chapters.title: Chapter 4430 Derivative I
paragraphs: The heavy Symphony continued building in surrounding atmosphere as for the first time in a while, Noah's smile transformed into actual laughter!
"Haha! Oh man, the delicious irony! An unkillable entity perishing! You may become the first of your kind to actually perish...and at hands of creatures you dismissed as imbecilic, no less!"
His words carried tremendous weight mixing revelation with cruel amusement, and THE Dead Order's expression of volcanic rage gradually... calmed.
She sat back even more deliberately upon her throne, forcing composure to return through sheer disciplined will.
Her features settled into careful neutrality as she processed everything.
Eventually, a calculated smile appeared across her face.
"This would represent the only unique situation where such outcome might be theoretically possible, wouldn't it? A singular vulnerability in otherwise absolute defense. But..."
Her smile took on predatory edge.
"What makes you genuinely believe you will be successful? That this siphoning will continue unimpeded until completion? You
fundamentally do not comprehend how massive my Civilization truly is...how infinitesimal the amount you're currently taking represents proportionally."
She gestured toward Sigrid dismissively.
"And her, the one you desecrate Order with through your base physical relationship...she resembles a delicate porcelain container that cannot hold substantial volume at present developmental level.
nt developmental level. She can easily break, this fragile thing. That would constitute genuine tragedy, wouldn't it? It would be such a shame."
Her voice intensified.
"You would also require time..moh, so much time that you simply do not possess! Me, Paradox, others... just which will reach you first?"

"THE Living Paradox doesn't know about her yet, correct? He would have taken immediate action if he possessed such intelligence. What if I simply share this discovery with him? Enemies of enemies are what again? Haha!"
HUUM!
She turned toward Sigrid with deadly smile and an expression mixing disappointment with cold calculation.

"And you. You are systematically siphoning my Civilizational Authority, yet you have barely articulated single word in this entire interaction. Do you not possess your own standing? Your own independent will?"
Her voice became scathing.

"You permit him to speak and act on your behalf for everything. Did he truly reduce you to merely his plaything? A toy existing solely for his desires and amusement? Can you not aspire to become something more as THE Living Order? He will diminish your light systematically. He will make you feel small and worthless as he appropriates all your brilliance and claims it as his own achievement."
Noah remained calm throughout such pointed provocation as behind him, Sigrid smiled with an expression mixing serenity and absolute conviction.

"I have only been made to shine brighter since encountering him. So Order need not concern itself with my wellbeing or autonomy. And he holds my Everything willingly given...you don't need to worry about
that arrangement either."
Her voice carried quiet strength.
"I will speak when I feel genuine need to contribute. Right now, I have been rather occupied with stealing from you. That requires
considerable focus, as you might imagine."
Her words emerged with grand simplicity, and THE Dead Order regarded her as if observing absolute fool...someone who couldn't recognize their own exploitation and diminishment.
Noah looked between both of them as his mind filled with grand possibilities, that devilish smile still present across his features!

After Sigrid's resolute reply affirming her choices and autonomy, THE Dead Order shook her head with an expression holding even greater disappointment...as if she was witnessing children playing with forces they fundamentally could not comprehend.
She maintained her regal bearing while speaking with a voice mixing condescension and genuine warning.
"You two truly do not even understand what you have inadvertently touched. That little Symphony of Existence you just manifested? You likely don't even comprehend what that phenomenon actually
represents."
Her voice took on lecturing quality.
"When one's existence becomes unique enough to affect all

surrounding reality in supportive resonance...when your Way aligns so perfectly with fundamental principles that Existence itself acknowledges your authority, manifestations occur across spectrum of intensity."
She gestured.
"At the weakest threshold, existence performs modest buzzing and trembling...barely perceptible recognition. Slightly above that level,
rhythmic sounds emerge as surrounding reality resonates with your cause, your Way of Existence harmonizing with Existence."
Her eyes gleamed!
"Those who are truly strong, however..."
At this moment, around her white throne, existence itself trembled
with far greater intensity than what Noah had inadvertently triggered! A glorious Symphony of Order began playing with full orchestral
magnificence!
It was not scattered drums but complete arrangement!
And beyond the instrumental grandeur, a chorus began echoing in the surroundings on her side of The Veil...voices that seemed to emerge from reality itself rather than specific singers!
"ORDER! SUPREMACY! ORDER IS SUPREMACY!"
HUUM!
The proclamation repeated with building intensity, each iteration
reinforcing the others until the conceptual space around THE Dead
Order vibrated with absolute conviction.
Existence itself resonated comprehensively with her Way as she
demonstrated capability to initiate a full Symphony and
accompanying chorus at her mere beck and call...and not accidentally triggered but deliberately commanded!
Oh!
Noah observed this display with eyes shining with analytical focus.
THE Dead Order stared back at him with an expression mixing pity and stern warning.
"You two possess no genuine comprehension of just what grandeur exists within Existence's infinite expanse. You simply do not know
what you're attempting to challenge. Keep pursuing your current course of action..."
Her voice dropped with weight of absolute certainty.

"And eventually I will be forced to deploy weapons that I did not intend to utilize until after The Fallout. Resources I have been carefully preserving for final confrontation. A weapon like... A Disciple
of THE Creature."
BOOM!
A Disciple...of THE Creature?
Noah's expression flickered with genuine surprise at this revelation.
This was one of the few indications that THE Creature possessed organized followers like others, if one did not count all Early Creatures as his followers!
THE Dead Order continued.
"THE Primordial Civilization of Existence was the strongest
framework, naturally. Even though THE Creature maintained

remarkably laid-back demeanor, he still cultivated members of his Civilization. His Disciples...select few entities that held interminable power positioned just below THE Living Existences themselves in hierarchy."
Her smile took on dangerous edge.
"I know precisely where such beings are currently suppressed. Just

like THE Living Paradox... you provoke me sufficiently, irritate me beyond tolerance threshold, and I may expend my considerable accumulated authority to liberate one of THE Creature's Disciples and direct them against you specifically."

chapters.title: Chapter 4431 Derivative II
paragraphs: Her voice intensified!
"Test me, Osmont. Please test me, and witness personally where such choices will ultimately lead you."
BOOM!
The threat landed with tremendous weight!
Noah's smile persisted despite, or perhaps because of the terrifying implications.
He closed his eyes while breathing out slowly, processing the accumulated waves of information.

This phenomenon with Sigrid siphoning Civilizational Authority of THE Dead Order has granted me access to invaluable resources. Direct communication with one of the more powerful existences currently operating outside THE Loom...
I have obtained extensive knowledge, but substantial work remains. While I continue managing THE Dead Order's attention here, I need to disseminate this critical understanding more broadly...
The knowledge regarding Ways of Existence and Primordial Civilizations seems unfathomably important to systematic advancement. Khor is an obvious recipient...
And another would be...the one who was currently expanding across The Lands of The Dead where THE Dead Order cannot even sense his presence!

He thought of Eckert when it came to sharing information that could advance one's way as the back of his mind also recalled another- The Peacemaker, and wondered what thst guy was upto now, of anything at all. But his mind revolved back to Eckert.

Since I lack direct access to that domain where endless territories of death stretch infinitely, Eckert might constitute only viable mechanism for extracting additional information and identifying potential weaknesses regarding THE Dead Order herself...

So at this moment, as a terrifying entity stared down at him with eyes promising catastrophic retaliation if provoked, Noah closed his eyes more completely and began transmitting comprehensive waves of information toward select few recipients.
He felt genuine curiosity regarding what results would manifest from this expanded knowledge distribution that had also granted him such profound advancement!
In The Lands of The Dead, across territories that stretched with impossible vastness beyond what Living domains could match, The Great Usurper continued his exponential and endless expansion.
His existence now covered multiple Citadels of The Dead...those vast metropolitan concentrations where countless deceased beings congregated.
He continued expanding with a silent inevitability, simply allowing the fundamental nature of his existence to spread without active effort or deliberate conquest.
Idle.
Unfettered and unbothered by concerns that motivated more active cultivators.
At such a time of passive growth, he began receiving substantial inflow of information from none other than the monstrous cheater himself...Osmont!
Eckert felt his consciousness buzzing as unique information flooded his awareness with unprecedented detail!
His mental voice processed aloud with mixture of surprise and focus.

"Primordial Civilizations? Permeation? Irreducibility? Inevitability? THE Primordial Civilization of THE Creature containing Existence itself... and all of this immense framework is intrinsically tied to... one's Way of Existence?"
His mind buzzed as he processed the comprehensive intelligence Osmont had transmitted.
Especially significant was how all this immensity connected fundamentally to one's personal Way of Existence...the individualized path each being carved through reality's infinite possibilities.
Osmont had mentioned this concept previously during earlier exchanges, but Eckert had deliberately left it unexplored rather than
pursuing it actively.
After all, the fundamental nature of his existence was Idle...would it truly align with his Way if he actively sought out something as critical
as his own path?
Wouldn't that constitute contradiction of his essential nature?
So he had remained Idle, allowing things to develop naturally.

And even now, as these terrifying waves of transformative information cascaded into his consciousness... he processed them with characteristic thoroughness, transmitted a brief message back to Osmont expressing gratitude for shared knowledge, and then...
He returned to his fundamental nature of Idleness, continuing to let things be as they should naturally become without forced
intervention.
At such a moment of deliberate non-action...
HUUUM!
His existence began buzzing with terrifying grandeur of power that remained unfathomably silent to all external observers.
He felt his already rapid expansion across reality accelerate by tens of multiples simultaneously!
Prompts materialized within his awareness right after!
Your existence has processed knowledge regarding Primordial
Civilizations and Ways of Existence
Your nature has retained its true Idle framework throughout
integration
Due to the unique characteristics of your existence, any actively made grand declarations would have violated your fundamental nature, minor active actions would not
For choosing to genuinely remain Idle even when presented with transformative knowledge, your Way of Existence has accumulated sufficient foundation to properly embark upon its destined path
YOUR WAY IS IDLE
And yet paradoxically, your Existence has already covered vast
expanses:|
-Numerous Folds of Existence
-Multiple Domains of Existence
-Many Wheels of Existence
-Extensive territories across The Lands of The Dead
-Growing presence within The Lands of The Living
Your Idle Way has encompassed immense variation of Existence itself through passive expansion rather than active conquest]
Your Way of Existence qualifies as Derivative Way stemming from a Primordial Civilization. Specifically: THE PRIMORDIAL CIVILIZATION OF EXISTENCE
You have begun embarking upon: The Derivative Way of Idle
Existence
A legitimate aspect of THE Creature's comprehensive framework, expressing Existence through lens of perfect non-action
BOOM!

Eckert felt like catastrophic explosion had detonated within his fundamental existence...as if he had been a modest star that at this precise moment became connected to something millions of times larger and more magnificent!

The influx of power felt so immense and so incomprehensibly grand that his existence screamed for him to do something dramatic with it...to act, to move, to demonstrate this newfound capability through
spectacular display!
And...
And...!
"Nah..." he simply acknowledged the immensity with characteristic nonchalance, enjoying the sensation while observing additional cascading prompts flash before his awareness.
But for the most part... he remained Idle.
Oh!

He felt tremendous influx of Civilizational Authority flowing into him from THE Primordial Civilization of Existence itself...the passive accumulation accelerating dramatically as his Derivative Way established proper connection to the source framework. He continued remaining Idle as he studied all manifestations with detached wonder, processing implications without feeling compelled toward immediate action.
"The Derivative Way of Idle Existence... a bit wordy, isn't it?" he
mused.
Derivative.
An authentic Aspect of THE Primordial Civilization of Existence, not
an inferior copy but a legitimate expression of fundamental principle through a specific lens.
It had fallen into the metaphorical hands of The Great Usurper, and after obtaining such monumentally grand designation...
He remained Idle.
And Existence continued unfolding around him, his territories expanding exponentially while he personally did absolutely nothing beyond being what he fundamentally was.
The irony was perfect- the being who refused to act had stumbled
into one of the most significant advancements possible, becoming a living embodiment of passive supremacy.

Somewhere far away, across The Veil separating domains, Noah would soon receive confirmation that his knowledge distribution had yielded spectacular results as...was Mana not involved in the explosion of Authority within Eckert.
Was the Mana that directly transmitted the knowledge not involved?
Was Mana...not pervasively everywhere?!
HUUM!
But for now, Eckert simply existed within his expanding territories,

content to observe rather than participate, embodying Idleness. Sometimes, he reflected, the greatest power comes not from doing everything, but from doing precisely nothing at all...haha! And with that thought settling comfortably in his awareness, The Great Usurper returned his attention to the vastness of The Lands of The Dead stretching endlessly before him. The territories waiting to be encompassed through his signature methodology of patient, inevitable, and perfectly Idle expansion!
Oh!

chapters.title: Chapter 4432 A Glimpse of Wonder I
paragraphs: Far from The Lands of The Living or The Lands of The Dead, in a location that very few entities could accurately pinpoint or describe with meaningful precision.
Inside of it, there existed a paradisiacal domain that defied conventional categorization.
An endlessly vast beach stretched in all directions, its shores lapped by radiant gold waters that seemed to contain concentrated essence of vitality itself.

The liquid shimmered with internal luminescence as perhaps it was liquified possibility, or crystallized potential given fluid form as it seemed much more potent than Early Sacred Waters of Early Veiled Shores.

The sky above this impossible beach constituted an illusory expanse of stellar white-gold brilliance, and if one observed carefully with enhanced perception...there appeared to be a visible ceiling far above!
It was as if this entire magnificent place was contained within the interior of some massive structure rather than existing as open territory.

The sands themselves shimmered with white-gold radiance that made each granule appear like microscopic star, and throughout the surroundings... thousands upon thousands of Early Creatures could be observed, surrounded by Living Emotives in approximately equal
distribution.
They were adorned in unique attire that somehow managed to blend tribal aesthetics with beach fashion.
Many of these entities lounged luxuriously on white-gold beach chairs and beds as their bodies were surrounded with radiant Civilizational Authority!
But even more were focused intently on what appeared to be a...game
occurring between assembled group of Early Creatures and Living Emotives.
The game bore a superficial resemblance to dodgeball, but operated at scale and with mechanics that transformed it into something far more spectacular.

Early Creatures occupied one side of the expansive playing field while Living Emotives positioned themselves opposite, and the "ball" being utilized was nothing less than a complete Primordial Fold...a spherical structure containing millions of Wheels of Existence and countless life forms dwelling within its compressed reality.

The goal appeared straightforward: pass this circular object through white square goal post positioned at the very end of the opposing side's territory, while the other team attempted to intercept, deflect, or return it toward your own goal.

The game required both tremendous power and extraordinary control... participants needed sufficient force to propel the Primordial Fold across vast distances while simultaneously modulating that power to ensure none of it transferred internally to accidentally eliminate every single life form contained within the structure.

At this moment, an Early Creature with radiant crimson-gold eyes and matching crimson-gold hair displayed expression of pure excitement and wonder as her hand pulsed with terrifying power that exceeded Quintillions entirely...measuring well into Sextillions of accumulated Complexity and Purity.

The authority flowing within her existence wasn't merely Living Paradoxical Authority, but actual Civilizational Authority of Paradox that made it clear she was recognized as a member of that Primordial framework!

She controlled this overwhelming power with purposeful precision, striking the circular Primordial Fold with force calculated to propel it toward the goal without allowing any energy to bleed through its containment and catastrophically affect the Fold Dwellers dwelling
within.

The moment her strike connected, her teammates erupted with synchronized waves of Haki...releasing oppressive auras of Civilizational Authority designed to slow the opposing Living Emotives just slightly, creating fractional advantage that proved decisive!
The Living Emotives lunged desperately to intercept, but the combined timing proved insufficient. The Primordial Fold crossed through the white square goal post marking victory!
HUUM!
The crimson-gold haired Early Creature's celebration was immediate and uninhibited.

She wore pink bloomers paired with white tank top, practical athletic attire that allowed full range of motion while maintaining modesty. She raised her fist victoriously, her ecstatic beauty shining resplendently as she roared with triumph.
"THAT is how you achieve victory! Precision, timing, and absolute confidence in execution!"
The Early Creatures surrounding her, each pulsing with power measuring within Sextillions, erupted into celebratory chaos as they chanted her name with enthusiasm.
"AMBESSA! AMBESSA! AMBESSA!"
The radiant Early Creature smiled broadly as she heard her name being proclaimed across the beach, basking momentarily in acknowledgment of her game-winning play.
But in the next moment, a heavy and stern voice also called out her name with completely different tone...a tone mixing authority with the expectation of immediate obedience.
She blinked with surprise and turned around. Toward the far end of

the beach where sand transitioned into radiant forest, and even further away...massive and impossibly tall structures portraying an endlessly vast citadel of white and gold could be seen stretching toward that false ceiling.

Where the beach met the beginnings of this radiant forest before expanding into the greater citadel, there stood a stern Early Creature adorned in golden Chiton...a traditional garment, who was calling her name with unmistakable command.
Ambessa's smile shifted from a celebration to a respectful acknowledgment as she took single step and instantly appeared mere inches away from this authoritative being.
She smoothly transitioned into kneeling posture while speaking.
"Forge Emperor Niso, what brings you all the way out to these recreational beaches? Surely not merely to observe our stupid game?"
Forge Emperor Niso cut an impressive figure...a muscular Early Creature with golden hair and bronze skin that seemed to radiate contained heat.
He possessed a commanding presence that exceeded simple physical intimidation, and he seemed like someone accustomed to being obeyed without question!

His Complexity measured far into Sextillions....orders of magnitude beyond Ambessa's already impressive accumulation, positioning him as one of the slightly powerful entities even within this tiny, tiny portion of THE Loom's concentrated population where Living Emotives and some Early Creatures resided.
When he spoke, his voice carried weight of someone delivering an important directive.

"An order came from the higher administrative echelons. They were seeking recommendation from me specifically for someone positioned relatively low within Sextillion range...still developing rather than fully matured, but demonstrating exceptionalism that exceeds peers of
equivalent developmental stage."
His gaze fixed on Ambessa.
"So I selected you. This represents potential opportunity for you and
several others...depending on who proves most outstanding and compatible, to earn tangible recognition within the glorious light of Paradox itself. Come with me immediately."

sentences.text: Far from The Lands of The Living or The Lands of The Dead, in a location that very few entities could accurately pinpoint or describe with meaningful precision.
Inside of it, there existed a paradisiacal domain that defied conventional categorization.
An endlessly vast beach stretched in all directions, its shores lapped by radiant gold waters that seemed to contain concentrated essence of vitality itself.

The liquid shimmered with internal luminescence as perhaps it was liquified possibility, or crystallized potential given fluid form as it seemed much more potent than Early Sacred Waters of Early Veiled Shores.

The sky above this impossible beach constituted an illusory expanse of stellar white-gold brilliance, and if one observed carefully with enhanced perception...there appeared to be a visible ceiling far above!
It was as if this entire magnificent place was contained within the interior of some massive structure rather than existing as open territory.

The sands themselves shimmered with white-gold radiance that made each granule appear like microscopic star, and throughout the surroundings... thousands upon thousands of Early Creatures could be observed, surrounded by Living Emotives in approximately equal
distribution.
They were adorned in unique attire that somehow managed to blend tribal aesthetics with beach fashion.
Many of these entities lounged luxuriously on white-gold beach chairs and beds as their bodies were surrounded with radiant Civilizational Authority!
But even more were focused intently on what appeared to be a...game
occurring between assembled group of Early Creatures and Living Emotives.
The game bore a superficial resemblance to dodgeball, but operated at scale and with mechanics that transformed it into something far more spectacular.

Early Creatures occupied one side of the expansive playing field while Living Emotives positioned themselves opposite, and the "ball" being utilized was nothing less than a complete Primordial Fold...a spherical structure containing millions of Wheels of Existence and countless life forms dwelling within its compressed reality.

The goal appeared straightforward: pass this circular object through white square goal post positioned at the very end of the opposing side's territory, while the other team attempted to intercept, deflect, or return it toward your own goal.

The game required both tremendous power and extraordinary control... participants needed sufficient force to propel the Primordial Fold across vast distances while simultaneously modulating that power to ensure none of it transferred internally to accidentally eliminate every single life form contained within the structure.

At this moment, an Early Creature with radiant crimson-gold eyes and matching crimson-gold hair displayed expression of pure excitement and wonder as her hand pulsed with terrifying power that exceeded Quintillions entirely...measuring well into Sextillions of accumulated Complexity and Purity.

The authority flowing within her existence wasn't merely Living Paradoxical Authority, but actual Civilizational Authority of Paradox that made it clear she was recognized as a member of that Primordial framework!

She controlled this overwhelming power with purposeful precision, striking the circular Primordial Fold with force calculated to propel it toward the goal without allowing any energy to bleed through its containment and catastrophically affect the Fold Dwellers dwelling
within.

The moment her strike connected, her teammates erupted with synchronized waves of Haki...releasing oppressive auras of Civilizational Authority designed to slow the opposing Living Emotives just slightly, creating fractional advantage that proved decisive!
The Living Emotives lunged desperately to intercept, but the combined timing proved insufficient.
The Primordial Fold crossed through the white square goal post marking victory!
HUUM!
The crimson-gold haired Early Creature's celebration was immediate and uninhibited.
She wore pink bloomers paired with white tank top, practical athletic attire that allowed full range of motion while maintaining modesty.
She raised her fist victoriously, her ecstatic beauty shining resplendently as she roared with triumph.
"THAT is how you achieve victory!
Precision, timing, and absolute confidence in execution!"
The Early Creatures surrounding her, each pulsing with power measuring within Sextillions, erupted into celebratory chaos as they chanted her name with enthusiasm.
"AMBESSA!
AMBESSA!
AMBESSA!"
The radiant Early Creature smiled broadly as she heard her name being proclaimed across the beach, basking momentarily in acknowledgment of her game-winning play.
But in the next moment, a heavy and stern voice also called out her name with completely different tone...a tone mixing authority with the expectation of immediate obedience.
She blinked with surprise and turned around.
Toward the far end of

the beach where sand transitioned into radiant forest, and even further away...massive and impossibly tall structures portraying an endlessly vast citadel of white and gold could be seen stretching toward that false ceiling.

Where the beach met the beginnings of this radiant forest before expanding into the greater citadel, there stood a stern Early Creature adorned in golden Chiton...a traditional garment, who was calling her name with unmistakable command.
Ambessa's smile shifted from a celebration to a respectful acknowledgment as she took single step and instantly appeared mere inches away from this authoritative being.
She smoothly transitioned into kneeling posture while speaking.
"Forge Emperor Niso, what brings you all the way out to these recreational beaches?
Surely not merely to observe our stupid game?"
Forge Emperor Niso cut an impressive figure...a muscular Early Creature with golden hair and bronze skin that seemed to radiate contained heat.
He possessed a commanding presence that exceeded simple physical intimidation, and he seemed like someone accustomed to being obeyed without question!

His Complexity measured far into Sextillions....orders of magnitude beyond Ambessa's already impressive accumulation, positioning him as one of the slightly powerful entities even within this tiny, tiny portion of THE Loom's concentrated population where Living Emotives and some Early Creatures resided.
When he spoke, his voice carried weight of someone delivering an important directive.
"An order came from the higher administrative echelons.

They were seeking recommendation from me specifically for someone positioned relatively low within Sextillion range...still developing rather than fully matured, but demonstrating exceptionalism that exceeds peers of
equivalent developmental stage."
His gaze fixed on Ambessa.
"So I selected you.
This represents potential opportunity for you and
several others...depending on who proves most outstanding and compatible, to earn tangible recognition within the glorious light of Paradox itself.
Come with me immediately."

chapters.title: Chapter 4433 A Glimpse of Wonder II
paragraphs: Forge Emperor Niso waved his hands with a gesture of absolute authority, and the two of them instantly disappeared from the beach environment.

When they reappeared, they found themselves inside grand structure...walking through hall lined with white and gold marble that opened into massive room equipped with advanced technological apparatus that blended seamlessly with more mystical implements. The room contained numerous radiant blank screens currently in standby mode, with Early Creatures and Living Emotives moving purposefully about as they prepared equipment and verified operational parameters.

At this moment, eight other entities possessing similar stature to Forge Emperor Niso had already arrived, each accompanied by single Early Creature measuring few Sextillions in Complexity and Purity.
All candidates stood in orderly formation before an Early Creature wearing pristine white laboratory coat whose body pulsed with unmistakable Civilizational Authority of Concept!
When Forge Emperor Niso and Ambessa materialized, this Early Creature in laboratory attire waved his hands with satisfied gesture.
"Excellent. All nine candidates have arrived. We may proceed with briefing and selection protocols."
He positioned himself centrally to address the assembled group witha voice of scientific precision and barely contained excitement.

"For those unfamiliar with my designation, I am Axiom Architect Surion...an existential researcher and developmental engineer specializing in bridging theoretical frameworks of with actual practical applications. I am present at the grand request of an important Paradox Anax from The Primordial Civilization of Paradox to identify nine relatively weak Early Creatures whose existences may
theoretically be deployed outside THE Loom without triggering a catastrophic rejection from Existence."
His words detonated like a conceptual bomb among the assembled candidates, many of whom had never even conceived such deployment was remotely possible!
The revelation was so profound that Ambessa's eyes widened with genuine shock as she raised her hand with an urgent question.

"Sir, how is that even theoretically possible? I was taught that THE Loom's boundaries are absolutely impermeable until THE Glorious Evolution, that nothing can enter or exit without catastrophic destabilization..."
Axiom Architect Surion looked at her with an expression of approval for asking intelligent question and satisfaction at having a dramatic revelation to share.
He pointed deliberately toward pair of radiant gold headsets positioned nearby.
The devices appeared extraordinarily sophisticated.
Each headset connected via luminescent wires to radiant white chairs
that resembled a combination of throne and medical apparatus.
The headsets themselves possessed elegant curves of organic growth patterns, but their surfaces displayed geometric precision that could only emerge from deliberate engineering.
They pulsed with internal radiance that cycled through spectrum of possibility, and intricate glyphs covering their exteriors suggested they operated through mechanisms of utter glory!
It was something that lesser beings could not conceive or ever have the chance to design, much less hold in their hands.
Axiom Architect Surion's voice held genuine pride in the innovation he was about to describe.
"These are Existence Avatar Diadems...cutting-edge prototypes produced by Concept Anax Kiu operating from the distant Primordial Concept Shelters."

"They theoretically allow someone positioned relatively weakly within THE Loom's power hierarchy to wear these devices and project an Illusory Reality Avatar of Existence outside THE Loom's boundaries."
His expression became more serious.

"The projected form will inevitably be weaker than your actual existence...potentially significantly so. It may also prove unstable depending on individual compatibility and external interference. But you would be among the first to test operational viability in genuine field conditions."
"It would otherwise be completely impossible to project even whispers outside THE Loom before the designated moment of THE Glorious Evolution."
The other candidates displayed brilliant and excited reactions...some whispering urgently to their sponsoring authorities, others stepping forward eagerly to examine the devices more closely.
But Ambessa's eyes shone with a calm intellect rather than simple enthusiasm as she asked the more straightforward question.
"For what specific purpose are we undertaking this unprecedented deployment? What objectives would justify utilizing such valuable prototype technology on relatively weak candidates?"
Forge Emperor Niso appeared ready to admonish her for questioning rather than simply accepting honor, but Axiom Architect Surion smiled with appreciation for her approach.

"An excellent inquiry. A certain...Paradox Anax from The Primordial Civilization of Paradox, I am not authorized to reveal his specific identity, recently heard troubling musings from THE Esteemed Living Paradox himself regarding an annoyance that a mere shred of his will
was encountering outside THE Loom."
HUUM!
His voice carried a weight of existential significance!

"THE Esteemed Living Paradox's power is heavily suppressed by Existence itself in external territories, reduced to fraction of his true capability. Since the Paradox Anax and those he directly oversees are far too Complex to manifest outside THE Loom, he desired attendants who could assist with whatever needs arise for that shred of THE
Esteemed Living Paradox's will."
He paused for emphasis.

"If you succeed in this deployment, you would simultaneously be testing groundbreaking product of THE Esteemed Living Concept and earning substantial favor from a Paradox Anax...one of the administrative authorities managing portions of Paradox's Primordial Civilization. Such recognition could accelerate your advancement by
eons. Are you all prepared to accept this opportunity?"
Ambessa's eyes blazed with crimson-gold intensity as confidence
surged through her existence.
She smiled broadly and stepped forward before any other candidates
could claim priority, moving directly toward the Existence Avatar
Diadems.
She selected one device and lifted it with reverent care before positioning it upon her head with a decisive motion.
The moment contact was established, glyphs across its surface began
pulsing with synchronized rhythm matching her own existential
signature.
Her voice emerged with absolute conviction.
"Let's do this!"
The other eight candidates exchanged glances of competitive spirit as
if this was merely a game, and one by one they also moved to claim
their own devices.
Radiant white gold light began to pulse as all 9 laid back on the thrones, their faces covered by the Existence Avatar Diadems headsets as their existence experienced grand changes!
Axiom Architect Surion observed with satisfaction as all nine
candidates prepared themselves, and somewhere far beyond THE Loom's impermeable boundaries, an entirely unsuspecting reality was about to receive unprecedented additional visitors...in due time.

chapters.title: Chapter 4434 The Scales of Law I
paragraphs: In the region of collapse where crimson-blue molten Mana still churned with residual violence from the deadly battle between Noah and Tatiana.
The Infiniverse floated serenely amidst this grand sea of liquified authority.
At this moment, the figure of Riya materialized near The Infiniverse's entrance with a dramatic flair.
A rope of pure Primus Mana extended from her hand, its other end secured around the wrist of a notably despondent Leonore
Rureaux...who appeared lost in contemplation regarding numerous troubling matters.
Above Riya's head, the manifestation of the crown symbolizing the Boon of The Minor Mana and Hunger Palisades shone with brilliant blue-gold radiance.
Her Complexity and Purity had long since surged past 100 Quintillion threshold, her power vibrant and barely contained within her physical form!
The moment she fully materialized near The Infiniverse, several figures emerged from its entrance to greet the arrivals.
The Queen of Matter appeared first, surrounded by floating books connected by luminescent threads that constantly rearranged themselves according to some incomprehensible organizational system.
Alongside her came Henry, The Emperor Penguin maintaining a regal proud bearing despite his unusual form, and The Blue Slime quivering with barely contained enthusiasm.
There was also Kazuhiko observing with focus, and a few others representing Noah's inner circle.

The Queen of Matter's eyes shone with genuine excitement as she spoke first, words tumbling out with barely contained enthusiasm. "Hello! Master instructed us to welcome members of his Isolated Civilization! I am The Queen of Matter, and I can serve as your comprehensive guide to The Infiniverse and The Early Veiled Shore. I know absolutely everything about its architecture, history, and current status!"
Her eyes sparkled with pride as Riya blinked with slight surprise before smiling lightly.
"Hello! I am Riyannara, the cherished plaything of the Ancestor!"
The Queen of Matter displayed a shocked expression as comprehension settled.
"Plaything? Another one already? Goodness, The Master cant keep getting away with this! Oh!"
Riya's eyes pulsed with interested curiosity at this revelation as she began asking.
"Oh? How many playthings does the Ancestor currently maintain-"
HUUM!
Before she could complete her inquiry, a hand filled with
concentrated blue Mana descended toward her head with clear intent to deliver corrective strike.
She coolly evaded the attack with minimal movement, and Kael alongside other Seed Members of the Isolated Civilization arrived with expressions of disapproval.
Kael wore particularly stern expression while staring at Riya with unambiguous warning, and when he spoke, his voice held the authority of someone accustomed to commanding respect.

"Forgive the Prize of our Civilization...her enthusiasm occasionally exceeds appropriate boundaries. I am Kael, and I come bearing gifts of advancement from The Ancestor that we have meticulously developed in The Way of Mana across eons of dedicated cultivation."

Those positioned behind him pulsed with considerable power, and even though they hadn't yet received the Boon of Minor Mana and Hunger Palisades, they emanated Complexity that notably exceeded Henry and most others present!
Henry stepped forward at this diplomatic juncture with smile mixing genuine welcome.
"I am Henry Osmont. The only Son of The Ancestor. Please, do come in and make yourselves comfortable..."
Henry had proclaimed aloud how he was the Son of The Ancestor
they all revered so profoundly.
Kael and the others instantly experienced their eyes lighting up with recognition and appropriate deference.
This was the Son of The Ancestor himself!

Henry smiled at the immediate recognition as his Weavings of Nepotism pulsed with glory...because why would he not be deriving genuine benefit from familial connection rather than personal achievement?
He was currently feeling absolutely no shame regarding his birthright!
Behind them, The Infiniverse opened a massive gateway revealing glimpses of impossible internal architecture, and Kael alongside his contingent looked inward with expressions of awe.
They came bearing gifts of wonder and advancement to share with their fellow members of Noah's expanding Civilizations!
Countless Glyphs and Arcana Glyphs to aid one across The Way of The Mana Architect, and more.

Riya harrumphed with displeasure at being diplomatically corrected, her body dividing cleanly into two separate manifestations- one composed of pure Primus Mana that entered The Infiniverse to participate in welcoming procedures, while the other remained stationed with Leonore Rureaux.
She smiled toward her captive with expression of calmness and necessary caution.

"Hey bestie, you won't enter The Ancestor's most intimate domains until I can fully verify you aren't some sophisticated imposter or compromised agent. I believe you personally, I genuinely do, but I must exercise appropriate caution when it concerns The Ancestor's security. No hard feelings, okay? Just hang tight until The Ancestor provides explicit order regarding locating your Schrodingers..."
She hummed thoughtfully while saying this, snapping her fingers to create luxurious Mana thrones for both of them...comfortable seating manifested from pure authority.
Leonore Rureaux did not reply as her gaze moved about.
Riya leaned closer to Leonore Rureaux while whispering with
conspiratorial tone.
"But can you believe it? The Ancestor has a son and many playthinsm.
The son is a bit weak in terms of grandeur compared to what direct Blood of the Ancestor should theoretically manifest..."

"...but hey, it would be genuinely weird if someone could actually match The Ancestor, even if they share direct genetic lineage. As for the playthings, in our glorious Civilization of Mana, the strong are favored. The strong can have whatever they want. I could've had many things, but I kept myself waiting for the Ancestor!" She talked and talked as if someone was genuinely listening to all her
words!
She articulated her observationz as Leonore Rureaux only silently nodded without substantial response, and Riya sighed with mixture of sympathy and mild frustration.
"Come on, I know you're hella depressed currently, but I'm actively

trying to redirect your attention away from obsessing over your Schrodinger situation. You are your own being at fundamental level...look for constructive solutions rather than drowning in despair. Get revenge against THE Living Paradox for what he orchestrated!"
At these words, Leonore Rureaux's eyes finally shone with brighter intensity as she nodded with more conviction.
Riya smiled with satisfaction at having provoked productive response

as she gazed toward the closing doorway into The Infiniverse. "Hey, tell me about external Existence...or for you, normal observable reality. What are the major factions? The tyrannical Early Creatures? Fold Dwellers? Living Existences? Any entertaining weavings of existence worth sharing?"
She posed such question with genuine curiosity, and Leonore
Rureaux sighed before beginning to speak about the broader landscape beyond their current isolated position!

chapters.title: Chapter 4435 The Scales of Law II
paragraphs: Far from their current location within The Collapse, in a domain of Law filled with brilliant silver-white grandeur of absolute order and systematic justice, an extraordinary scene was unfolding.

Alexander Asmodeus spun silently while suspended in mid-air, surrounded by potent Living Authority of Law that resonated with his existence, and additionally...concentrated Civilizational Authority of Law that marked him as legitimate inheritor rather!
Below him on silver marbled ground that reflected his spinning form with perfect clarity, Seraphina Valorheart panted with evident exhaustion.
Her existence seemingly could not handle the complete inheritance being offered, and her framework was lacking sufficient breadth to contain such concentrated authority.
Around Alexander, within his consciousness, the voice of THE Living Law rang out with a mixture of satisfaction.

"Different beings possess fundamentally different Breadths of Existence, the capacity to contain and express authority varies dramatically across individuals. Some are naturally born Leaders like Elderborns, possessing innate capability to coordinate vast resources."
"Others have uniquely expansive landscapes within their existential architecture, allowing them to house multiple competing authorities simultaneously."
The voice continued with analytical assessment.
"You could handle my full inheritance without catastrophic destabilization. That girl could not...her framework lacks necessary dimensional breadth, though she possesses other valuable qualities."
Alexander looked towards Seraphina Valorheart calmly as he heard these words echo out in his mind.
"She will be of substantial help to you in future endeavors, so do not abandon her merely because she cannot match your capacity. Loyalty has value beyond simple power."
The tone then shifted.

"But as of now, you hold a leading administrative position within my Primordial Civilization of Law. Even though a large portion of my Civilization was systematically collapsed by a coordinated assault, a fundamental truth remains: A Primordial Civilization can never be truly collapsed. Only suppressed, only diminished...never permanently eliminated."
Anticipation entered the voice as THE Living Law continued!

"After The Fallout and THE Loom opens, I will possess opportunity to rise again toward previous heights. But if you prove sufficiently exceptional in upcoming trials... you might be capable of surviving long enough to become a False THE before The Fallout even commences. That may give you the power to save others and whether through The Fallout. Maybe...maybe."
The voice became more practical.

"You wanted to be given genuine chance at significance rather than remaining scattered individual. This is it. You possess the Scales of Law innately within your existence now...whenever you encounter anyone, their true affiliations will be weighed."

Collapsed Civilizations...survivors maintaining vestigial identities while lacking unified purpose or coordinated strategy."

BOOM!

COLLABORATION!"
BOOM!

a voice of absolute conviction!

WAP!

They had been directly transported to t Transcendent Law Folds.
Their appearance occurred in a region filled with expected silver-white brilliance of Law suggesting this was appropriate
territory...
But alongside this established authority, there also seemed to be unusual influence of blue permeating the atmosphere!
Blue!

with confused assessment.
"Mana? Why would such extraordinarily pure Mana be covering the Transcendent Law Folds so comprehensively...

He perceived what had been concealed: a
Crow in the distance observing them with unusual intensity!

"Who are you? Why do you possess... such unusual authority radiating from your existence? That signature doesn't match any
known Living Laws currently operating here...
Alexander's eyes also turned cold as he responded with voice carrying
judgment.
"The Scales of Law deem you... among those connected to THE Loom. Let me see... Emotive? What specific connection do you maintain to Emotive that would relate to THE Loom?"
HUUM!

Malphas, began radiating power that caused Seraphina to gasp in shock at the magnitude, while Alexander Asmodeus maintained cold observation despite recognizing the genuine threat.
They just came out, and they meet someone this powerful?! Malphas deliberately donned white gloves with a theatrical flare as if
this white would soon be painted red, and he said with a voice mixing threat and curiosity.
"I'll be asking the questions today. No ordinary Living Laws would emanate the Civilizational Authority of Law you are displaying. You may be the ones actually connected to THE Loom. What are you
truly?"
Two powerful entities faced off at this critical moment as whether they would actually come to violent blows or find diplomatic resolution... remained uncertain!

chapters.title: Chapter 4436 Infinite Hunger! I
paragraphs: In the middle of what had been escalating into tense standoff
between Malphas and Alexander Asmodeus, the atmosphere shifted dramatically.
A moment later, Malphas' cold gaze flickered subtly as if receiving new information.
His hands, which had been positioned to deliver devastating assault, slowly lowered as his expression transformed from hostile assessment to practiced calm.
When he spoke, his voice held apologetic professionalism.
"My apologies for the aggressive posturing. I am Malphas, and The Master has just informed me that you are designated as friendlies."
Alexander blinked with confusion at this abrupt de-escalation.
"What Master are you referring to?"
Malphas replied with simple clarity.
"The Early Creature, Osmont."
The moment Alexander absorbed this revelation, his eyes opened wide with recognition and his entire figure relaxed dramatically.
Even though the Scales of Law continued indicating some form of link between this being and components of THE Loom, the identity of Osmont superseded all such warnings!
Seraphina Valorheart observed the complete diffusion of what had been imminent violence the instant Noah's name was invoked, and she shook her head with mixture of relief and exasperation.
She addressed Alexander with a voice of an urgent reminder. "Can we please proceed to the Heart of Law? We have to assess the
true extent of what remains of the Collapsed Civilization of Law and its location in the Wandering Territories... and the Kleos Council should know something."
Alexander looked at her bright, somewhat pouting eyes as he sighed. He wanted to check in with Osmont! He sighed once more before looking toward Malphas.
"Can you provide a little summary of what has occurred recently in these territories? We must attend to Law's infrastructure first..
Malphas nodded with practiced efficiency.
"The Master has expressed curiosity regarding the Civilizational Authority buzzing prominently around your existence. This
manifestation of mine can accompany you with The Master's explicit permission and aid you as needed."
With such arrangement established, Alexander nodded with acceptance as Seraphina looked between the two of them before sighing again.
"Let's go then!"
Her figure surged toward the Heart of Law with determined velocity while Malphas appeared beside Alexander with fluid grace, his gaze calm as they began following.
Malphas spoke with a voice of genuine interest in fulfilling his assigned role.
"Where shall I begin the summary? Recent events have been... remarkably eventful."
Far from their current position, in the Transcendent Quantum Folds, Noah stood beside Khor in that carefully veiled domain.

From their concealed vantage, they could observe the Justiciar Outpost maintaining its ominous vigilance, as well as the massive wall grotesquely fused with Mutated Inevitabilities...and most significantly, the faint doorway inscribed upon that terrible structure suggesting potential passage toward THE Loom itself.
At this moment, Noah's attention focused primarily on Khor as her body pulsed with immense concentrated waves of Civilizational
Authority of Hunger.
Her expression held profound heaviness as if she was remembering something that had always been fundamental part of her identity but had been forcibly suppressed or fragmented.
When she spoke, her voice was a heavy one!

"My Hunger. My Inevitabilities. My People. We were so magnificently free before the catastrophe. Amongst all Primordial Civilizations, we should have been among the earliest to manifest...apart from Existence itself, Hunger represents one of the most fundamental principles driving all advancement."
Her crimson eyes blazed.

"To systematically collapse Hunger, to subjugate and mutate all Inevitabilities like what we witnessed on that wall... Oh, Outsider, I am truly going to fuck up Paradox when opportunity presents itself. The vengeance will be proportional to eons of accumulated suffering."
HUUM!

Noah smiled at Khor's passionate declaration as after he had relayed comprehensive information regarding Primordial Civilizations and their five critical qualities, her reforming Way had elevated dramatically...just as his own understanding had triggered advancement.
Similar to his experience, she had already possessed everything necessary.
She simply required the knowledge to properly access and utilize

what had always been present within her collapsed framework. Knowledge had proven critical beyond any other factor, and at this moment, he could feel the steady stream of Hunger descending onto her from across Observable Existence.
Her power continued exploding upward with momentum that suggested no immediate ceiling!
Noah's eyes pulsed as his voice echoed out.
"My Hunger and yours are fundamentally connected, and yet maintain unique characteristics. I planted your Hunger as you emerged from suppression, and I listened to the Doctrines of Hunger
to have Ozymandias enact my Civilization of Hunger through that
vessel."
His voice carried weight of magisterial revelation.
"The two of us are essentially building the same Civilization, but my

Hunger is fully intertwined with Mana in ways yours is not. My progression will systematically aid your restoration, and your advancement will reciprocally strengthen my framework. We are....symbiotic rather than competitive."
Khor opened her crimson eyes fully and looked at him with expression mixing gratitude and determination.
She raised her hands in the Farmer's Greeting- three fingers extended with deliberate significance.
"Outsider, let us accomplish great things together. Let us restore what was collapsed and forge something even more magnificent than what
existed before."
Noah smiled with satisfaction as he stretched out his own three fingers to meet Khor's in the traditional gesture, and a silent wave of crimson-obsidian Hunger bloomed between them like a covenant
being sealed!
Prompts materialized simultaneously within both their minds.
The intricate connection between The Primordial Civilization of Hunger and The Primordial Civilization of Mana has been comprehensively clarified
At this moment, the foundations of both Civilizations have reached sufficient developmental level:
|--Hunger is free and unbound, no longer suppressed or corrupted
-Mana is infinite, permeating all existence as fundamental building
block
|A Critical Threshold Has Been Achieved:
A period of POPULATION EXPLOSION has been enacted] RESPLENDENT SANCTUARIES OF INEVITABILITIES can now be
formed as Civilizational Structures]
These Sanctuaries will produce: 1,000,000 Primus Inevitabilities of Mana and Hunger DAILY
Specifications of the Primus Inevitabilities of Mana and Hunger:
-Minimum Baseline: 1 Quintillion Complexity and Purity at birth
|-Inherent Capability: Born with instinctive ability to utilize Civilizational Authority of both Mana and Hunger] -Growth Potential: Unlimited advancement trajectory
-Loyalty Framework: Innately aligned with your Civilizations'
principles and objectives
-Tactical Flexibility: Capable of independent operation or coordinated swarm tactics
Hunger was collapsed and subjugated under ravenous entity who
currently holds the corrupted Heart of Hunger
For the sake of all those experiencing constant agony of mutated and
defiled appetite...
For the countless Inevitabilities suffering under forced mutation and
perversion of their essential nature...
A new Hunger burning with light of infinity will rise from these ashes]
Where the old Hunger was collapsed, the new Hunger will prove
inevitable
Where the old framework was corrupted, the new structure will
maintain purity
The cycle continues, but this time with vengeance driving
restoration
The prompts carried tremendous weight, and Khor's crimson eyes sparkled with barely contained glory!
Noah smiled as his words echoed out.
"Our Civilization possesses grand and unfathomable potential. All we
genuinely require is time...duration sufficient to accumulate what others obtained across eons." His voice intensified with conviction!
"With adequate time... even the Primordial Civilizations that have been
advancing systematically for incomprehensible duration, collecting passive benefits through Existential Communication and Permeation
every single moment... it may just prove possible to catch up with
them. Maybe." His smile widened.
"They had eons. We have Perpetual Harvest, Cheating Architect, and a
bit more..."
The confidence was well-founded rather than delusional!
They knew it would be arduously hard.
Noah knew how terrifying and immense the Primordial Civilization of
Paradox and others had to be because of how terrifying his own
budding Civilization was!
He knew.
But still.
He held no Fear or Doubt.
He may stumble down the line. The enemies they might meet could
overwhelm them momentarily.
But...
"My Mana is Infinite. My Hunger is Infinite. And I...am really, truly
fucking hungry." HUUM!

paragraphs: He was hungry for much more of existence!
After proclaiming this conviction with tyrannical certainty, Noah gazed at the distant Justiciar Outpost and the ominous wall of THE Loom stretching behind it.
At that terrible structure fused with Mutated Inevitabilities and bearing the faint doorway suggesting a potential passage.
His voice emerged.
"Utilize Parallel Processing of The Principle of the Cheating Architect.
Let me see... simulations of the different choices I can make from this juncture."
Prompts materialized immediately with technical specifications.
Due to complexity of scenarios and exponential potential possibilities:|
150 Primus Glyphs of the Cheating Architect will be required for comprehensive analysis]
This expenditure will provide high-quality phantom processes with accurate probabilities]
Confirm resource allocation?
Noah smiled and nodded while maintaining focus on the Justiciar Outpost.

"Confirmed. Show me the phantom process of entering the Justiciar Outpost, systematically eliminating the Justiciars while devouring their harvest and memories, then activating that doorway they believe would grant them entry to THE Loom."
"The second phantom process is...me taking my clone alongside Riya and other Members of my Civilization into the Desiccated Sleeping
Shore where Schrodinger's bodies may be concealed. Third, the possibility of following Goliath into the Wandering Territories to uncover mysteries surrounding the Collapsed Civilizations."

After stating these parameters, his body illuminated with blue-gold brilliance as his enhanced perception seemingly observed three distinct paths opening before him like diverging rivers of possibility. He focused on the first while prompts began echoing through his consciousness, accompanied by blue-gold illusory holographic manifestations that displayed events of that simulation with glorious clarity.
Phantom Process One- Justiciar Outpost Assault
Entry into the Justiciar Outpost would lead to utter systematic stomping of the Justiciars themselves
Their memories would be read and grasped through your Civilizational Authority
You would not discover anything substantial regarding Civilizations that you do not already possess
NOTABLE DISCOVERY:
Other Loom Outposts exist throughout external territories
These particular Justiciars possess limited knowledge of overall infrastructure-they have only maintained contact with one additional Outpost located in the Transcendent Emotive Folds]
That Outpost contains significantly more powerful Living Emotives with higher administrative clearance
CRITICAL EVENT - DOORWAY ACTIVATION:
When you approach the wall of THE Loom, the doorway shines with intensifying brilliance
It forcefully pulls both you and Khor into its spatial mechanism
You find yourselves transported to: SPECIALIZED EMOTIVE
CIVILIZATION BATTLEGROUNDS
This is a pocket dimension from which none can leave through normal means
A voice descends with deceptive instruction:
"The only pathway through is to experience the emotion of collapse with your own hands by collapsing the one beside you. When this emotion sits heavily within your existence, you shall gain passage."
This is a fucking lie
If one complies with this instruction, they will then be informed:
"You have collapsed the one thing dear to you, and there actually isn't anything on the other side. Now, you can feel the emotion of...
ORMORDNES
The doorway is a psychological trap designed by THE Living Emotive Its only purpose is to inflict emotional devastation through manufactured betrayal
Noah's gaze turned chilly as he expected bullshit from THE Living Emotive, but he simply didn't expect this level of bullshit. Mind you, this was something that it designed for its own people.

The utter depravity of these schemes. THE Living Emotive constructed that doorway specifically to make beings destroy under false promises of salvation. The Justiciars have been waiting for eons, believing they would eventually gain entry to THE Loom as reward for their service, and the entire time... it was designed to make them collapse each other while discovering there was never anything waiting on the other side...
Just... orchestrated despair. Emotional devastation as entertainment.
Disgusting.
He looked at the illusory phantom with an expression of disgust as he
moved on to another.
"Let me see the next one."

crystalline clarity once more

You take Riya's clone and other Members of your Civilization into the

discovered

Oh!

paragraphs: His eyes flashed with callous recognition as comprehension settled with bitter clarity.
Truly, his enemies did not plan on being fair.
And why should they, when they possessed such immense power at their disposal?
Even these Avatars mentioned in the parallel processing were likely an insignificant force that was deployed.
And yet these grunts alone were sufficient to suppress him and capture his clones.
They're not even taking me seriously yet as they don't know the Civilization I hold, and their casual response already overwhelms everything. If they deployed their actual strength...
The thought remained unfinished because the conclusion was too sobering to articulate!
Oh!
Existence was not easy!
With his eyes burning with blue-gold brilliance of determination rather than despair, he called out coldly.
"Let me see the last phantom processing."
The third phantom process began manifesting with equal clarity. Phantom Process Thre- Wandering Territories Exploration
You follow Goliath into The Wandering Territories, crossing through The Mobius Caverns- spatial shortcuts connecting distant territories| Destination is an Isolated Collapsed Civilization of Origin|
This represents remnants of Early Creatures and Living Origins
They were actually part of THE Primordial Civilization of Origin before systematic collapse
They survived the rampage of THE Living Paradox through careful concealment (Pure luck, and by the will of Paradox likely, leaving behind seeds to grow)
Initial Reception: Extreme distrust
Within that Collapsed Civilization, many entities observe your arrival with suspicion
Power levels range dramatically: dozens of Quintillions to hundreds of Quintillions
Collapsed Civilizations have hidden themselves in different areas of The Wandering Territories
These territories are FAR vaster than Transcendent Folds, offering superior concealment
All remnant Civilizations are waiting for forces of Paradox to appear
They know THE Loom nears initiation of The Fallout when the forces of Paradox appear
They plan to put up ONE LAST STAND against their destroyers
Problem- Those you encounter do not trust you whatsoever
Your unknown Primordial Civilization of Mana and Hunger confuses them
You are neither recognized ally nor confirmed enemy
They possess no framework for categorizing what you represent
Trust must be earned through actions rather than claimed through words

This... is the only decently good outcome I can currently pursue. These Isolated Collapsed Civilizations provide opportunity to discover much more regarding what remained from THE Living Paradox's systematic rampage. Their accumulated eons of survival knowledge could prove useful...

But more importantly: if they are planning a Last Stand against THE Living Paradox and his forces... how precisely did they know Paradox would appear? Or other forces from THE Loom? What information do they possess regarding timing and methodology?
And were their preparations over the eons sufficient enough to pose genuine threat? Did these Collapsed Civilizations cultivate entities in the Sextillions of power?
The questions and possibilities were abundant.
His eyes flashed with brilliant intensity as he contemplated all these cascading possibilities...each variable opening into dozens of potential advantages if navigated correctly.
He breathed out heavily as he looked at the Justiciar Outpost again, his words echoing out freely.

"My advancement is unbelievably fast compared to any normal cultivation trajectory, and the weight of the Civilizations I bear is genuinely mighty. I possess wonders that previous Primordial Civilizations never developed."

"But... the previous Primordial Civilizations continue to demonstrate just how ridiculously robust they are. They have been collecting passive benefits every single moment for eons beyond counting. Their accumulated total is staggering beyond easy quantification."
Beside him, Khor was blazing with hunger as she voiced out with heaviness.
"So what, Outsider?"
HUUM!
Noah's eyes blazed with tyrannical conviction.

"So what indee. My speed of progression simply needs to eclipse their massive accumulation of power! I need to be advancing so rapidly that even their eons of head start becomes proportionally insignificant. Efficiency must triumph over duration. Innovation must overwhelm tradition. Glorious innovation, glorious Cheats, glorious weavings of Infinity and Quintessence!"
He looked toward Khor.
"The Wandering Territories. Following Goliath. We will start there.

Leave the Justiciar Outpost alone for now. In The Wandering Territories, we gain allies, we gain intelligence, we gain time to continue growing while gathering forces that might actually prove useful when confrontation becomes inevitable."
His smile turned sharp as he stared at the Justiciar Outpost one final time, cataloguing every detail for future reference before turning away with decisive motion.
His voice echoed out to The First Hunger beside him with a tone of
anticipation.
"Let us witness the emergence of the Primus Inevitabilities of Mana
and Hunger."
Khor nodded with satisfaction and eager anticipation.
She would maintain this clone's presence here to keep continuous
surveillance on the Justiciar Outpost and its terrible wall, while her main body within The Infiniverse was prepared for the glorious event
about to unfold.
Noah materialized in the crimson-blue molten Mana region of collapse, his gaze immediately drawn to the grand massive Infiniverse floating serenely amidst churning seas of liquified authority.
Nearby, Riya's clone, floating alongside the bound Leonore Rureaux,
lit up with brilliant smile as she called out with enthusiasm. "Ancestor! Did you miss my presence around you already? I knew you
would find my absence unbearable!"
Noah looked toward her and actually nodded with a slight smile
touching his features.
This terrifyingly perceptive woman observed the subtle gesture and frowned as she immediately detected something.
"What's wrong, Ancestor?"
Noah looked over toward Leonore Rureaux as he replied.
"Simply a change of plans. We won't set off to locate the vessels of
THE Living Paradox just yet. Alternative priorities have emerged."
He then turned to directly address the figure of Leonore Rureaux, recalling the future of her collapse from the phantom process...how her presence had proven valuable until catastrophic intervention
rendered the entire operation devastating failure. His voice held the weight of opportunity.
"She is cleared to enter the Infiniverse as long as... she pledges fealty to my Civilization and accepts my authority over her advancement!"
He articulated such conditions calmly as Riya's eyes opened wide. She nudged the woman beside her with an encouraging gesture. "Hey, the Ancestor is offering you a genuine chance here. Paradox

itself abandoned you and extracted your lover from you through manipulation. This Ancestor here would be your only possible pathway to potentially reclaim what you lost. Come on, don't let pride prevent you from accepting salvation."
Leonore Rureaux's figure trembled slightly with mixture of emotions
as Noah waved his hand.
A brilliant Spark of his Way floated toward Leonore Rureaux with gentle luminescence, carrying essence of his Civilization's fundamental principles condensed into singular offering!

chapters.title: Chapter 4439 Infinite Hunger! IV
paragraphs: The glorious scene that unfolded carried the weight of a covenant being established.
Leonore Rureaux fell to her knees with surrender and determination!
She accepted the Spark as it descended toward her, biting her lips with internal struggle concluding in favor of acceptance.
Her figure began illuminating with gloriously blue Mana- pure essence of Noah's Civilization suffusing her existence and marking her as member of his Way!
Riya smiled at successful the conversion before looking toward Noah with characteristic playfulness:
"Ancestor, shall I get on my knees for you too? Perhaps in more... private circumstances?"
Noah raised his brows at this suggestion as this brilliant woman. seemed a bit parched. He had to provide her some water soon!
He responded with amusement and firm direction.
"Stop playing around. Join the others inside for a show soon, one you won't want to miss."

He waved his hand as brilliant blue-gold light wrapped around both women positioned before him, and they disappeared instantly- transported directly into The Infiniverse's interior to await the emergence of the Primus Inevitabilities of Mana and Hunger.
He then looked up at the grand structure before him as his playful smile faded, replaced by an expression of profound contemplation.
All surrounding crimson-blue molten Mana began flowing toward him with inexorable force as his body commenced enlarging in size with breathtaking velocity.
His form rapidly expanded beyond normal proportions, becoming
more than light years in diameter, then continuing growth until reaching scales measured in Gigaparsecs!
Ridiculously massive was an understatement.

The glorious scene defied conventional spatial understanding. Noah in his tremendous form, existence expanded to proportions that made galaxies seem like scattered dust, proceeded to float below the massive circular Infiniverse.
With movements of both practical purpose and symbolic weight, he positioned the colossal structure upon his neck and back, supporting its entirety through his expanded form.
Like the ancient mythological figure of an entity bearing a celestial sphere, Noah took the weight of his entire Civilization upon his shoulders!
HUUM!
His posture suggested the strain that was more philosophical than physical, the weight representing not mere mass but accumulated obligations and promises made to those dwelling within.
A prompt bloomed within his consciousness with a concerned tone.

Master, you don't need to perform such physical demonstration. You could miniaturize the Infiniverse and transport it with minimal expenditure. This seems...unnecessarily theatrical, though I'll admit the symbolism has certain gravitas.
Noah smiled at the prompt as he responded with a voice of reflective depth.

"I know I could employ simpler methodology. But this... I am feeling particularly contemplative at this moment. Do you comprehend what the stance I am taking as I hold up the Infiniverse truly represents?"
At such question, extensive prompts materialized with a heavy philosophical weight
The Atlas posture. Interesting choice for someone who usually
prefers efficiency over symbolism.|
This stance symbolizes responsibility, perseverance, and strength.|

An action like this represents far more than physical demonstration of power. It embodies the father persevering through hardship, doing everything necessary for his family's continuation. It represents the mother bearing weight of expectations while nurturing those dependent upon her. It symbolizes the daughter carrying forward legacy while forging new paths. It manifests the son shouldering responsibilities inherited from predecessors.
All existences carry some form of responsibility, burdens accepted or imposed. And they must persevere through difficulty. They must hold strong when circumstances demand surrender.

The Atlas does not simply carry weight. The Atlas chooses to carry weight when alternatives exist. That choice transforms burden into purpose. That choice transforms suffering into meaning. Through the weight carried, the bearer grows stronger through persistence.
Perseverance isn't the absence of struggle. Perseverance is continuation despite struggle. Strength isn't the absence of doubt. Strength is action despite uncertainty.

Every step taken while bearing burden represents triumph over despair. Every moment sustained represents victory over collapse. Though I should note...this level of introspection from you usually means you're processing a decision you're not entirely comfortable with.|
Noah smiled and nodded at such words as his voice emerged with contemplative depth.
"Yes, we have to be strong. Even when things feel overwhelmingly oppressive, even when it seems like existence itself conspires against us, we have to hold strong through sheer determination."
His gaze became distant.
"I know that I am a spectacular existence...someone who has advanced at velocity that defies normal probability. I know my Mana is ridiculous. My existence is ridiculous. I know."
"But
know to remind myself every now and then how I began like countless others across the folds, across existence..as just a man. Just a man with responsibilities. A son. Eventually a father. Someone
with people depending on him."
His expression softened slightly.
"And I continue to carry those responsibilities to this day. Every

choice I make affects not just myself but everyone within this structure I bear. And every now and then I find myself questioning whether I made the right decisions...whether alternative paths might have yielded better outcomes."
His voice carried weight of recent reflection.

"The most recent choice that occupied my contemplation was how things unfolded with The First Farmer. In my mind, someone who was actively conspiring to ruin my foundation and steal my Perpetual Harvest isn't someone I would simply lend helping hand to right after discovery. That was my thought and that was my conviction."
He paused.
"And so I did not lend that helping hand. I caught the thief stealing

from me as it may have not been the first time he stole, just the first time I caught him. But I could have gone another route. Given benefit of the doubt. Considered that perhaps his desperation stemmed from circumstances I hadn't fully comprehended."

"What an entity The First Farmer was. Someone capable of nurturing Principles themselves. He could have truly been great. Could have been magnificent ally rather than desperate enemy. Every now and then I'll find myself thinking about that choice, wondering if my judgment was too harsh, too absolute."
His expression hardened slightly.

"Whether all the choices I make are right or wrong, I won't know with surety until consequences fully manifest. I will only continue making choices that appear to benefit me and my people the most based on available information. Ah, perseverance, responsibility, and strength. One has to be strong to make the choices that could be right or wrong... and live with outcomes either way."
After articulating these words, Noah took single massive step and
moved light years away while carrying the colossal structure on his
back. He crossed the regions of collapse instantly, entering into the vast Wandering Territories with momentum.
These regions were much, much larger than the Minor Folds or even
the Transcendent Folds where Living Existences clustered. The Wandering Territories represented unexplored vastness that dwarfed all catalogued domains, places where beings could hide for
eons without discovery.
Since things were about to get significantly more complicated and considerably busier with multiple factions potentially converging, there was no harm in reducing exposure.

He followed the path of seeking out Collapsed Civilizations while simultaneously removing his primary assets from vulnerable positions. And so the glorious scene of a man carrying an utterly massive structure on his back could be observed by nobody...as he moved through territories so vast and empty that witnesses simply didn't exist. Those who did exist were unfathomably dangerous!
