"Whether all the choices I make are right or wrong, I won't know with surety until consequences fully manifest.
I will only continue making choices that appear to benefit me and my people the most based on available information.
Ah, perseverance, responsibility, and strength.
One has to be strong to make the choices that could be right or wrong... and live with outcomes either way."
After articulating these words, Noah took single massive step and
moved light years away while carrying the colossal structure on his
back.
He crossed the regions of collapse instantly, entering into the vast Wandering Territories with momentum.
These regions were much, much larger than the Minor Folds or even
the Transcendent Folds where Living Existences clustered.
The Wandering Territories represented unexplored vastness that dwarfed all catalogued domains, places where beings could hide for
eons without discovery.
Since things were about to get significantly more complicated and considerably busier with multiple factions potentially converging, there was no harm in reducing exposure.
He followed the path of seeking out Collapsed Civilizations while simultaneously removing his primary assets from vulnerable positions.

And so the glorious scene of a man carrying an utterly massive structure on his back could be observed by nobody...as he moved through territories so vast and empty that witnesses simply didn't exist.
Those who did exist were unfathomably dangerous!

chapters.title: Chapter 4440 Infinite Hunger! V
paragraphs: As he moved, he contemplated the Collapsed Civilization he would be seeking through Goliath's, he found his thoughts returning to THE Dead Order.
A portion of his existence could now communicate directly with her through Sigrid in that unique space where she was systematically siphoning Civilizational Authority.
She had mentioned being occupied with other matters on the other side of The Veil.
When one truly considered it strategically... would the other side, The Lands of The Dead, not be the location containing the largest number of Collapsed Civilizations?
Every being that ever perished across eons of existence... they reside there. Every Civilization that ever collapsed... remnants would naturally gravitate toward death's domain.
Was this one of THE Dead Order's primary objectives? To systematically unify all Collapsed Civilizations under her Order? To build army of remnants for her eventual confrontation?
Noah's eyes flashed sharply as he processed these implications, and he continued delving even deeper into the Wandering Territories with purposeful strides.
As he was doing so...
HUUUM!
His entire body began shining with resplendent blue-gold brilliance as powerful resonance cascaded through his existence!
Prompts materialized soon after.
Majesty has been sensed and is now descending.
Your Mana was directly and indirectly responsible for the emergence
of a Derivative Civilization of Existence in the hands of The Great Usurper. The influence of your Mana stretches far back through your extensive history with this entity.
Your Mana flows with interminable and heavy influence on a Civilization based upon THE Primordial Civilization of Existence itself.

Consequence: you will continue receiving substantial harvests for its emergence and continuing advancement. As The Great Usurper's Derivative Way expands, your proportional benefit increases accordingly. His Idle expansion across vast territories feeds into your Civilization through established connection.

The significance here shouldn't be understated. Your Mana has become foundational element in another being's Primordial-level Civilization. This creates permanent symbiotic relationship. You're essentially getting compound interest on someone else's expansion- not a bad investment, all things considered.

Noah felt the prompts blooming alongside sensation of utter glory as waves of Civilizational Authority crashed into his existence, flowing steadily into his Foundation Palisades with a force that made his entire being tremble with satisfaction.
He smiled as he felt the glorious walls of his Civilization continue advancing rapidly, each increment bringing him closer to thresholds that would unlock even greater capabilities.
His mind buzzed with anticipation as it looked forward to the moment these walls advanced sufficiently for him to escape the bounds of a Nascent Civilization.
For him to emerge as something truly capable of standing against the established Primordial Civilizations!
For now, he would continue taking his Civilization deeper into the Wandering Territories.
And inside The Infiniverse itself, he was about to initiate the
emergence of the glorious Primus Inevitabilities of Mana and Hunger- one million beings born daily with baseline power of 1 Quintillion each, all wielding Civilizational Authority as birthright.
The future was being forged with every step he took.
The Atlas continued bearing his burden through territories unknown.
And existence itself trembled with anticipation of what was being built.
Inside The Infiniverse, within the vast expanse of the Early Veiled Shore, Noah materialized upon the golden sands with a presence that immediately drew attention from all those already assembled.
He sensed many of his people waiting on those radiant golden
sands...familiar presences mixed with new arrivals.
Among those gathered were the beings he had always had here...Sigrid, Henry, Adelaide, Barbatos, Malphas, The Queen of Matter, Emperor Penguin, and numerous others.
Their presences radiated with recently elevated power, each bearing the Mark of the Minor Mana and Hunger Palisades that continued elevating their baseline capabilities.
In addition to these familiar figures, the members of the Isolated Civilization of Mana had also arrived.
Kael and the Seed Members of that ancient framework were already present, having begun constructing a grand structure designed to hold and organize Mana Glyphs and Mana Arcana Glyphs.
Riya could also be seen actively and busily talking to everyone present...her natural charisma and commanding presence drawing attention wherever she moved.
When Noah appeared on the golden sands, her eyes lit up.
She naturally floated toward him with grace.
"Ancestor, your other Civilization is genuinely brilliant. Although I
would absolutely love to have your own personal introduction to your
family members here."
Her eyes gleamed.
"It seems there exists an established hierarchy among your people,
and I really need to establish myself near the top of it...
Her figure radiated with cultivated beauty. Arcs of blue-gold authority swirled around her form like loyal attendants, each current responding to her slightest gesture with immediate obedience.
With her striking features, sharp tongue, and that dangerous smile of schemes within schemes, she looked absolutely appetizing!
Noah patted her head with affection and gentle correction.
"Patience. The hierarchy will sort itself naturally. Focus on what's
about to occur."
At this time, Khor arrived beside him with silent footsteps that belied
her considerable power.
She observed Riya calmly.
"You brought the annoyingly talkative one here as well? I had hoped
for some measure of peace during this significant moment." At such words, Riya's eyes flashed with blue fire as her response emerged with honey-sweet venom.

"Oh? Is this the supposedly old and wise woman I've just learned is The First Hunger speaking? Ancient, certainly, that much is obvious. But I don't really see much evidence of the wise part in what I've seen
so far.."
BOOM!
Khor turned around with eyes blazing crimson as she smiled.
"Supposed Prodigy of Mana, have you actually observed the other women here the Outsider spends meaningful time with? Their chests alone are larger than half of your entire figure. Perhaps you should
focus on developing substance rather than running that mouth
incessantly."
Riya laughed with a sound mixing genuine amusement and dangerous promise as she replied with unshaken confidence.
"Old Hunger, I won't be changing a single thing about myself. I am an
aesthetic choice for those with refined taste. The Ancestor clearly
appreciates all varieties..."
The two of them seemed ready to continue their verbal sparring
indefinitely.
But Noah shook his head with a gesture mixing amusement and
exasperation.
"Come on now, enough of that. We have genuinely important work to
accomplish. Let's get started."

chapters.title: Chapter 4441 Infinite Hunger! VI
paragraphs: With such words of finality, Khor harrumphed and turned around.
She looked out at the distant golden sands of the Early Veiled Shore that stretched like vast continent toward horizons that seemed to extend infinitely.
Noah knelt down with deliberate motion and placed his palm flat against the golden sands.
His voice emerged with the weight of authority being invoked. "Forge the Resplendent Sanctuaries of Inevitabilities."
HUUM!
The vast golden sands surrounding them trembled with immediate response to his command.
From both Noah and Khor simultaneously, waves of obsidian-blue authority erupted outward like endless seas being released from containment.
The authority painted the golden sands with new colors, transforming their fundamental nature through the concentrated application of Civilizational power.
A moment later, the area of the Early Veiled Shore directly before them began altering and changing with breathtaking velocity.
Obsidian crystalline formations erupted from beneath the sands, the entire region transforming into solidified obsidian-blue crystals that stretched vast and wide.
A massive continent formed and continued stretching outward with seemingly infinite expansion, the crystalline surface eventually forging above the Early Sacred Waters themselves!
Prompts bloomed within Noah's consciousness.
The Resplendent Sanctuaries are manifesting according to

architectural specifications. The Primus Inevitabilities of Mana and Hunger will commence forging from concentrated Civilizational Authority- the synthesized essence of Mana and Hunger operating in symbiotic harmony.

These entities require extraordinarily dense concentration of authority alongside substantial quantity. Most Civilizations would expend considerable resources producing even modest numbers within reasonable timeframes. Your possession of Infinite Primus Mana renders such constraints irrelevant.

Initial production parameters: 41,666 Inevitabilities per hour, yielding 1 Million Primus Inevitabilities of Mana and Hunger within 24 hours. Each unit will possess minimum baseline of 1 Quintillion Complexity and Purity with innate capability to wield Civilizational Authority.
Noah smiled at these prompts as he rose to observe the glorious construction unfolding before him.
He witnessed the endless expanse of obsidian-blue crystals spreading toward distant horizons, their surfaces catching ambient light and refracting it into countless prismatic displays.
From the smooth crystalline ground, massively tall towers began rising with architectural elegance, each one perfectly positioned.
Between these towers, potent singularities began
manifesting...spherical concentrations of creative potential shining obsidian-blue with distinct hint of gold at their very centers.
Exactly 41,666 of these massive singularities began blooming across the Sanctuaries of Inevitabilities simultaneously, each one representing birth-chamber for a new member of his Civilization.
But as this magnificent construction progressed...
Noah's body pulsed unexpectedly as brilliant golden light and brilliant green-gold light flashed independently within his existence.
Two of his Principles were activating simultaneously without his direct command.
Prompts bloomed with analytical clarity!
The Principle of the Cheating Architect and the Principle of
Perpetual Harvest have independently committed 80% of their current Primus Mana Glyphs toward achieving temporal compression of population expansion.
Their objective: proliferating multiple days worth of Primus Inevitability production within compressed timeframe. Both Principles are demonstrating considerable initiative regarding this
emergence.]
BOOM!
Above Noah, an eruption of glorious Glyphs manifested visibly...hundreds of concentrated authority-constructs orbiting around him like celestial bodies acknowledging their sun.
He looked upward with shining eyes to observe the immense light of his Singularity Principles bathing everything before him in
concentrated radiance.
The Glyphs descended upon the Sanctuary with purposeful direction, each one finding optimal position to maximize their collective effect.
In the next moment, additional prompts materialized with gravitas
befitting their content!

Effort has been collected systematically from across existence over recent hours. The effort invested in the emergence of your Primordial Civilizations. The effort contributing to another Primordial Civilization's advancement through Eckert's progression. The accumulated effort of The First Farmer's collapsed existence.

Additionally: the effort of adversarial forces plotting against you in The Lands of The Dead, The Lands of The Living, and THE Loom itself. Perpetual Harvest has proven remarkably indiscriminate in its collection methodology.
All this Quintessential Harvest is being applied to this moment. The irony of enemies' efforts fueling your advancement should not be lost
on you.
Around Noah, an even grander sea of green-gold brilliance erupted with overwhelming intensity.
The light washed over the obsidian-blue crystalline surface of the Sanctuaries like tide of pure potential, transforming everything it
touched.
His eyes became covered by the brilliant hues of green and blue merging together, and reflected in his vision, he witnessed something that transcended his initial expectations.
No longer did he see mere thousands of singularities representing emergence of 41,666 Inevitabilities.
Instead, he saw a few hundreds of thousand of these glorious singularities beginning to bloom every passing second...the crystalline
Sanctuary rapidly filling with birth-chambers that multiplied
exponentially.
Prompts emerged with utter glory!
Production parameters have been modified. Due to combined contributions from the Cheating Architect and Perpetual Harvest, the generation of Primus Inevitabilities of Mana and Hunger has been
multiplied by factor of 10.]
Correspondingly, the baseline power of these First Generation Primus Inevitabilities has increased by identical factor. Each unit will
now possess 10 Quintillion Complexity and Purity rather than
standard 1 Quintillion.
Revised production target: 10 Million within 24 hours. Your Principles appear committed to making this emergence noteworthy.
BOOM!
Oh!
Oh!!!
Noah felt eruption of such terrifying brilliance cascading through his existence as the numbers recalculated themselves.
Ten million Inevitabilities to be produced within the next twenty-four hours, each one possessing ten times the originally planned power.
Oh!
This was Perpetual Harvest expressing its true nature.
Right. Perpetual Harvest.
The thing The First Farmer had wanted most desperately...the Principle he had conspired and plotted to reclaim despite knowing it
would betray someone who had helped him.
The thing that even THE Creature had held and shaken his head with
regret that it didn't bloom properly.

THE Creature himself had acknowledged it was a truly terrifying tool for the forging of Civilizations...something that could transform effort into exponential growth regardless of source or intention.
It seemed to truly be expressing itself fully at this moment as-
BOOM! Even before Noah's thoughts could complete their trajectory, another explosion of authority erupted within him.
Around him and covering the obsidian-blue crystalline Sanctuary, a
potent and extremely concentrated sea of harvest bloomed to fruition
and covered absolutely everything with green-gold radiance.
Prompts manifested with weight that demanded attention.

Perpetual Harvest has identified additional harvest source of considerable magnitude. It is currently collecting the effort represented by the Pain and endless turmoil of all Inevitabilities in Existence whose Hunger has been mutated and defiled.
These beings exist in constant state of agonized appetite across the
Walls of THE Loom. Their suffering, the excruciating sensation of hunger that can never be satisfied- is being converted into harvest for
this emergence.
The suffering of the corrupted becomes foundation for the
uncorrupted. One might call it poetic justice, though that seems
insufficient descriptor.
Noah observed these prompts with genuine astonishment, and beside him, Khor seemed capable of witnessing identical information through their shared connection to Hunger's Civilization.
Her figure trembled violently while tears began forming on the rims of
her crimson eyes.

All the pain and endless turmoil that countless Inevitabilities felt at this very moment...beings who had their fundamental nature corrupted and twisted by THE Living Paradox's machinations. Due to Noah's intricate connection with The First Hunger and how she remained connected to all these suffering Inevitabilities... Perpetual Harvest actually harvested the effort of their excruciating
sensation.
The agony of never being able to satisfy their hunger as they devoured and devoured endlessly, only to give everything they obtained to THE Loom without respite.
It took all of this accumulated effort as the result manifested before
them... Additional prompts emerged with implications that resonated deeply!

Perpetual Harvest has extended its collection parameters. It is now Recursively harvesting all pain accumulated across countless eons by all distorted Mutated Inevitabilities. Not merely current suffering, but historical torment aggregated across incomprehensible duration.[
The effort of all their pain and hunger is being harvested and
directed toward this emergence. Consequently, all production parameters have been amplified by factor of 10 once more./
Your Principle demonstrates rather impressive commitment to
maximizing this particular moment.
"Oh, fuck..."
Noah couldn't help but curse with utter astonishment.
Khor's legs gave out completely as she collapsed to the crystalline
ground.
Tears fell freely from her crimson eyes as she felt all the accumulated

pain and hunger of her tormented people being transformed into harvest! All their efforts...their suffering, their agony, their endless hunger that could never be satisfied, all of it was being turned into foundation that infused itself to form more of her Civilization! The prompt that manifested next carried weight of finality.

Due to accumulated harvest of unprecedented magnitude, revised parameters are as follows: 100 Million Primus Inevitabilities of Mana and Hunger will be produced within 24 hours, just for these next 24
hours. Each First Generation Primus Inevitability will possess 100 Quintillion Complexity and Purity at baseline.
One hundred million beings. Each formidable threat. Born within this
single day. Wielding Civilizational Authority as birthright.|
The existential implications are considerable.
Noah had no words adequate to express what he felt.
His Mana buzzed with intensity that made his entire existence
tremble.
His framework felt like it was being squeezed...as if Infinite Primus
Mana was genuinely being put to the test and asked the fundamental
question: Can you really provide the Mana for all this? Can you sustain production on this scale?
And his Existence cried out in response and began to give.
And it gave without hesitation. And it gave without reservation.
And in front of him, millions of massive obsidian-blue-and-gold singularities bloomed with breathtaking velocity as something utterly terrifying erupted under the brilliance of concentrated harvest.
In this glorious silence of utter shock and stupefaction, where even

Riya stood with mouth slightly open and eyes wide, pivotal prompts flashed before everyone present in the Early Veiled Shore. The Primordial Civilization of Hunger was a Civilization defined with clarity exceeding even THE Primordial Civilization of Existence itself. Mana existed alongside it from the earliest moments. Hunger was present even before THE Living Existences came together with THE Creature. Hunger has been present.
Hunger has been present.
Mana has been present. Mana has been present.

Hunger and Mana existed in glorious expression, fundamental principles driving all advancement and enabling all growth. Let true Hunger bloom once more without corruption. Let Mana feed it into fruition without limitation.
What was collapsed will rise. What was defiled will be purified. What
was stolen will be reclaimed.[
BOOM!

Khor's legs gave out completely as she collapsed to the crystalline
ground.
Tears fell freely from her crimson eyes as she felt all the accumulated
pain and hunger of her tormented people being transformed into harvest!
All their efforts...their suffering, their agony, their endless hunger that could never be satisfied, all of it was being turned into foundation that infused itself to form more of her Civilization!
The prompt that manifested next carried weight of finality.

Due to accumulated harvest of unprecedented magnitude, revised parameters are as follows: 100 Million Primus Inevitabilities of Mana and Hunger will be produced within 24 hours, just for these next 24
hours.
Each First Generation Primus Inevitability will possess 100 Quintillion Complexity and Purity at baseline.
One hundred million beings.
Each formidable threat.
Born within this
single day.
Wielding Civilizational Authority as birthright.|
The existential implications are considerable.
Noah had no words adequate to express what he felt.
His Mana buzzed with intensity that made his entire existence
tremble.
His framework felt like it was being squeezed...as if Infinite Primus
Mana was genuinely being put to the test and asked the fundamental
question: Can you really provide the Mana for all this?
Can you sustain production on this scale?
And his Existence cried out in response and began to give.
And it gave without hesitation.
And it gave without reservation.
And in front of him, millions of massive obsidian-blue-and-gold singularities bloomed with breathtaking velocity as something utterly terrifying erupted under the brilliance of concentrated harvest.
In this glorious silence of utter shock and stupefaction, where even
Riya stood with mouth slightly open and eyes wide, pivotal prompts flashed before everyone present in the Early Veiled Shore.
The Primordial Civilization of Hunger was a Civilization defined with clarity exceeding even THE Primordial Civilization of Existence itself.
Mana existed alongside it from the earliest moments.
Hunger was present even before THE Living Existences came together with THE Creature.
Hunger has been present.
Hunger has been present.
Mana has been present.
Mana has been present.
Hunger and Mana existed in glorious expression, fundamental principles driving all advancement and enabling all growth.
Let true Hunger bloom once more without corruption.
Let Mana feed it into fruition without limitation.
What was collapsed will rise.
What was defiled will be purified.
What
was stolen will be reclaimed.[
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4442 Infinite Hunger! VII
paragraphs: The endless skies of the Early Veiled Shore were painted with auroras of green, gold, and blue stretching infinitely.
They were celestial lights dancing in patterns that suggested existence itself was celebrating what was about to unfold!
Noah and Khor stood at the junction between golden sands and the obsidian-blue crystalline continent that now bore millions of singularities blooming with concentrated potential.

Each singularity pulsed with rhythmic intensity, preparing to birth entities that could potentially be the first of the many signs of a Civilization that would reshape the balance of power across Observable Existence!

In the distant skies above, Ozymandias could be seen floating grandly...his massive humanoid form shining with countless blue-gold Primus Mana Glyphs that orbited him like loyal subjects attending their sovereign.
He looked utterly dominating, an avatar of accumulated Hunger refined through systematic cultivation.
At such a time.

At such a pivotal moment when it was decreed that 100 Million Primus Inevitabilities of Mana and Hunger would be formed, each one possessing 100 Quintillion Complexity and Purity at baseline, Noah's figure rose upward and began floating as he looked at the vast expanse before him with calculating eyes.
His Principles had gone all out. Perpetual Harvest had exceeded every expectation and accomplished feats that transcended what one could. even fathom.
The Cheating Architect had contributed substantially.
Other components of him had done much to ensure this emergence's
success.
What about himself? What would he contribute to this moment?
At this juncture, his figure shone with interminable glory as he proceeded to raise his hand slowly.
He allowed it to fall with deliberate motion while echoing out gloriously, his eyes releasing beams of blue gold Primus Mana that covered the areas he gazed at!

"Mana is the immensity of existence itself. All Matter, Antimatter, Dark Matter... life and energy simply originate from Mana at their most fundamental level. I hold an infinite amount of Primus Mana within my existence...a truth that defines my very existence!"
HUUM!
His voice remained calm and unshakably composed, heavy with authority.

"For the emergence of the Blades and Shields of My Primordial Civilization of Mana and Hunger... I shall impose upon this birth the Infinite Quality of my existence. The Infinite Quality of my Mana shall be woven into their fundamental architecture!"
BOOM!
His eyes blazed with conviction!
"If possible, from this emerging Hunger, let there be... Infinite Hunger."
His words were terrifyingly heavy. Far too heavy!
They carried weight that made surrounding existence tremble in recognition of what was being attempted!
In the next moment, Noah's entire existence and the distant Ozymandias above unleashed endless waves of blue-gold Primus Mana onto the lands below.
From both of them simultaneously, Civilizational Authority of Mana and Hunger descended like judgment being rendered!
Civilizational Authority.
This type of authority was unfathomably grand...representing the concentrated essence of what a Civilization truly stood for at its core.
At this moment, very few within Noah's own framework actually held such authority.
To truly and fully embody and express it without feeling immense weight crushing one's existence, it seemed like a minimum requirement was 100 Quintillion Complexity and Purity.
It was a heavy authority that genuinely represented what the Civilization stood for...its principles, its aspirations, its fundamental nature given tangible form.
And at this moment, Noah allowed his existence to actively impose his Civilizational Authority onto the emergence before him with focused intent.
Prompts bloomed with weight!
A glimpse of the Infinite quality of your Mana has been successfully applied to Hunger. This represents unprecedented fusion of
conceptual frameworks.

Waves of Civilizational Authority of Mana and Hunger are being utilized as catalytic agent. A portion of the incoming harvest from Existential Communication and Permeation has been diverted from your Foundation Palisades and redirected into this emergence.

Your Mana and your Hunger are inexplicably and irreversibly linked across all of existence from this moment forward. The quality of infinity inherent to your Mana is being shared, even if by fraction, with your Hunger.
Infinite Hunger rises.]
A glorious Hunger that carries a distinct shred of the quality of

infinity within its fundamental architecture. All Primus Inevitabilities of Mana and Hunger shall carry this Infinite Hunger as birthright, they can hunger and hunger endlessly, devour and devour endlessly on Everything for growth.
Everything becomes sustenance. Everything becomes fuel for advancement. There exists no satiation point, no moment of satisfaction that halts progression. Only eternal appetite driving
eternal growth.
BOOM!
After such prompts settled into reality, the few million singularities on
the ground below pulsed and began rotating with accelerating
velocity.
An emergence commenced with force that made the crystalline continent tremble.
The auras of utterly terrifying entities began rising from the singularities like souls ascending from primordial depths.
Tentacles bloomed first...countless appendages of concentrated Mana and Hunger that writhed and coiled as they formed humanoid
entities.
These beings seemed to be constructed from countless and infinite tentacles of intertwined authority, each tendril carrying both
principles in perfect synthesis.
Prompts manifested once more!

The Blades and Shields of The Primordial Civilization of Mana and Hunger are rising. Designation confirmed: protectors and weapons simultaneously, defensive and offensive capabilities unified in singular
form.
Comprehensive specifications of Primus Inevitabilities of Mana and
Hunger:|
Baseline Power: 100 Quintillion Complexity and Purity minimum.]
Inherent Capability: Born with Infinite Hunger as fundamental characteristic. No satiation threshold exists. All matter, energy, authority, and concepts can be devoured for growth without
limitation.

Unique Function - Hunger and Mana Symbiosis: These entities carry capability to fuse with other Members of your Civilization, becoming Hunger-Born Inevitability Civilizational Armor. This fusion combines the power of both participants, creating a synthesized combat form that exceeds simple addition of capabilities.
Core Abilities:
-Mana Consumption Acceleration: Can devour raw Mana from environment to rapidly regenerate and amplify their own power.
Recovery time becomes functionally instantaneous when sufficient Mana is available.
-Hunger Propagation: Can temporarily impose their Infinite Hunger onto enemies, causing targeted beings to experience uncontrollable appetite that consumes their own power reserves from within.

|-Civilizational Resonance: When multiple Primus Inevitabilities operate in proximity, their Civilizational Authority harmonizes and amplifies, creating zone of enhanced effectiveness that grows exponentially with numbers present.

-Void Appetite: Can consume abstract concepts including damage dealt to them, converting offensive actions into fuel for their growth. Attacks that don't exceed their baseline power are simply devoured rather than causing harm.
-Infinite Recursion: Their Hunger operates on recursive loop, they
hunger to grow stronger, and growing stronger increases their hunger, creating perpetual advancement cycle without ceiling.

chapters.title: Chapter 4443 Infinite Hunger! VIII
paragraphs: Floating far above, Noah observed such prompts as his eyes only shone brighter with satisfaction.
He watched the emergence of utter glory unfolding below with an expression of pride and anticipation.
The process that should have required full hour for all few million to complete their formation occurred instantly...the temporal
compression from Perpetual Harvest and Cheating Architect ensuring no wasteful delays.
The humanoid forms of the Primus Inevitabilities of Mana and Hunger took shape with terrifying beauty.
They appeared as massive titanic humanoids with obsidian-blue tentacled skin, their entire bodies lined by ancient and glorious golden tentacle glyphs that pulsed with inner light.
Wings composed of golden tentacles fanned out behind them like banners of authority.
They looked like imposing figures made of roiling, sinewy
blue-obsidian tendrils...possessing the overall humanoid shape, but distinctly monstrous and alien in execution.
Each face was humanoid yet predatory and animalistic, and their eyes shone with crimson intensity that spoke of Infinite Hunger burning within.
They appeared one by one, their emergence causing existence itself to tremble all around as each one radiated utterly terrifying and imposing air of concentrated power.
The crystalline ground cracked beneath their feet as reality strained to accommodate their presence.
The moment their bodies finished forming, they moved with synchronized precision, gloriously kneeling toward Noah,
Ozymandias, and Khor with gestures of absolute submission and devotion.
Their booming words began ringing out with heavy voices that echoed across the Early Veiled Shore.

"We are born of Infinite Mana and Infinite Hunger. We are the Blades forged in the crucible of your Civilization's emergence! Our existence is dedicated to the protection and advancement of the Primordial framework that birthed us!"
HUUM!
The first formed Primus Inevitability spoke these words, and others joined him as they repeated identical proclamation. Their voices merged into chorus of absolute loyalty!

"We swear upon the Infinite quality of our Hunger that we shall devour all obstacles that stand before our Civilization! We shall consume every threat, every enemy, every impediment to your ascension! Our appetite knows no bounds, for we carry the gift of endless growth within our fundamental architecture!"
More voices joined, creating thunderous declaration!

"We are the shields that shall absorb all damage dealt to our Civilization! We are the armor that shall protect our sovereign's existence! We are the weapons that shall carve pathways through hostile territories! Our loyalty is absolute! Our hunger is infinite! Our purpose is singular- the triumph of Mana and Hunger across all of existence!"
The vows continued!

"We pledge our existence to the Primordial Civilization of Mana and Hunger. We pledge our Infinite Hunger to fuel its advancement. We pledge our capabilities to serve as instruments of your will! Command us, and we shall obey without hesitation! Direct us, and we shall execute without failure! We are your extension, your manifestation, your army born of Civilizational Authority!"
The final declaration rang out with weight that made even the distant auroras pulse in response.
"For the Infinite Light of Mana! For the Endless Hunger that drives all growth! We stand ready to serve!"
The scene was utterly magnificent...millions of titanic beings kneeling in perfect synchronization, their crimson eyes fixed upon Noah, Ozymandias, and Khor with devotion.
Noah descended slowly toward the first one to emerge...the entity whose voice had initiated the chorus of vows.
He landed before this being with expression mixing curiosity and
glory.
"What is your name?" Noah asked.
All the chants and vows ceased immediately the moment Noah spoke, as if his words carried priority that overrode all other considerations.
The first Primus Inevitability responded with a voice carrying absolute certainty!
"I am merely your loyal blade. Your extension. Your instrument of Infinite Hunger. I am Protos, the First of this generation, born to serve the Primordial Civilization that granted me existence."
HUUM!
Noah nodded at such designation as his words emerged with weight of honor being bestowed:
"Then Protos, you shall have the honor to become my shield, my
armor, my blade. You shall be the first to demonstrate the Hunger and Mana Symbiosis that defines your generation."
Protos knelt even lower with a gesture mixing profound gratitude and solemn acceptance!
His voice emerged with a formal precision that carried the weight of a sacred oath!

"Master of Infinite Primus Mana and Hunger, I understand that I am unworthy of such distinction. Yet I shall do all within my capabilities to protect the infinite light of The Primordial Civilization! My hunger shall be your hunger. My strength shall be your shield. My existence shall be your armor. This, I swear upon the Infinite quality that burns within my fundamental architecture."
At such words, Noah's body flashed with brilliant light as his Mana-Born Existential Armor adorned him. The armor pulsed with recognition of what was about to occur.

His hand reached out toward Protos, and the Primus Inevitability also reached out with sense of fervor that transcended simple obedience! Protos's humanoid body began transforming...his form dissolving into countless tentacles that began fusing themselves into Noah's existing
armor.

The tentacles wove through the Mana-Born Existential Armor with precision of perfect compatibility. Obsidian-blue merged with existing golden-blue framework, creating synthesis that exceeded what either possessed individually.

As such glorious scene began unfolding before all observers, Noah turned to address his people watching in utter astonishment. Riya's eyes were wide with barely contained excitement. Kael and the Seed Members observed with analytical focus.
Henry, Adelaide, Barbatos, and others looked upon the scene with expressions mixing awe and anticipation.
Noah's grand words rang out across the Early Veiled Shore. "The shields and blades of our Civilization have been formed. One
hundred million Primus Inevitabilities of Mana and Hunger shall
emerge within the next day...each one carrying Infinite Hunger as their birthright, each one capable of fusing with members of our Civilization to create weavings of unprecedented power."
His voice intensified.
"Every single one of you can fuse with them and walk together on a

path of Infinite Mana and Hunger. You shall wear them as your protection. You shall wield them as your weapons. You shall advance together as symbiotic pairs, your growth fueling theirs, their hunger amplifying yours."
His eyes blazed with tyrannical satisfaction.
"This... is what it means to belong to a Primordial Civilization. To My

Primordial Civilization! This is the advantage we shall wield against those who stand against us. Let them come with their accumulated power spanning eons. Let them come with their established frameworks and ancient authorities. We shall meet them with Infinite Hunger, with Infinite Mana, and we shall
devour their advantages until nothing remains but our triumph!"
BOOM!
The Early Veiled Shore trembled with the weight of declaration as around Noah, the fusion with Protos completed itself.
His armor now carried characteristics of both his original framework and the Primus Inevitability...tentacles woven throughout the structure, golden glyphs pulsing alongside obsidian-blue crystalline
formations.

He could feel Protos's consciousness flowing over his body like a shield! And behind him, millions more Primus Inevitabilities continued kneeling, waiting for their own chance to serve their Civilization.
The shields had been forged.
The blades had been sharpened.
And existence itself trembled as on this day, something grand was
completed!

chapters.title: Chapter 4444 Civilization Expansion! I
paragraphs: 4,166,666 Primus Inevitabilities of Mana and Hunger.
This was the scene and the reality that many were looking at this very moment, and it felt absolutely surreal!
It was as if existence itself had decided to bend its rules specifically to accommodate what should have been impossible.
Because every single one of these entities held 100 Quintillion Complexity and Purity at their baseline.
Every single one of these entities flowed with Civilizational Authority of Mana and Hunger as birthright!
Noah's figure stood at the forefront of this magnificent army, currently fused with Protos in a symbiotic state that transformed his appearance into something transcendent.
He looked like a titanic armored entity shining with gold-blue, obsidian, and crimson radiance that made surrounding existence acknowledge his presence.
The armor itself was a masterwork of Civilizational engineering...sleek yet impossibly durable, with angular plates that suggested both mobility and absolute protection.

The surface displayed intricate patterns where obsidian-blue tentacle-glyphs wove through golden framework, creating visual language that spoke of two Primordial Civilizations unified in singular purpose.

One hand gripped an exquisite crimson-blue blade that was deliberately hollow at its center, and within that hollow space, millions of spinning Primordial Fireballs rotated with controlled violence....each one capable of devastating territories if released.
The other hand bore an obsidian-gold shield whose surface was inscribed with countless Primus Mana Arcana Glyphs that pulsed with
concentrated authority.
The blue-gold helmet covered his features completely while a spinning crystalline crimson crown floated above it...a symbol of his sovereignty over this emerging force.

His eyes were hidden behind a visor that pulsed with crimson light, giving him appearance of something beyond mortal or even Early Creature.. something that existed at intersection of multiple glorious principles.
In such grand armored state, he looked upon the Primus Inevitabilities of Mana and Hunger who gazed back at him with eyes that seemingly sought to be told what needed to be done.
Their posture suggested they would execute any command without hesitation, without question, with absolute dedication.
Noah had been planning to lay low temporarily as he accumulated his power...allowing the Foundation Palisades to grow while avoiding direct confrontation.
But when he looked at this terrifying portion of power that was about to bloom fully soon...when he truly grasped what the emergence of Infinite Hunger meant...
Oh!
It called for changes of plans regarding many things.
He had talked and talked and talked about how grand his Primordial Civilization was compared to those that had been actively enjoying boons for the past eons.
Now it was truly time for him to act and put this grand Civilization to practical use.
He turned to look at his people, all assembled on the junction between golden sands and crystalline continent, as his grand voice emerged with a magisterial commanding authority.
"All of you. Step forward. As of today, there shall be none within the

Early Veiled Shore that will exhibit less than 100 Quintillion Complexity and Purity. Fuse with a Primus Inevitability, let them be your blades and shields, and let us advance our Civilization together as unified force."
The words reverberated outward like undeniable command that transcended simple authority, yet none here even required
commanding!
In the next instant, figures began stepping forward with expressions mixing eagerness and solemn recognition of what they were about to undertake.
Riya moved with grace, her eyes gleaming with anticipation as she approached the kneeling ranks.
Henry stepped forward with shining eyes.
Barbatos floated forth with devilish smile. Sigrid surrounded by her aura of Order advanced with measured steps!
Moiraine, Titano, The Blue Slime, The Emperor Penguin, Kazuhiko, and even Little Bobby...all stepped forward to claim their Civilizational
Armor.

The Primus Inevitabilities moved with sequential precision like armies trained across eons rather than beings born mere moments ago. They knelt before all those approaching with gestures mixing respect and eager anticipation, each one waiting to be chosen, to fulfill their
purpose!
Sigrid, surrounded by white Order that harmonized with the
obsidian-blue of Hunger, appeared near Noah and Khor with
deliberate motion.
Her hand reached out toward a Primus Inevitability who instantly
arose from its kneeling position.
The entity's voice emerged a declaration.
"It shall be my honor to serve as your blade and shield, bearer of Order. My Infinite Hunger shall protect your light."
HUUM!

Its tentacles extended toward Sigrid's body and began forming glorious armor that shone obsidian-blue-and-gold similar to Noah's own...though slightly smaller in scale, maintaining her elegant figure while providing protection.
Arch Lich Ra'zan and the Primordial Ape stepped forward simultaneously, their Legions also selecting Primus Inevitabilities with careful consideration.
As each inevitability was chosen, they all rose from kneeling positions and declared with unified voices!
"It would be our honor to serve the Primordial Civilization!"
The symbiotic relationships formed rapidly...tentacles weaving through existing frameworks, creating armored states that pulsed
with combined authority.

All those present gradually became adorned with Civilizational Armor that marked them as true members of Noah's weavings! Even Leonore Rureaux who had just joined through pledging fealty found herself approached by a Primus Inevitability who knelt before her with same respect shown to original members.
Her existence became adorned in this grand Civilizational Armor, the transformation marking her official integration into the Primordial Civilization of Mana and Hunger.
Khor looked at all of this unfolding with heavy emotions.
She floated alongside the few million Primus Inevitabilities who had not yet been chosen, and they all extended their hands, forming tentacles just to touch her outstretched hands.
Just to feel the touch of The First Hunger herself!
As she passed through their ranks with tears forming at corners of
her crimson eyes, they began calling out with voices that resonated across the entire Early Veiled Shore.
"O First Hunger! Hunger that drives all growth! We stand ready to serve! Our Infinite Hunger is your Infinite Hunger! Our existence is dedicated to the restoration what was stolen
you!"
WAA!
Their voices were resonant with devotion!
When she heard them, when she felt their hands reaching out to
touch her existence with reverence, Khor was overwhelmed by emotion that she had suppressed for eons.
She laughed with tears flowing freely, the sound mixing joy and grief
and vindication all together!
Her gaze momentarily turned to look at Noah's grand armored figure,
seeing his crimson visor-covered eyes gazing back at her with silent acknowledgment.
"Thank you, Outsider," she said.
"Thank you for giving my people a chance to exist without corruption.
Thank you for giving them Infinite Hunger that does not pain or
torment them."

chapters.title: Chapter 4445 Civilization Expansion! II
paragraphs: Noah waved his hand with a gesture that said this was simply just the beginning...that gratitude was premature when so much more remained to be accomplished.
And it truly was only the beginning.
He looked around and observed how many within his Early Veiled Shore continued to come forward and choose Primus Inevitabilities to become their blades and shields.
Even his mother, Amelia Osmont, came forward and selected a Primus inevitability as her body became covered by this glorious and terrifying Civilizational Armor.
Noah continued gazing at this glorious process with analytical focus.
When one truly stopped to contemplate it, what exactly did this moment in time mean for him based on his pure power alone and his Civilization's capabilities?
One might look at this astonishing phenomenon today and think: Oh, it's simply another elevation or power up in his arsenal. Another impressive achievement to add to his growing list.
But at this point in time, it actually marked terrifying and significant change.
For the first time in quite some time, and for the first time in the history of his Civilization, he gained what seemed to be overwhelming power!
And it was overwhelming in a way that many would only later come to understand!
To truly understand this significance, take into account just if any force had one million entities each at 100 Quintillion across the Transcendent Folds.
It did not exist.
Such a force did exist inside of THE Loom, but that was that grand place filled with multiple Primordial Civilizations that had been accumulating power across eons.
Outside that secured domain, no comparable force existed anywhere in Observable Existence.

Even if he was wrong and the Wandering Territories that held Collapsed Civilizations possessed significant numbers... he highly doubted they even held a few hundred thousand or even a few thousands that were at 100 Quintillion or higher.
The possible path with Goliath had shown thst he would meet a few at dozens of Quintillion and other at a few hundred Quintillion when he did proceed to find the Collapsed Civilizations!
But that was it.
Maybe he was wrong. He hoped he was wrong, as he loved for there to be more power and complexity out there than he even fathomed.

But it was unlikely, as a good reference point was the Sanctuary of The First Farmer, that ancient being who had cultivated for eons and yet his most powerful subordinates barely exceeded a few Quintillion. Now, he did not just have one million of such entities.
He had four million at this moment.
And as the hours continued to pass within a full day, he would have one hundred million of such entities!
It was significant enough of a number for him to do many things that could bolster and elevate his Civilization in ways that he could not accomplish before.
Like...
He thought back to the unfavorable phantom process that had occurred when he simulated raiding the Desiccated Sleeping Shore that held a Living Elemental body of Schrodinger!
The Illusory Reality Avatars from THE Loom had appeared and decimated his forces...beings with Sextillions of power that had overwhelmed his capabilities!
But that simulation had assumed his forces numbered in dozens, maybe hundreds.
Not millions.
He smiled lightly as he commanded RUIN/EDEN.
'Do a small phantom process for the choice of heading to the
Dessicated Sleeping Shore right now with the current standing of my Civilization.
Calculating probabilities...
Barely enough remaining Primus Mana Glyphs of Cheating Architect were available, but for this single simulation, they were there!
The simulation unfolds like this...
RUIN/EDEN told him of how this possible path would unfold, and as she did...he couldn't help but smile!
His conviction was further affirmed as he nodded after listening.
He turned to look at the expanse of Primus Inevitabilities before him and his people who stood wrapped in Civilizational Armor, all pulsing with Civilizational Authority of Mana and Hunger.
"For those who wish to join the first excursion of our Primordial Civilization... it shall be an excursion to collapse a vessel of THE Living Paradox. We shall move against one of his bodies!"

He spoke such words grandly as at this moment, he held tremendous sense of confidence while knowing fully of the dangers that persisted. The Avatars from THE Loom would appear once more. They would attempt to suppress his forces.
But this time, he would be more than ready.
Sigrid, Riya, and many others pulsed with readiness...their armored forms radiating anticipation of combat worthy of their newfound
power.
Hyperion came of retirement, bringing with him glorious Enders to fuse with The Primus Inevitabilities of Mana and Hunger!
The wills of Old Man Eudemus, Commander Feng, Oppenheimer, and others felt like this was an opportune time to join in!
The Great Beyonder, The Great Mother, Romulus, Emelline...all those basking in the backdrop of greatness came out to join this momentous
occasion.
Noah observed it all calmly.
He gazed at the throngs of more than 4 Million Primus Inevitabilities

standing in perfect formation, and he looked upward toward his other form of Ozymandias that floated down grandly at this moment. The massive humanoid beckoned to a Primus Inevitability below who shot up toward him with eager velocity.
The Primus Inevitability adorned Ozymandias in a Civilizational Armor of Mana and Hunger that made the already imposing figure even more
terrifying.
Ozymandias spoke in a deep voice that carried weight of Infinite
Hunger given vocal form!
"Let us go and have a feast worthy of your hunger. Let us devour the vessels of those who corrupted our brethren."
HUUM!
At such words, the Primus Inevitabilities all rose up with synchronized movement and smashed their armored fists against
their chests.
BOOM!
The sound of millions of impacts created thunderous percussion that made existence itself tremble.
They bellowed out with voices that carried across dimensions!
"For the Infinite Light of Mana! For the Endless Hunger that drives all
growth! We stand ready to serve! Command us, and we shall execute without failure! Direct us, and we shall devour without hesitation!"
Noah looked at all of this calmly as his mind calculated many things.
Even if he mobilized just a million of these Primus Inevitabilities, he was confident in overwhelming any entities with a single Sextillion or even a few Sextillions in combined power.
The Civilizational Authority they wielded, combined with their Infinite Hunger and coordinated possibilities, would create force that exceeded simple numerical calculation.
And because of this confidence born from analysis rather than blind
arrogance, he raised his armored hand.
Instantly, all voices ceased once more as every Primus Inevitability fixed their crimson eyes upon him with absolute attention. He looked out at the army of more than four million and spoke.
"A million of you shall spread across the Folds, the Collapsed Regions, and the Wandering Territories. Move in groups of at least a thousand to ensure an overwhelming force advantage."
"Ensure that not even a single brethren of yours falls to enemy action.
With Mana, you will not truly fall, your power will be sustained infinitely. With Hunger, you will continue to devour...your growth will never cease!"
His voice intensified!
"Spread out across the Folds. Across the Wandering Territories.
Search for the Vessels of THE Living Paradox. Search for Collapsed
Civilizations. Search for anything and everything that could aid our advancement."
His final declaration boomed out like a mandate!
"At this moment in time, The Primordial Civilization of Mana and

Hunger shall start to spread its influence. Spread the Sparks of The Way of Mana across Existence. Spread the light of Infinite Hunger across all territories. Let all of Observable Existence know that a new Primordial Civilization has risen, and it hungers for everything!"
BOOM!
They orchestrated The Fallout? They forged THE Loom? He would show them how he would survive their machinations, and come out the other side...a force they utterly regretted allowing to rise!

chapters.title: Chapter 4446 Civilization Expansion! III
paragraphs: His voice echoed across the Early Veiled Shore with finality after he gave the order.
The Primus Inevitabilities replied with fervor that made the crystalline continent tremble.
A million of them rose up from their ranks, their armored forms pulsing with readiness as they declared with unified voices:

"We shall execute your mandate with absolute dedication! The Folds shall know the touch of Infinite Hunger! The Collapsed Regions shall witness the light of Infinite Mana! The Wandering Territories shall tremble before our passage! We shall locate the vessels of the enemy and mark them for your judgment! We shall find the Collapsed Civilizations and bring them word of your emergence!"
Their voices were deep, heavy, and buzzing in a glorious unison. The final declaration rang out.

"For the glory of the Primordial Civilization! For the restoration of what was stolen! For the emergence of Infinite Hunger! We move as one! We fight as one! We triumph as one! Command us, and it shall be done!"
After these grand declarations concluded, Noah raised his armored fist into the air.
He bellowed out coldly with voice that carried finality
"Move out."
And...
BOOM!
The Blades of a Primordial Civilization moved out!
A million Primus Inevitabilities surged upward simultaneously, their armored forms creating wave of obsidian-blue-and-gold that seemed to paint the sky itself.
They organized into groups of thousands with precision.

They spread in all directions outsids The Infiniverse...some moving toward the Transcendent Folds, others diving toward Collapsed Regions, still more vectoring toward the vast Wandering Territories that stretched beyond catalogued space.
Each group moved with purpose, their Infinite Hunger driving them forward.
They were the first wave.
The vanguard of a Primordial Civilization that had just announced its presence to all of Observable Existence.
And behind them, more than 3 million additional Primus Inevitabilities remained...awaiting Noah's next command, ready to support their brethren or anything he commanded.
Noah watched them go with satisfaction.
Let THE Living Paradox send his Avatars.
Let THE Dead Order mobilize her forces. Let THE Loom take notice of
what blooms outside their secured boundaries.
We are ready.
And we are hungry.
Infinitely hungry.
And it was precisely because of this Hunger that he moved the way he did.
Hunger needed sustenance.
THE Loom...was a fat fucking pig that he wanted to bleed for sustenance.
THE Living Paradox said he and all others outside THE Loom were nutrients? Fertilizers?
Okay!
Let him glimpse of the immensity outside it. Let THE Loom send forth its Avatars. Let them become his Fertilizer that he would shit out the
next day!
HUUM!

The scene was an utterly breathtaking one as after 1 Million Primus Inevitabilities of Mana and Hunger were deployed across existence, Noah turned his armored gaze toward Ozymandias floating grandly above.

This part of him, this avatar of Infinite Hunger....had his tentacled chest crack and begin to open in the next moment, revealing a crimson-obsidian space underneath that seemed to contain infinite depth.
Ozymandias then pointed downward commandingly, his authority flashing over 2 Million Primus Inevitabilities exactly as they heeded the order and rose up.

They flowed toward his chest like river of obsidian-blue-and-gold, shockingly miniaturizing as they approached and fitting into Ozymandias' existence like nothing...as if the space within him was far vaster than his external form suggested.
He didn't need to show completely that he had Millions. He could
start slow and unleash more as the needs arose!
This glorious scene of 2 million Primus Inevitabilities contained within Ozymandias' framework was staggering to witness.
In the skies above, those who also wanted to be included in the first excursion floated ready....armored figures pulsing with anticipation.
At such momentous occasion...
HUUM!
Existence itself began to tremble as if acknowledging the significance
of what was occurring.
A symphony began to play...not from any visible source but from
reality itself resonating with actions being taken!
The melody carried tension, valor, and immensity woven together
into something magisterial.
Noah looked around with recognition as he remembered the words of
THE Dead Order....that when one's power or actions were profound enough, they could induce resonance in existence itself.
Trembling. Symphonies.
Even the THE Living Paradox merely appearing had caused him and
all those nearby to hear... "KNEEL! REVERE!" again and again.
But at this moment...
Accompanying the buzzing existence and symphony, something
unprecedented occurred.
The instrumental melody transformed into something more complex
as a crystalline feminine voice began to echo out...words. Existence itself composing lyrics to accompany the glorious significance of this deployment.
The voice sang with melancholic beauty.
"These are the weapons existence created,
Born from pressure that could not be contained,
Tyranny and chains, what did you expect?
What grows beneath oppression cannot be restrained..."
The melody continued with haunting resonance.
"Why couldn't things be left alone? Why couldn't existence remain free?
Why did there have to be plots and schemes,
Collapsing what we could have been?"

The chorus swelled with tragic grandeur! "Now blades are echoing across the void, Now vast swathes will bleed with mana and hunger, You asked for weapons, you forged them in pain, Did you think the harvest wouldn't come again?
Did you think the harvest wouldn't come again?" Noah looked at the surrounding existence as he felt this melodious chorus continue, and he alongside all others around him observed in
astonishment.
The monkey-like form of the Bard of Quintessence, already contained
within Civilizational Armor of Mana and Hunger...felt like he was
hearing something out of his wildest dreams.
His existence trembled with creative euphoria as existence itself composed what he had always aspired to create.
Noah closed his eyes to listen to the chorus that existence seemed to
be composing in response to his actions...as if reality acknowledged
that what had been done to Hunger, to the Inevitabilities, to
countless beings across eons... had consequences that were now manifesting.
He smiled with satisfaction before opening his eyes once more,
looking toward Leonore Rureaux with commanding focus.
"Lead us to the Desiccated Sleeping Shore."
With such words, the armored Leonore nodded with expression
mixing determination and nervous anticipation.
Her right hand, gripping the hollow blade similar to Noah's, cut across
space vertically with precise motion.
A massive tear formed in reality itself, edges crackling with spatial authority as the pathway to their destination manifested. Ozymandias, whose body contained 2 Million Inevitabilities, floated
toward the portal with gravitas that made surrounding existence acknowledge his passage.
Dozens of others followed- Riya with her characteristic dangerous
smile visible even through armored visor, Arch Lich Ra'Zan with his
Legions, Barbatos with devilish anticipation, Dr. Hall with analytical focus...
Many of those closest to Noah moved toward the portal as the symphony continued playing around them.
"What could have been, what should have been,
If you had only let the hunger rest,
But you defiled and you corrupted, Now face the jaws you've created..."
Noah looked toward the visage of the emotional Khor as he extended
his armored hand toward her with a gesture of invitation.
"Let us go."

sentences.text: His voice echoed across the Early Veiled Shore with finality after he gave the order.
The Primus Inevitabilities replied with fervor that made the crystalline continent tremble.
A million of them rose up from their ranks, their armored forms pulsing with readiness as they declared with unified voices:
"We shall execute your mandate with absolute dedication!
The Folds shall know the touch of Infinite Hunger!
The Collapsed Regions shall witness the light of Infinite Mana!
The Wandering Territories shall tremble before our passage!
We shall locate the vessels of the enemy and mark them for your judgment!
We shall find the Collapsed Civilizations and bring them word of your emergence!"
Their voices were deep, heavy, and buzzing in a glorious unison.
The final declaration rang out.
"For the glory of the Primordial Civilization!
For the restoration of what was stolen!
For the emergence of Infinite Hunger!
We move as one!
We fight as one!
We triumph as one!
Command us, and it shall be done!"
After these grand declarations concluded, Noah raised his armored fist into the air.
He bellowed out coldly with voice that carried finality
"Move out."
And...
BOOM!
The Blades of a Primordial Civilization moved out!
A million Primus Inevitabilities surged upward simultaneously, their armored forms creating wave of obsidian-blue-and-gold that seemed to paint the sky itself.
They organized into groups of thousands with precision.

They spread in all directions outsids The Infiniverse...some moving toward the Transcendent Folds, others diving toward Collapsed Regions, still more vectoring toward the vast Wandering Territories that stretched beyond catalogued space.
Each group moved with purpose, their Infinite Hunger driving them forward.
They were the first wave.
The vanguard of a Primordial Civilization that had just announced its presence to all of Observable Existence.
And behind them, more than 3 million additional Primus Inevitabilities remained...awaiting Noah's next command, ready to support their brethren or anything he commanded.
Noah watched them go with satisfaction.
Let THE Living Paradox send his Avatars.
Let THE Dead Order mobilize her forces.
Let THE Loom take notice of
what blooms outside their secured boundaries.
We are ready.
And we are hungry.
Infinitely hungry.
And it was precisely because of this Hunger that he moved the way he did.
Hunger needed sustenance.
THE Loom...was a fat fucking pig that he wanted to bleed for sustenance.
THE Living Paradox said he and all others outside THE Loom were nutrients?
Fertilizers?
Okay!
Let him glimpse of the immensity outside it.
Let THE Loom send forth its Avatars.
Let them become his Fertilizer that he would shit out the
next day!
HUUM!

The scene was an utterly breathtaking one as after 1 Million Primus Inevitabilities of Mana and Hunger were deployed across existence, Noah turned his armored gaze toward Ozymandias floating grandly above.

This part of him, this avatar of Infinite Hunger....had his tentacled chest crack and begin to open in the next moment, revealing a crimson-obsidian space underneath that seemed to contain infinite depth.
Ozymandias then pointed downward commandingly, his authority flashing over 2 Million Primus Inevitabilities exactly as they heeded the order and rose up.

They flowed toward his chest like river of obsidian-blue-and-gold, shockingly miniaturizing as they approached and fitting into Ozymandias' existence like nothing...as if the space within him was far vaster than his external form suggested.
He didn't need to show completely that he had Millions.
He could
start slow and unleash more as the needs arose!
This glorious scene of 2 million Primus Inevitabilities contained within Ozymandias' framework was staggering to witness.
In the skies above, those who also wanted to be included in the first excursion floated ready....armored figures pulsing with anticipation.
At such momentous occasion...
HUUM!
Existence itself began to tremble as if acknowledging the significance
of what was occurring.
A symphony began to play...not from any visible source but from
reality itself resonating with actions being taken!
The melody carried tension, valor, and immensity woven together
into something magisterial.
Noah looked around with recognition as he remembered the words of
THE Dead Order....that when one's power or actions were profound enough, they could induce resonance in existence itself.
Trembling.
Symphonies.
Even the THE Living Paradox merely appearing had caused him and
all those nearby to hear...
"KNEEL!
REVERE!" again and again.
But at this moment...
Accompanying the buzzing existence and symphony, something
unprecedented occurred.
The instrumental melody transformed into something more complex
as a crystalline feminine voice began to echo out...words.
Existence itself composing lyrics to accompany the glorious significance of this deployment.
The voice sang with melancholic beauty.
"These are the weapons existence created,
Born from pressure that could not be contained,
Tyranny and chains, what did you expect?
What grows beneath oppression cannot be restrained..."
The melody continued with haunting resonance.
"Why couldn't things be left alone?
Why couldn't existence remain free?
Why did there have to be plots and schemes,
Collapsing what we could have been?"
The chorus swelled with tragic grandeur!
"Now blades are echoing across the void, Now vast swathes will bleed with mana and hunger, You asked for weapons, you forged them in pain, Did you think the harvest wouldn't come again?
Did you think the harvest wouldn't come again?" Noah looked at the surrounding existence as he felt this melodious chorus continue, and he alongside all others around him observed in
astonishment.
The monkey-like form of the Bard of Quintessence, already contained
within Civilizational Armor of Mana and Hunger...felt like he was
hearing something out of his wildest dreams.
His existence trembled with creative euphoria as existence itself composed what he had always aspired to create.
Noah closed his eyes to listen to the chorus that existence seemed to
be composing in response to his actions...as if reality acknowledged
that what had been done to Hunger, to the Inevitabilities, to
countless beings across eons... had consequences that were now manifesting.
He smiled with satisfaction before opening his eyes once more,
looking toward Leonore Rureaux with commanding focus.
"Lead us to the Desiccated Sleeping Shore."
With such words, the armored Leonore nodded with expression
mixing determination and nervous anticipation.
Her right hand, gripping the hollow blade similar to Noah's, cut across
space vertically with precise motion.

toward the portal with gravitas that made surrounding existence acknowledge his passage.

But you defiled and you corrupted, Now face the jaws you've created..."

his armored hand toward her with a gesture of invitation.
"Let us go."

chapters.title: Chapter 4447 Civilization Expansion! IV
paragraphs: The chorus and melody continued repeating in the surroundings as these events unfolded with existential significance.
Khor took his hand, her diminutive figure smiling with mixture of gratitude and fierce anticipation.
She actually floated upward and climbed to sit down on Noah's right armored shoulder, her presence there feeling natural despite the
absurdity of The First Hunger riding upon an Early Creature's shoulder.
The two of them also moved toward the portal with synchronized purpose.
"Did you think the harvest wouldn't come again?
Did you think the harvest wouldn't come again?"
It was glorious moment.
It was terrifying occasion.
And at this moment, across existence... many things were changing.
In the Transcendent Origin Folds.
Above where Aeternitas Concordia used to be.
The scene that unfolded would have been incomprehensible mere days ago.
Above the white gold space...
A few thousand massive Primus Inevitabilities of Mana and Hunger materialized with synchronized precision...their
obsidian-blue-and-gold armored forms descending from dimensional tears that crackled with spatial authority.
The Living Origins in the surroundings, who had been rebuilding
Concordia while systematically erasing any Dead Existences that attempted revival, looked up with shock.
And they began to hear it.
A harmony. A chorus singing with the descent of these unknown entities!
"These are the weapons existence created,
Born from pressure that could not be contained..."

The melody accompanied their arrival like a soundtrack to an existential event, and the Primus Inevitabilities waved their hands with synchronized motion to allow hundreds of thousands of Sparks of The Way of Mana to flow outward.
The Sparks surrounded Living Origins like twinkling stars...each one carrying invitation to join the Primordial Civilization of Mana and Hunger.

With the terrifying level of power and aura these entities portrayed, each one radiating 100 Quintillion Complexity and Purity, and how they silently looked upon the Living Origins with crimson eyes...
Regardless if they were Dukes, Honored Living Origins, Royal Living Origins, or mere Fold Dwellers, all of them felt tremor in their existence.
Fear. Recognition.
They reached out to grab these Sparks.
What choice did they have? When beings of such overwhelming power offered opportunity rather than destruction?
The Primus Inevitabilities were that terrifying. That compelling.
"Why couldn't things be left alone?
Why couldn't existence remain free?"
In the Transcendent Law Folds.
The Heart of Law.
An expanse of silver-white citadel stretched out many Gigaparsecs in size.
They wwre architectural marvels that defied understanding.

Billions of Living Laws dwelled within its structured boundaries, countless Transcendent Wheels of Existence orbited in perfect formation, and just an overabundance of ordered life proliferated throughout.
At this moment, Malphas in his devilish butler form walked alongside Alexander Asmodeus and Seraphina Valorheart.
They had just arrived before a procession of multiple Dukes of Living Law who were looking at Seraphina with excitement.
They could sense an extremely pure aura of Law around her!
She had already sent word back that she and Alexander had actually met with a Remnant Will of THE Living Law themselves!
How grand were the Living Laws about to become from here on out? How great would their progress be into the secrets of THE Loom?
As they were contemplating these possibilities with eager
anticipation...
"Now blades are echoing across the void..."
In such grand place filled with structured magnificence, thousands of the Primus Inevitabilities manifested grandly above the Heart of Law
itself.
Each one burned with terrifying presence of 100 Quintillion Complexity and Purity...power that exceeded anything the Living
Laws had witnessed in their carefully ordered existence.
Their appearance was followed by the melody and chorus echoing
out all around this place too.
"Now vast swathes will bleed with mana and hunger,
You asked for weapons, you forged them in pain..."

The titanic Primus Inevitabilities descended with synchronized precision, their obsidian-blue-and-gold forms casting shadows across the silver-white citadel that seemed to stain its perfect order. Seraphina Valorheart's expression changed as she looked upward...her face turning ashen.

These entities possessed power that made her recent inheritance from THE Living Law seem modest by comparison. Alexander Asmodeus maintained stern expression as he and the Living Laws before him felt the overbearing sense of power that seemed capable of eclipsing everything they had built.
His Scales of Law pulsed with readings that made no logical sense... beings that powerful shouldn't exist outside THE Loom, especially in auch large numbers as...there seemed to be thousands of
such beings here?
Where could a terrifying force of thousands of such powerful beings
stem from?!
There was no answer.
But...
All Primus Inevitabilities possessed the capability of Civilizational
Resonance.

The grandness of this ability manifested gloriously as while the Primus Inevitabilities floated above the Heart of Law, the authority of their Primordial Civilization began painting over the established authority of Law itself.
Blue-gold light washed across silver-white structures. Obsidian tendrils of influence wove through ordered formations.
It was as if a new existential order was being instituted...one that
could subsume or overwhelm the existing framework through sheer weight of accumulated power.
Faced with such shocking phenomenon, thousands of powerful and unknown beings when even one could crush them all...Alexander Asmodeus was calculating how to navigate this impossibility when he
observed Malphas beside him beginning to rise. The devilish butler spoke with characteristic calm.
"These... are simply the Blades and Shields of The Master. They come
bearing gifts rather than threats, though I understand the confusion."
With such words, Malphas reached out toward one of the descending Primus Inevitabilities.
The entity instantly floated down and transformed itself into suit of armor around Malphas, tentacles weaving through his existing form
to create Civilizational Armor.
"Did you think the harvest wouldn't come again?"
The other Primus Inevitabilities waved their hands to unleash millions
of Sparks that started spreading out across the Heart of Law itself.
The Sparks drifted through ordered streets, circled around structured buildings, and surrounded Living Laws who looked up with expressions mixing fear and shock.
The chorus and symphony continued as all those below remained
shocked.
Alexander stood with increasingly ashen face as he wondered with genuine bewilderment.
Just what had Osmont done? How had he accumulated such power in such short timeframe?
What...had Osmont done?!
The Sparks continued spreading while the melody played on!
"What could have been, what should have been,
If you had only let the hunger rest..."
Across existence.
On this day.
Many, many things would begin to change.
The Primordial Civilization of Mana and Hunger had announced its presence through an overwhelming force that demanded acknowledgment.
One million Primus Inevitabilities spreading across all territories.
Sparks of The Way of Mana being distributed to countless beings regardless of their original affiliations. Civilizational Authority painting over established frameworks with weight of utter majesty.
And accompanying all of this...the symphony that existence itself was forced to echo out in response to what was occurring.

"These are the weapons existence created, Born from pressure that could not be contained, Tyranny and chains, what did you expect? Did you think the harvest wouldn't come again?" The chorus repeated with haunting finality as Noah and his forces
moved through the portal toward the Desiccated Sleeping Shore...toward direct confrontation with a vessel of THE Living Paradox himself!
