chapters.title: Chapter 4448 Duty I
paragraphs: Officium.
Duty.
A word that carried different weight depending upon who spoke it, who heard it, who lived beneath its shadow.
For some, duty was nothing more than chains disguised as
purpose....obligations imposed by others who claimed authority over your existence.
These beings viewed duty as surrender, as relinquishing the freedom to determine one's own path in exchange for the comfort of being told what to do.
For others, duty was sacred covenant- a binding agreement between self and something greater that transformed mere existence into meaningful purpose.
These beings viewed duty as elevation, as recognition that individual desires paled before collective necessity.

And for a select few across existence's infinite expanse, duty was neither chain nor covenant but choice...deliberate decision to serve something beyond self because that service aligned with personal values rather than external compulsion.
The question that plagued peasants, warriors, and kings alike was simple: What constituted true duty, and who possessed authority to define it?
In the Earliest Folds, in times beyond current reckoning.
There was a moment when The First Leader, Gilgamesh, fought against a Disciple of THE Creature himself.
Just having a more concentrated Everything of THE Creature did not
mean one could become a Disciple!
Nobody knew the complete results of that battle it occurred in domain others could not perceive, hidden from ordinary observation.
But at its conclusion, Gilgamesh lay on shattered folding of existence itself...reality cracked beneath him like broken mirror.
His chest was rent open with wounds that leaked essence rather than blood, his breathing labored with pain.
Yet his expression remained stern. Unyielding. Unbowed despite catastrophic defeat.
He stared out into a golden fractured sky where reality itself seemed wounded from their confrontation, and his voice emerged with the weight of someone questioning their fundamental assumptions.

"What is our duty in existence? What are we bound by? Is our duty always to follow The Way of Existence of THE Creature and THE Living Existences? Is that all that our existence amounts to...perpetual service to those who came before, adherence to frameworks
established by others? Are we nothing more than instruments of their will?"
Gilgamesh asked such questions as he addressed the entity who had defeated him so thoroughly.
The Disciple of THE Creature stood without single injury visible anywhere on her form...a woman with dark hair cascading like shadow and blue eyes.
Her expression carried no malice, no satisfaction at victory, only calm certainty of someone who knew their place.
When she spoke, her voice held reverential conviction.

"Duty is not burden to be questioned or chain to be broken. Duty is the very essence of meaningful existence. I am a follower of THE Creature whose Primordial Civilization encompasses Existence itself. My duty is therefore infallible because it serves the foundation upon
which all else is built. My duty is to Existence itself, not as an abstract concept but as a living principle that sustains all things."
Her eyes hardened slightly.

"You speak of duty as if it constrains you, First Leader. But true duty liberates by providing purpose beyond selfish desires. Those who reject duty in pursuit of personal freedom often discover that freedom without purpose is merely chaos wearing pleasant mask." At such words, Gilgamesh's expression twisted with spiteful rejection. Blood, or what passed for blood in his primordial existence, continued seeping from his chest wounds as he responded with bitter defiance. "I reject that type of duty. I am tired of following the Way of others, of walking paths established by those who came before and expecting gratitude for my obedience. I want to find my own duty...one that serves purposes I determine rather than purposes imposed upon me by THE Creature or any other authority"
His damaged hand clenched into fist.
"Even if that duty is wrong by your standards, at least it would be mine."
The Disciple of THE Creature scowled at such declaration...her serene composure cracking to reveal something approaching contempt for what she viewed as foolish pride.
Her words emerged with sharp edges.

"For that ambition, you would need to usher forth your own Way and establish your own Civilization. You would need to create framework from nothing, to convince others that your path holds merit equal to or exceeding THE Creature's Primordial Civilization of Existence itself."
"Are you exceptional enough to accomplish that? Do you possess the capability to forge something from void when THE Creature required giving his Everythings to accomplish what he did?"
Gilgamesh's reply emerged despite his wounds, his voice carrying unshaken conviction.

"I stand exceptional among countless many across existence. I am The First Leader, the one who gave purpose to beings who wandered aimlessly. My exceptionalism is demonstrated through actions rather than claimed through words."

The Disciple's response was sharp and biting...it was words designed to wound pride more deeply than any physical attack! "And yet, you could not even land a single injury on a lone Disciple like myself, no matter how much Civilizational Authority you burned in attempt. You threw everything you possessed at me and accomplished precisely nothing. What about you is exceptional, supposed First Leader? Your inability to recognize your own limitations? Your stubborn insistence that you deserve authority you haven't earned?"
She turned away with a dismissive gesture.
"Find your own duty if you wish. Forge your own Civilization if you
can. But understand that duty defined by personal desire rather than principle is merely ambition wearing duty's clothing. And ambition without wisdom leads only to destruction."
Duty.
It was a word that meant different things for many.
For some, duty was nothing.
For others... duty was everything.
The Present.
The sensation of being inside a Primus Inevitability was something
one couldn't really fathom unless they were personally experiencing
it.
For the Blue Slime, it was akin to sitting in small domain where he was the center of existence itself.

His gelatinous form rested within crystalline chamber of obsidian-blue light, and his existence held a layer of Primus Mana covering him and connecting him to the armor's systems as he felt like the 100 Quintillion power was not separate from him, but truly
his.

He and the Primus Inevitability were inseparable...a symbiotic pair that shared power, purpose, and perception simultaneously. At this moment, the bubbly blue slime focused on the surroundings with enhanced senses that the Civilizational Armor provided. Something unique he realized was that as the Primus Inevitabilities moved across existence, their bodies hummed with power as one could hear silent words of affirmation ringing out inherently around
them.
When the Blue Slime listened closely, his consciousness attuning to
the subtle vibrations...
He heard...
"For the Infinite Light of Mana. For the Endless Hunger that drives all
growth."
It was like mantra that they repeated as they moved...sacred scripture recited through a fundamental nature of their existence!

I want to find my own duty...one that serves purposes I determine rather than purposes imposed upon me by THE Creature or any other authority"
His damaged hand clenched into fist.
"Even if that duty is wrong by your standards, at least it would be mine."
The Disciple of THE Creature scowled at such declaration...her serene composure cracking to reveal something approaching contempt for what she viewed as foolish pride.
Her words emerged with sharp edges.
"For that ambition, you would need to usher forth your own Way and establish your own Civilization.
You would need to create framework from nothing, to convince others that your path holds merit equal to or exceeding THE Creature's Primordial Civilization of Existence itself."
"Are you exceptional enough to accomplish that?
Do you possess the capability to forge something from void when THE Creature required giving his Everythings to accomplish what he did?"
Gilgamesh's reply emerged despite his wounds, his voice carrying unshaken conviction.
"I stand exceptional among countless many across existence.
I am The First Leader, the one who gave purpose to beings who wandered aimlessly.
My exceptionalism is demonstrated through actions rather than claimed through words."
The Disciple's response was sharp and biting...it was words designed to wound pride more deeply than any physical attack!
"And yet, you could not even land a single injury on a lone Disciple like myself, no matter how much Civilizational Authority you burned in attempt.
You threw everything you possessed at me and accomplished precisely nothing.
What about you is exceptional, supposed First Leader?
Your inability to recognize your own limitations?
Your stubborn insistence that you deserve authority you haven't earned?"
She turned away with a dismissive gesture.
"Find your own duty if you wish.
Forge your own Civilization if you
can.
But understand that duty defined by personal desire rather than principle is merely ambition wearing duty's clothing.
And ambition without wisdom leads only to destruction."
Duty.
It was a word that meant different things for many.
For some, duty was nothing.
For others... duty was everything.
The Present.
The sensation of being inside a Primus Inevitability was something
one couldn't really fathom unless they were personally experiencing
it.
For the Blue Slime, it was akin to sitting in small domain where he was the center of existence itself.

His gelatinous form rested within crystalline chamber of obsidian-blue light, and his existence held a layer of Primus Mana covering him and connecting him to the armor's systems as he felt like the 100 Quintillion power was not separate from him, but truly
his.
He and the Primus Inevitability were inseparable...a symbiotic pair that shared power, purpose, and perception simultaneously.
At this moment, the bubbly blue slime focused on the surroundings with enhanced senses that the Civilizational Armor provided.
Something unique he realized was that as the Primus Inevitabilities moved across existence, their bodies hummed with power as one could hear silent words of affirmation ringing out inherently around
them.
When the Blue Slime listened closely, his consciousness attuning to
the subtle vibrations...
He heard...
"For the Infinite Light of Mana.
For the Endless Hunger that drives all
growth."
It was like mantra that they repeated as they moved...sacred scripture recited through a fundamental nature of their existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 4449 Duty II
paragraphs: It was mesmerizing to listen to as a moment later...
HUUM!
The Blue Slime gazed outward through his armor's visual systems to find that their group had arrived in the skies of unique location.
A Desiccated Sleeping Shore!
The domain stretched below them like corrupted mirror of the Early Veiled Shore they had departed from.
Where their home held golden sands radiating with vitality, this place bore gray granules that seemed drained of life essence.
Where their waters shone with crystalline purity, these waters moved sluggishly with unhealthy coloration suggesting contamination at fundamental level.

But the Shore held many entities...different types of Living Existences who had made this drained place their home or temporary refuge. They looked upward at the sudden appearance of armored figures with shock.
The Blue Slime looked at all of them with curiosity befitting his nature, studying their varied forms and expressions.
At this moment, in the skies, his body was among the dozens that followed behind the massive form of Ozymandias.

When he looked back with his armor's enhanced perception, he saw the glorious armored figure of his Master in his own fused state...that sleek obsidian-blue-and-gold form with crimson visor and floating crystalline crown.
And Khor sat on the Master's shoulder like diminutive sovereign observing her domain.
The Blue Slime's thoughts emerged with admiration.

Master always looks cool in absolutely everything he does. It's really unfair how he manages it so consistently. And right now, even with all these terrifying armored forms of Primus Inevitabilities that I and others adorned, a halo of light surrounds the Master as he distinctly looks different from everyone else...
Master was so incredibly cool!
The Blue Slime watched with barely contained excitement as his Master simply waved his hand with a casual gesture...a minor motion that somehow carried weight of existential authority.
In the next moment, the figure of one among their group moved forward.
Steam hissed out dramatically as one of them took off the helmet of the Civilizational Armor they adorned.
The face underneath was revealed to be Leonore Rureaux, her features carrying mixture of determination and something approaching grief.
The Blue Slime did not know much about her apart from being recent entrant into Master's weavings, but many beings joined his Master over the months and years.
Each addition brought new perspectives, new capabilities, new loyalties.
The scene of shock spreading across the Living Existences on the Desiccated Sleeping Shore was palpable even from their elevated position.
They saw Leonore...who should have been their ally, their companion, their trusted comrade...emanating such terrifying power and arriving with these foreign beings of overwhelming strength.
She looked at them with an expression mixing recognition and resolve.
"Existence is at stake, with forces you do not understand currently in
motion. Did any of you here... observe the return of Schrodinger?"
Schrodinger.
The leader of this place, the enigmatic figure who commanded their loyalty.
And Leonore Rureaux, their supposed ally, was seemingly asking for him while surrounded by immensely powerful unknown forces!
Just... what was going on?!
The Living Existences below began murmuring with confusion and growing fear as they recognized the magnitude of power hovering above them.
At such a time...
HUUM!
The Blue Slime instinctively felt his body tense within the armor, and the Civilizational Armor around him moved naturally to pulse with
defensive authority.
The blade and shield he carried through the armor's limbs were raised
as if the armor itself sensed danger approaching!
And this sensation was followed by terrifying eruption of silent authority that froze every Living Existence on the Desiccated Sleeping Shore.
From the very center of the domain... a power burning with paradoxical light arose with overwhelming presence!
The Blue Slime's enhanced senses focused to see a humanoid Early Creature rising far ahead...emerging from concealment with casual confidence!
This Early Creature's hair shone gold like concentrated sunlight, and its body was adorned by white chiton that seemed woven from paradoxical threads.
The body appeared very much real and yet not simultaneously...as if existing in multiple states at once through mechanisms that defied conventional existence.
It was titanic in scale, and it was not a Dead Early Creature, but a genuine Early Creature...one projecting from elsewhere.
As the Blue Slime looked forth with growing tension, he naturally saw blue-bordered words rising to identify this being who looked at them with great interest.
Illusory Reality Avatar of Existence]
Designation: Unknown - Avatar of Early Creature from THE Loom
Approximate Complexity and Purity: 1.5 Sextillion
Classification: Hostile Entity - Vessel Guardian
1.5 Sextillion!
The number made the Blue Slime's gelatinous form quiver with
recognition of the threat.
That was 15 times more powerful than any single Primus Inevitability...equivalent to 1,500 Quintillion!
As soon as such a being fully manifested, he looked with interest at
Ozymandias, the distant Noah, and all assembled forces with an
expression mixing curiosity and arrogance.

"Well, this is certainly an interesting development. Has the outside existence advanced this much to actually have dozens of creatures following a Way of Existence this tightly? Such power, coordination, such unified purpose...I haven't witnessed its like outside THE Loom." His voice was paradoxical and heavy, causing sense of pressure to descend all around them.
Even the Blue Slime felt slight sense of suffocation despite being protected by his Civilizational Armor.
The Avatar continued with condescending amusement.
"Who are you all? And why would you be looking for something that
does not involve you?"
The voice alone caused heavy sense of suffocation across all present.
And yet the Blue Slime did not fear because at this moment...
"For the Infinite Light of Mana. For the Endless Hunger that drives all
growth!"
His Civilizational Armor and all those of others nearby continued to hum with these affirmations as if they were repeating sacred
scripture.
The mantra seemed to push back against the Avatar's oppressive presence, creating bubble of resistance through sheer weight of unified belief.
And while facing such terrifying being...
The Blue Slime began to bounce up and down with excitement inside
the Civilizational Armor as he saw the Master behind them wave his
hand with another casual gesture.
In the next moment, Ozymandias' chest opened with dramatic motion
as from within it... 1,000 Primus Inevitabilities shot out like river of
obsidian-blue-and-gold.
They encircled the skies with practiced precision, staring down at the
Avatar from THE Loom with crimson eyes that held no fear...only hungry anticipation.
The moment they appeared, a booming and tense symphony began to
bloom in the surroundings.
Existence itself acknowledged the significance as chorus echoed out! "These are the weapons existence created,
Born from pressure that could not be contained..."
The Blue Slime felt the oppression from the terrifying Avatar lift
significantly with the appearance of these 1,000 Primus Inevitabilities. Their combined Civilizational Authority pushed back against the
Avatar's singular presence.
Inside the armor, his body still looked at his Master with excitement
as the Master's hand remained raised...clearly not finished with his
deployment.
And in the next moment...
HUUM!
Tens of thousands more Primus Inevitabilities surged out of
Ozymandias' opened chest, surrounding the Illusory Reality Avatar of Existence with overwhelming numbers.
The Avatar, who had maintained calm and arrogant gaze, had his
expression change to become stern as he stared at tens of thousands of similar lifeforms surrounding him.
Each one pulsed with 100 Quintillion Complexity and Purity, each one wielding Civilizational Authority as birthright. His power was 1.5 Sextillions, yes.
15 times stronger than each individual one, yes.
But when there were tens of thousands of beings, even if they were 15
times less complex individually... the numbers became heavy.
Heavy!

chapters.title: Chapter 4450 Duty III
paragraphs: The weight of accumulated power pressed down upon the Avatar's advantage and began to negate it through sheer volume.

And the Blue Slime couldn't help but laugh with bubbly joy inside his armor as he knew his Master had 2 Million hidden within the body of Ozymandias...and he had only revealed a fraction of available forces!

When exactly 100,000 Primus Inevitabilities blotted the skies of the Desiccated Sleeping Shore and surrounded the Avatar in perfect formation, the scene was both glorious and horror-inducing simultaneously.
The powerful air of the Avatar was completely eclipsed, with only the light of Primus Mana and Hunger being
present...obsidian-blue-and-gold radiance that painted over the paradoxical authority the Avatar had been exuding.
This moment was absolute!
The Primus Inevitabilities of Mana and Hunger gazed down upon the Avatar with unified focus, their crimson eyes creating constellation of hostile intent.

In the hands of each one rested blade and shield similar to what the armored body of the Master was holding...hollow blades with Primordial Fireballs spinning within, shields inscribed with Primus Mana Arcana Glyphs. Just slightly less bright than the Master's weapons, but multiplied by 100,000...
The combined light was blinding.
At such moment...

The Blue Slime trembled with excitement as he saw the Civilizational Armor of his Master pulse with activity. Tentacles bloomed from it to form into glorious Primus Inevitability beside his Master rather than around him.
The one who had introduced himself as Protos and who had fused with the Master!
Protos appeared grandly and already looked taller and bigger than all other Primus Inevitabilities...as if his fusion with Noah had elevated him beyond his brethren.
At this moment, Protos raised his shield high as he bellowed with a voice that carried across entire domain.
"What do we fight for?!"
HUUM!
The next scene made the Blue Slime's existence tremble with vicarious pride.
All 100,000 Primus Inevitabilities raised their shields grandly in synchronized motion...the sound of 100,000 obsidian-gold shields being raised creating thunderous percussion.
They answered with unified voice that seemed to shake reality itself.
"We fight for Mana! We fight for Hunger! We fight for the Primordial Civilization that birthed us!"
The eyes of the Blue Slime sparkled inside his armor as he saw Protos raise his sword next and speak with a booming voice that carried the weight of absolute conviction.
"What is our duty?!"
Duty.
What was their duty?
The Blue Slime found himself contemplating this question alongside the Primus Inevitabilities, his gelatinous form rippling with introspection.
The Primus Inevitabilities answered with synchronized voices once
more.

"Our duty is to serve the Primordial Civilization without hesitation! Our duty is to defend the Master's light without reservation! Our duty is to devour all obstacles that stand before our framework! We do not question! We do not falter! We do not cease! Our duty is absolute! We are the Blades and Shields, and our purpose is singular- the triumph of Mana and Hunger across all of existence!"
BOOM!
The Blue Slime heard their resonant answer as he found his own existence trembling with recognition.
He asked himself.
What is MY duty?
He had met the Master what felt like so long ago...back when things were simpler, when powers were modest, when the scope of ambition
was limited to survival.
He was a summon of the Master, a tool initially created to serve
specific function.
What was his duty?
And as he pondered this, Protos asked next question.
"What is our purpose?!"
The gaze of the Avatar had become entirely heavy at this moment...the arrogance replaced by something approaching genuine concern as he
recognized the coordinated threat surrounding him.
The Primus Inevitabilities bellowed out their purpose with
synchronized precision.
"Our purpose is the advancement of the Primordial Civilization! Our purpose is the protection of those we serve! Our purpose is the
consumption of all that opposes us! We exist to fight! We exist to defend! We exist to devour!"
At such moment, the Blue Slime felt sense of euphoria blooming within his gelatinous form as Protos floated forward and stood gloriously tall without any trace of fear.
His massive form looked down upon the Avatar...who despite
possessing 1.5 Sextillion in power, now appeared less intimidating when surrounded by 100,000 beings who each wielded Civilizational
Authority without hesitation.
Protos said once more with voice carrying weight of final question
before action.
"What is our duty?!"
This time, the Blue Slime felt his existence truly buzzing as when he truly asked himself, his duty... was to give back to the Master.
To defend the Master after all he continued to give to him and many
others.
To serve not because he was compelled, but because he chose to serve someone worthy of service.
So this time, as the Primus Inevitabilities replied with their booming
voices, the Blue Slime joined them in their declaration as he also
raised his sword through his armor's limbs.
"Our duty is to the Master! Our duty is to the Civilization! Our duty is
absolute and infinite!"
And shockingly, he wasn't the only one.
He could see the Emperor Penguin raising his armored sword,

Kazuhiko joining the chorus, Lilith's blade rising, Titano's massive form adding its voice, Erikson participating despite his usual reserve, and many others also raising their swords and bellowing out the same declaration of duty like the Primus Inevitabilities!
Original members of Noah's weavings had found their duty alongside the newly born Inevitabilities...a unified purpose transcending origin or length of service!
Existence trembled and became completely silent in the next moment
as all symphonies ceased.
All chorus ceased.
There was only Protos pointing his sword down toward the Avatar as
he said with cold finality.
"An enemy of the Master is before you. Fulfill. Your. Duty."
The glorious moment that followed would be seared into the Blue Slime's memory for as long as he lived.
All Primus Inevitabilities lit up with obsidian-blue-and-gold waves of power simultaneously...100,000 beings activating their capabilities in perfect synchronization.
They swung their hollow swords down with unified motion, and from each blade, countless Primordial Fireballs bloomed outward. The Blue Slime watched in slow motion as each Primus Inevitability
released at least 1 Million condensed miniaturized Fireballs with their single swing.
Each Fireball burned with concentrated Mana and Hunger, each one capable of devastating territories if allowed to detonate fully. 100,000 Primus Inevitabilities.
1 Million Fireballs each.
100 Billion Primordial Fireballs surging toward a lone Avatar.
The sight was beyond spectacular...it was cataclysmic. The sky became wall of obsidian-blue-and-gold fire descending with inexorable purpose.
All of it surged toward the lone Avatar whose expression had become
heavy with recognition of what he faced.
He howled out and began to surge with Civilizational Authority of
Paradox....his 1.5 Sextillion power manifesting fully as paradoxical light erupted around him.

But even as he activated his full strength, even as he deployed whatever defensive measures his projection allowed... 100 Billion Primordial Fireballs continued their descent. The Blue Slime looked at all of this with ecstasy, his entire existence
feeling sense of fervor as he repeated words of his own duty to his
Master.
Duty.
Yes. This was his Duty.
In Master's grand emerging Civilization, he would witness all the
wonders as he carried out his duty.
He would serve with loyalty that transcended simple obligation. He
would fight with conviction born from choice rather than compulsion.
This was his Duty!
And as the Fireballs descended and the Avatar prepared for impact that would test the limits of his projected form...
The Blue Slime felt his gelatinous form pulse with glory! Officium. Duty.
Duty was not chains. Duty was not burden.
Duty was choice...choice to serve something worthy of service, choice
to fight for those worthy of protection, choice to devour for
Civilization worthy of growth. And his Duty was to the Master.
For as long as he lived. BOOM!

The glorious moment that followed would be seared into the Blue Slime's memory for as long as he lived.
All Primus Inevitabilities lit up with obsidian-blue-and-gold waves of power simultaneously...100,000 beings activating their capabilities in perfect synchronization.
They swung their hollow swords down with unified motion, and from each blade, countless Primordial Fireballs bloomed outward.
The Blue Slime watched in slow motion as each Primus Inevitability
released at least 1 Million condensed miniaturized Fireballs with their single swing.
Each Fireball burned with concentrated Mana and Hunger, each one capable of devastating territories if allowed to detonate fully.
100,000 Primus Inevitabilities.
1 Million Fireballs each.
100 Billion Primordial Fireballs surging toward a lone Avatar.
The sight was beyond spectacular...it was cataclysmic.
The sky became wall of obsidian-blue-and-gold fire descending with inexorable purpose.
All of it surged toward the lone Avatar whose expression had become
heavy with recognition of what he faced.
He howled out and began to surge with Civilizational Authority of
Paradox....his 1.5 Sextillion power manifesting fully as paradoxical light erupted around him.
But even as he activated his full strength, even as he deployed whatever defensive measures his projection allowed...
100 Billion Primordial Fireballs continued their descent.
The Blue Slime looked at all of this with ecstasy, his entire existence
feeling sense of fervor as he repeated words of his own duty to his
Master.
Duty.
Yes.
This was his Duty.
In Master's grand emerging Civilization, he would witness all the
wonders as he carried out his duty.
He would serve with loyalty that transcended simple obligation.
He
would fight with conviction born from choice rather than compulsion.
This was his Duty!
And as the Fireballs descended and the Avatar prepared for impact that would test the limits of his projected form...
The Blue Slime felt his gelatinous form pulse with glory!
Officium.
Duty.
Duty was not chains.
Duty was not burden.
Duty was choice...choice to serve something worthy of service, choice
to fight for those worthy of protection, choice to devour for
Civilization worthy of growth.
And his Duty was to the Master.
For as long as he lived.
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4451 Duty IV
paragraphs: There was strength in numbers.
This truth had been acknowledged across existence since the earliest days when the first beings clustered together for protection against threats they could not face alone.
Many had proclaimed that if one simply possessed sufficient
quantity, quality became secondary concern.
Accumulate enough. Gather enough. Amass enough.
This was true, but only to an extent.

If there existed a terrifying army of knights numbering 100, each capable of massacring a peasant with single swing of their blade...trained warriors encased in armor that deflected weak strikes, wielding weapons that cleaved through unprotected flesh like scythes through wheat...
Then even 1,000 peasants might not accomplish much against them.
The peasants would charge. The knights would cut them down in swathes. Bodies would pile. Blood would flow. And the knights would stand victorious over mountain of corpses.
But if 1 million peasants with no individual power swarmed these same 100 knights?
The calculus shifted dramatically.
The sheer exhaustion after cutting down thousands would accumulate. Arms would tire from endless swinging.
Armor would dent under cumulative impacts of countless weak strikes.
Eventually, dozens of these invincible knights would fall...not from single devastating blow, but from being gradually ripped apart by weak peasants who simply refused to stop coming.
There was strength in numbers, yes.
But one had to understand how to use these numbers. Where the true strength resided.
How to ensure that tens of thousands of peasants did not have to die before achieving results they wanted.
The difference between victory and pyrrhic slaughter lay not in accumulation of bodies, but in tactical application of accumulated force.
Wisdom transformed numbers from blunt instrument into a magisterial, tyrannical, surgical weapon.
In the Dessicated Sleeping Shore.
Protos gazed at the erupting might of the Illusory Reality Avatar of Existence with coldness and immensity that exceeded his newly born consciousness.
He currently stood in front of Noah, feeling the interminable gaze of The Master behind him.
The analytical eyes that observed and wanted to see the results of them facing their first genuine enemy.
And the first enemy they faced was 15 times stronger individually than each of them.
But so what?
The Master wanted results, and The Master would have results.
It was the least that Protos could do to deliver results when the Master had done so much for their emergence. When the Master had infused them with Infinite Hunger and purpose!
So Protos watched as the Avatar of an Early Creature below made his
move.
Since he had the honor of being fused into Master's glorious glow, his capabilities had grown far beyond his Brothers and Sisters.
His gaze could perceive details that others could not access.
This was his Master allowed him to come out and lead.
When he looked at the Avatar, he looked at it through the Master's brilliant analytical gaze as details freely displayed themselves.
Illusory Reality Avatar of Existence
Designation: Aurelius Paradoxus - Early Creature of THE Loom
Current State: Avatar displaying 25% of Main Body's capability
Main Body Complexity and Purity: 6 Sextillion
Avatar Complexity and Purity: 1.5 Sextillion
Primary Authority: Civilizational Authority of Paradox
Active Principles: 3 Grand Principles detected - Paradoxical Manifestation, Reality Inversion, Quantum Superposition
Thr Avatar possesses limited duration outside THE Loom. Estimated operational time remaining: Unknown.
Protos processed this information calmly.
His words emerged through the communication channel shared exclusively among Primus Inevitabilities- glorious, disciplined, and
unwavering.

"Brothers and Sisters, heed my words. The enemy designated Aurelius Paradoxus possesses power exceeding ours individually by a factor of fifteen. His Civilizational Authority of Paradox is substantial, and three Grand Principles amplify his capabilities significantly."
His voice carried weight of a commander addressing his troops!
"However, this Avatar represents merely 25% of his main body's power. Our duty is clear- we must pressure him relentlessly until all of his existence burns under our Infinite Hunger!"
HUUUM!
His crimson eyes blazed.
"After the initial impact of this first wave between us, the pivotal
moment for us to oppress this much more powerful enemy will appear. Our numbers are our strength. Our coordination is our weapon. Our Infinite Hunger is our victory."
After delivering this assessment, his body began to pulse as he and all his Brothers and Sisters activated their Civilizational Resonance.
Their combined power had already covered everything in the grandeur of Mana and Hunger....painting over the paradoxical authority with obsidian-blue-and-gold radiance.
At this moment, while over 100 Billion Primordial Fireballs carrying
the decimation of 100+ Quintillion complexity each smashed onto
their enemy, Protos gave another order without pause.
They had to be relentless against their enemy.
Their enemy could not be allowed to breathe. Could not be allowed a
single moment to recover or counter-strategize.
"Impose your Hunger onto this enemy. Let them experience glimpse of what Infinite Hunger truly feels. Everyone...activate Hunger
Propagation immediately!"
The effects of Hunger Propagation were devastating in their
application.
To feel the hunger of 100,000 Primus Inevitabilities simultaneously...to experience that uncontrollable appetite that begins devouring one's
own power reserves from within...was to understand why this capability was going to be feared in the not so distant future.
It was not external assault.
It was internal sabotage.
The target's own existence would turn against itself, hunger
consuming power like fire consuming fuel.
Resources carefully accumulated would be devoured by appetite that had no satiation point.
The stronger the target's reserves, the more aggressively the imposed
hunger would attempt to consume them!
Below their encirclement, Aurelius Paradoxus, the Avatar of an Early Creature, had erupted with terrific power befitting an entity with 1.5 Sextillion Complexity and Purity.
Gloriously, his body shone with scintillating golden box of Paradox

that pulsed with concentrated Civilizational Authority. The paradoxical construct absorbed all incoming attacks...100 Billion Primordial Fireballs smashing against its surface and being negated through reality-defying mechanisms.
A paradoxical box that simultaneously existed and didn't exist, that
absorbed damage by making the damage paradoxically to "never have occurred."
This being was so powerful that he withstood the combined attack of 100,000 Primus Inevitabilities alone and appeared completely
unscathed!
Within that golden box, he looked up at all of them with hardened
gaze that carried recognition of threat but no fear.
It was the arrogance of someone who had faced countless lesser
beings and emerged victorious.
At that precise moment, he felt their imposed hunger.
And...
HUUM!
The radiant and infallible box of Paradox rapidly began to deteriorate
as if being consumed by his own internal hunger.
Golden light that had been solid and impenetrable started flickering,
sections dissolving as the Avatar's power reserves were being devoured from within by appetite that had no end.
His eyes pulsed with lividity as he recognized what was occurring. His own defenses were eating themselves, his Civilizational Authority being consumed by a hunger he could not control or dismiss!

chapters.title: Chapter 4452 Duty V
paragraphs: When Protos observed this deterioration, he knew the time had come for next phase.
His words rang out to his Brothers and Sisters.
"The enemy's defenses falter. His paradoxical barrier consumes itself. Be ready for a response. Maintain formation. Maintain duty!"
And in the next instant...
The Avatar opened his mouth and roared grandly with a sound that made surrounding existence tremble.
Protos analyzed the grandeur of 3 Grand Principles shining from this being...Paradoxical Manifestation, Reality Inversion, and Quantum Superposition overlapping on top of each other.
They amplified his Civilizational Authority of Paradox exponentially, each Principle feeding into the others to create multiplicative effect rather than additive.
And the product that came out...
BOOM!
The attack was cataclysmic in scope and devastating in intent.
Millions of golden paradoxical pillars of light surged upward toward the Primus Inevitabilities like forest of death growing instantly from below.
Each pillar crackled with concentrated Civilizational Authority of Paradox...golden light that seemed to burn reality itself with its
passage.
Half of them shockingly directed and concentrated toward Noah's and Ozymandias' positions specifically...as if the enemy knew exactly who he wanted to eliminate.
Time felt like it moved unfathomably slow as Protos gazed at this
attack approaching. Through the Master, he understood it!
In the span of single instant, he spoke to all Primus Inevitabilities present through their exclusive communication channel.

"Brothers and Sisters, observe the enemy's counter-assault. Designation: Schrodinger's Strike. Each golden pillar of paradox carries more than 1 Sextillion worth of damage, far exceeding our individual capabilities to withstand."
His voice remained steady despite the apocalyptic attack approaching.

"If touched by even one of these pillars, your existence will be forced into quantum paradox. You will become simultaneously 'dead' and 'alive'in the same state until reality is forced to choose one outcome. The forced choice will almost certainly result in harmful resolution, your existence unraveling as paradox resolves against your favor!"
His crimson eyes blazed with unwavering conviction.

"This attack is lethal. This attack is devastating. This attack seeks to eliminate us before we can fulfill our purpose. But I ask you now, Brothers and Sisters: does this attack exceed our duty? Does this assault surpass our purpose? Can paradoxical death prevent us from serving our Master?"

In that instant as the attack was coming, as the millions of golden pillars were racing toward them with lethal intent, in the communication channel only for the Primus Inevitabilities, all those present roared their reply with unified conviction!
"NEGATIVE! Our duty is absolute! Our purpose is infinite! We do not falter! We do not fear! We devour all obstacles! Death itself cannot exceed our duty to the Master!"
Protos then looked at the deadly attacks directed toward his Master with expression carrying protective fury.
"Then fulfill your duty. Activate Void Appetite!"
Void Appetite.
This terrifying capability represented one of the most devastating aspects of Infinite Hunger given tangible form.

At this moment, the 100,000 Primus Inevitabilities, alongside those in form of Civilizational Armor fused with Master's people, pulsed with obsidian-blue-and-gold-crimson light that erupted from their combined existence.
Brilliant stellar tentacled jaws manifested in the surroundings...and they were not physical constructs but conceptual weapons that could consume abstract concepts including damage itself!
Their hunger overlapped and resonated, creating zone of absolute consumption where anything that entered would be devoured.
These jaws crushed and bit down on the surging pillars of Paradox...the golden light that could deal 1 Sextillion damage each being met by Infinite Hunger that had no upper limit.
The glorious scene that unfolded was breathtaking in its significance.
The light of Paradox was being devoured by the jaws of Infinite
Hunger.
Golden pillars that had been racing toward them with lethal intent were intercepted by stellar tentacles that wrapped around them and
consumed their essence.
Many of the jaws shattered and broke under the intense light of Paradox, unable to fully contain power that exceeded their individual
capacity.
But even more replaced them instantly, Infinite Hunger regenerating faster than it could be destroyed.
In single nanosecond that felt like eternity, the millions of golden pillars of Paradox... were devoured by a gloriously endless appetite!
The attack that should have devastated their forces, that should have eliminated dozens of their number through paradoxical death, was consumed as fuel for their growth instead.
HUUM!
All the Primus Inevitabilities shone with glorious light of increased
power as down below, Aurelius Paradoxus looked up with blazing
eyes of absolute lividity.
From his powerful attack, his Schrodinger's Strike that should have been devastating, none of these weak creatures 15 times less powerful
than himself had even perished!
In fact... the light around them seemed to be getting stronger?
His expression shifted from anger to something approaching concerned recognition as he realized his attacks were feeding their growth rather than diminishing their numbers.
At such moment, Protos raised his sword commandingly as
he...bellowed out.
"What is our duty?!"
All Inevitabilities raised their swords in synchronized motion as they replied with unified voices!
"Our duty is to our Master! Our duty is absolute! Our duty is Infinite!"
Protos then boomed out his words with commanding authority.
"Then give the Master what you devoured! Channel all gained essence toward the Civilization!"
Prompts flashed before Protos.
Cataclysmic attack designated Schrodinger's Strike has been devoured by grand collective of Infinite Hunger.
Distribution parameters established by The Master:
All Primus Inevitabilities present on the battlefield gain +.1 Quintillion
Complexity and Purity each through the grace of the Master's
framework.
Only .01 Quintillion Complexity and Purity has been accepted by the
Master himself.
Remaining essence flows across the Civilization's Foundation
Palisades for collective advancement.
The Master demonstrates generous leadership by prioritizing his
forces over personal gain.
Protos turned around to gaze at the still armored visage of the Master
as his crimson eyes shone with blinding light of duty fulfilled. The Master could have taken all of it for himself. Could have absorbed the entire consumed attack to further his own power.
Instead, he distributed it among his forces while taking only modest portion for himself.
This was why Protos would serve until his existence ceased.
While looking at the Master with reverence that transcended simple
loyalty, he bellowed out with commanding authority. "Advance upon the enemy. Close the encirclement. Do not give him...even a moment to recover! Fulfill. Your. Duty!"
The moment he issued this command, the silence that had fallen over
the battlefield ended.
A new symphony bloomed across existence...not the melancholic melody from before, but something far more aggressive. The beat was high-paced, as if drums of existence were pounding to
the beat of rapid heart preparing for decisive confrontation. And this time, there wasn't grand chorus with flowing lyrics.
There were only two words that began to echo out with booming fervor as the Primus Inevitabilities' encirclement closed in tighter
around the Avatar.
"INFINITE!"
WAA!
"HUNGER!"
BOOM!
Infinite. Hunger.
Such words blazed across existence like alarm that could not be
ignored...a declaration of what they were and what they intended to
do.
In the next moment, the shields of all Primus Inevitabilities and the Civilizational Armored forces raised their defensive implements in synchronized motion.
From their shields, Primus Mana Arcana Glyphs activated with concentrated power.
In the next instant, more than 100,000 Primordial Primus Mana-Flame
Wyrms emerged from the activated Glyphs!

These were not simple manifestations or temporary constructs. They looked unfathomably real...creatures of concentrated authority given permanent form through the quality of Primus Mana. Each Wyrm possessed nine heads that pulsed with interminable grandeur, and each head bore jaws capable of releasing molten
Civilizational Authority.
The glorious sense of power and honor these Wyrms emitted was palpable...ancient creatures summoned to serve The Primordial Civilization of Mana and Hunger!
They... could remain active for a whole hour!
The Primus Mana quality made such grand thing possible! And
100,000 of them were called out at this moment as they encircled the Avatar alongside their summoners.
Each of their many jaws...more than 900,000 heads total, opened simultaneously as they roared out molten Civilizational Authority of Mana and Hunger toward the enemy!
BOOM!
"INFINITE!"
"HUNGER!"
The Symphony and Chorus picked up with increasing intensity as on
the ground, Aurelius Paradoxus roared angrily with a voice that made surrounding existence crack. "I bear the light of a glorious Civilization! You all... cannot compare to
what THE Loom has cultivated across eons! ONTOLOGICAL ANCHORING!"
BOOM!

They looked unfathomably real...creatures of concentrated authority given permanent form through the quality of Primus Mana.
Each Wyrm possessed nine heads that pulsed with interminable grandeur, and each head bore jaws capable of releasing molten
Civilizational Authority.
The glorious sense of power and honor these Wyrms emitted was palpable...ancient creatures summoned to serve The Primordial Civilization of Mana and Hunger!
They... could remain active for a whole hour!
The Primus Mana quality made such grand thing possible!
And
100,000 of them were called out at this moment as they encircled the Avatar alongside their summoners.
Each of their many jaws...more than 900,000 heads total, opened simultaneously as they roared out molten Civilizational Authority of Mana and Hunger toward the enemy!
BOOM!
"INFINITE!"
"HUNGER!"
The Symphony and Chorus picked up with increasing intensity as on
the ground, Aurelius Paradoxus roared angrily with a voice that made surrounding existence crack.
"I bear the light of a glorious Civilization!
You all... cannot compare to
what THE Loom has cultivated across eons!
ONTOLOGICAL ANCHORING!"
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4453 Olethros! I
paragraphs: Immense waves of Civilizational Authority of Paradox erupted from Aurelius Paradoxus...a golden light that expanded outward to form into sea of paradoxical power.
This golden sea rose to match and drown out all incoming attacks, attempting to negate their assault through fundamental reality manipulation.
In the surroundings, a different symphony started to bloom with the eruption of Civilizational Authority of Paradox- a competing melody that clashed with the drums of Hunger.
And accompanying this counter-melody:
"PARADOX!"
A booming singular word of Paradox threatened to drown out Hunger...trying to impose its authority over the battlefield through sheer weight of established Primordial Civilization!
Once more, Protos analyzed the threat and communicated to his forces

"This technique seeks to impose upon you and your abilities a self-negating truth. According to this paradox, you can only exist if you do not exist. The truth seeks to retroactively erase you and your abilities even before you existed...to make it so you never were."
"Does such a truth align with your duty?"
The short but grand synchronized reply of the Primus Inevitabilities rang out with absolute conviction.
"NO! Paradox cannot erase our duty!"
Protos' eyes shone brilliantly with glorious crimson light as he bellowed out the command.
"Then... FULFILL. YOUR. DUTY!"
BOOM!
Void Appetite erupted again with even greater intensity than before, Infinite Hunger responding to paradoxical assault with absolute consumption.
Oh!
The glorious jaws manifested throughout the golden sea, stellar tentacles wrapping around concentrated Civilizational Authority of Paradox and devouring it with methodical precision.
The paradox that sought to erase them was being consumed. The truth that claimed they could only exist if they didn't exist was being eaten by hunger that didn't care about logical contradictions.
Infinite Hunger devoured even paradoxes.
Ontological Anchoring has been systematically devoured by Infinite Hunger. Paradoxical truth negated through consumption rather than logical refutation.
All Primus Inevitabilities present gain +1.5 Quintillion Complexity and Purity.
The Master requests no portion of this harvest. All essence flows to his forces and Civilization.
The golden sea of Civilizational Authority of Paradox faded as it was devoured, and the attacks of 100,000 Wyrms descended with 900,000 heads worth of molten Civilizational Authority raining down.
Aurelius Paradoxus gazed at them coldly from below, his expression mixing fury with calmness.
The glorious scene that followed was devastating in its relentlessness.
The attacks landed on his body one by one...900,000 streams of molten Mana and Hunger crashing against his form with combined weight that exceeded even his substantial defenses.
He gazed at them coldly as his entire body shone golden with protective light...attempting to nullify all attacks as they smashed into him through paradoxical negation.
A staredown commenced between the Avatar and those above.
Aurelius looked toward Noah and Ozymandias with eyes that carried killing intent.

But the crimson eyes of Protos were the only thing that met his gaze... Protos staring down this being that was being bombarded with attacks of all his brethren while standing perfectly still between the enemy and his Master.
Aurelius was powerful, yes.
He was withstanding assault that would have devastated lesser beings. His Civilizational Authority of Paradox was genuine, his power
substantial.
But...
BZZT!
In the staredown, Protos observed the infallible golden glow of Paradox surrounding the Avatar dim slightly over time as... Infinite Hunger began to take bites from it!
The constant pressure, the relentless assault, the imposed hunger from within...all of it was accumulating damage that even 1.5 Sextillion
power could not indefinitely sustain.
The enemy was indeed powerful.
But before their hunger, before their Duty... he had to fall.
Protos deemed this with absolute certainty even as the Master communicated through their bond that soon, this Avatar would
receive aid from others just like him...with one being immensely powerful, far exceeding even Aurelius.
Protos accepted this information and was already prepared. Only 100,000 of his Brothers and Sisters were currently deployed.
1.9 Million were yet to be revealed from the glorious body of Ozymandias.
When the rest of the enemies came, and they would come, Protos would lead to fulfill his duty.
The glorious scene that unfolded would be remembered across
existence.

The encirclement around the Avatar closed in even deeper...100,000 Primus Inevitabilities with their 100,000 Wyrms creating zone of absolute consumption that pressed inward with inexorable force. Shockingly, terrifyingly, magnificently...a being with 1.5 Sextillion power was being offset by unique combination of numbers, Mana, and
Hunger!
One being watched it coldly.
He was Protos, First of the Primus Inevitabilities.
And at this moment...
"Finish it."
He gave a command that would determine the immediate future of
this battlefield.
A moment later, the terrifying scene unfolded. On the body of
Ozymandias floating grandly above, the chest flashed twice with deliberate pulsing...a signal that had been pre-arranged with his
Master.
Protos had already communicated extensively with Noah regarding the optimal approach for decimating their first true enemy.
For the sake of achieving overwhelming victory rather than costly
struggle, one had to be wise and strategic rather than simply
powerful.
When an animal was thrown with their back against the wall, it would
lash out with the strongest and most volatile response available. Aurelius Paradoxus was about to erupt with Everything...his full
remaining resources dedicated to devastating counter-attack against the forces he perceived as threatening him.
At such a moment, when he had mentally accounted for how to erupt
with sufficient power against the 100,000 terrifying Primus Inevitabilities surrounding him...
Protos gazed down coldly as in the next instant, 200,000 more Primus Inevitabilities materialized within the encirclement of Aurelius with synchronized precision!
The simple yet tactical brilliance was devastating.
Protos watched with continuing analytical curiosity as he observed
the eyes of this terrifying entity open wide with incredulity...the arrogance and calculated confidence fracturing into genuine shock as he realized the forces arrayed against him had just tripled.
And in that brief opening, in that instant where shock disrupted his
tactical planning...
Hunger Propagation was activated by all newly appearing 200,000
Primus Inevitabilities to layer onto the Hunger Propagation that was already imposed upon this being.

While he had prepared and acclimated to throw a last-second volatile attack sufficient to devastate 100,000 entities, 200,000 more appeared and imposed their terrifying Infinite Hunger upon him! The effect was catastrophic!

chapters.title: Chapter 4454 Olethros! II
paragraphs: The brilliant golden light of Paradox that had been surrounding his body, the protective barrier that had withstood millions of Primordial Fireballs....was instantly devoured by his own being as the
accumulated hunger from 300,000 Primus Inevitabilities exceeded any threshold his existence could manage.
The terrifying scene that followed would haunt any observer who witnessed it.

This entity of immense power...1.5 Sextillion Complexity and Purity, bearer of Civilizational Authority of Paradox, Avatar of an Early Creature from THE Loom...lost his protections as his uncontrollable appetite devoured his own existence from within.
His defenses didn't break.
They were consumed by hunger that recognized no distinction between self and other, between friendly power and hostile attack.
And the moment that the influence of his Civilizational Authority was gone, the instant his golden barrier collapsed into nothing through internal consumption...
Protos took a single step.
And in the next moment appeared directly in front of Aurelius Paradoxus with velocity.
Defenseless. Shocked. Not knowing how what was happening could possibly be occurring...his tactical calculations shattered, his arrogance replaced by genuine fear.
At such moment, the sword in Protos' hand flashed with blinding speed to sink into the chest of Aurelius that possessed no remaining defenses.
The hollow blade pierced through flesh and essence with equal ease, and the Primordial Fireballs spinning within the blade's center
erupted into his internal existence.
A horror-inducing scene followed as Protos grasped the head of Aurelius Paradoxus with his other hand...the fucking grip suggesting absolute domination rather than simple combat advantage.
He whispered coldly with voice that carried no malice, only tactical assessment.
"Next time, try to bring your main body or someone significantly stronger than you are. You fought decently for what you possessed. But decently is insufficient."
BOOM!

With such words, Protos shouldered the Civilizational Resonance of all Primus Inevitabilities present...their combined hunger flowing through him as focal point, as a living weapon wielding the accumulated appetite of 300,000 beings.
His Infinite Hunger erupted out ravenously as in the next moment, the pierced chest Aurelius began collapsing into an Event Horizon centered upon the blade embedded within him.
The hollow center of Protos' sword, filled with countless Primordial Fireballs, became a point of absolute consumption as Aurelius' existence began spiraling inward.
And in the next instant, muscle, bone, and entire body of Aurelius collapsed into Protos' blade!
He was not destroyed or killed through conventional means.
He was devoured!

The Avatar of Aurelius Paradoxus was systematically consumed....his 1.5 Sextillion Complexity and Purity becoming fuel for the Primus Inevitabilities' growth, his Civilizational Authority of Paradox being harvested as resource for advancement!
Immense silence instantly settled across the battlefield at such terrifying scene.
An entity 15 times more powerful than each individual Primus Inevitability had been collapsed
If they had erred at any moment during the engagement, if Protos had miscalculated or hesitated, multiple of their brethren could have been killed or severely damaged.
But Protos had led tremendously under the brilliance of the Master's guidance!
They had climbed a glorious mountain fifteen times grander than their individual capabilities and systematically collapsed it through Infinite Hunger.
In the silence, Protos simply raised his blade with casual motion as if he had not accomplished anything particularly remarkable.
He gave another command with a voice carrying a matter-of-fact authority.
"Turn this Desiccated Shore upside down. Find the Vessel that creature was protecting. Leave nothing unchecked. Fulfill your duty."
BOOM!

As if they had not just accomplished unprecedented victory against overwhelmingly superior individual opponent, the 300,000 Primus Inevitabilities here instantly transformed into streaks of obsidian-blue-and-gold light that pervaded across the Desiccated Sleeping Shore!
They moved with methodical efficiency...groups of thousands sweeping through territories, investigating structures, probing hidden spaces with enhanced perception!
Protos' body trembled with immense complexity at this moment as what he had devoured was far, far too pristine.
The concentrated essence of an Avatar bearing Civilizational Authority
of Paradox was unlike anything he had consumed before.
He turned toward his Master...wanting to offer this grand complexity he had just hungered to Noah, wanting to demonstrate that all gains belonged ultimately to the Civilization rather than individual
advancement.
But before he could articulate such offer...
Prompts bloomed with systematic precision.
All hungered harvest has been amplified by Perpetual Harvest. All
effort carried out by all forces present has been amplified by Perpetual Harvest's multiplicative capabilities.
All collective harvest including the decimation and complete devouring of Aurelius Paradoxus has been systematically distributed according to optimal advancement parameters outlined by The Master.
50% has been deemed to be solely claimed by Protos, The First Primus Inevitability, in recognition of his exemplary leadership and
execution.
50% flows into the Foundation Palisades for collective Civilizational
advancement.
This distribution ensures both individual excellence is rewarded and collective framework is strengthened simultaneously.
Protos trembled as in the next moment, he felt his existence buzzing with unprecedented intensity as his Complexity and Purity began surging upward with momentum that suggested no immediate ceiling.
Additional prompts detailed the magnitude!
Your Complexity and Purity has increased by 500 Quintillion after
such grand harvest. The effort of defeating and devouring Aurelius Paradoxus, amplified by Perpetual Harvest, has yielded exceptional
returns.]
Your total Complexity and Purity now exceeds 600 Quintillion.
You have become substantially more powerful than your Brothers
and Sisters through meritorious service. Keep it up.
BOOM!
The glorious scene that followed was visible to all present.
The body of Protos became twice as large...his form expanding to accommodate the concentrated power now flowing through his
existence.
The air that radiated from him carried brutality alongside discipline, predatory hunger alongside absolute loyalty!
His presence had transformed from merely formidable to genuinely overwhelming...a being that could now challenge enemies far exceeding his previous capabilities.
And yet even as he emanated such terrifying aura of accumulated
power...
He knelt toward the Master with a gesture mixing reverence and absolute dedication.
"I will burn Existence for you, Master! My power is your power! My existence serves your Civilization! Command me, and it shall be done!"
