chapters.title: Chapter 4455 Olethros! III
paragraphs: It was a terrifying and swift execution.
Noah watched all of it silently as he only gave a few commands and allowed Protos to execute decisions independently.

The coordination and movements of these terrifying Weapons of his Civilization operated smoothly and grandly when they were left to carry out their orders while being led by singular commanding entity.

That entity was either Protos or his form of Ozymandias...both of whom could fully tap into the communication channels connecting all Primus Inevitabilities and move as one unified force rather than scattered individuals.
So he only nodded with satisfaction as he saw Protos kneeling while his body pulsed with 600 Quintillion Complexity and Purity...power that now positioned him as a decently formidable threat!
As for himself...
Prompts materialized detailing his own advancement.

An immense quantity of harvest is flowing into the Foundation Palisades. The quality of this harvest is unfathomable as it contains substantial concentration of The Primordial Civilizational Authority of Paradox.

Protection threshold from Foundation Palisades has increased from 500 Quintillion to 1,000 Quintillion Complexity and Purity. Any entity wishing to harm your existence must now exceed this threshold while also being member of established Civilization.
Boon from Minor Mana and Hunger Palisades has increased from 45 Quintillion to 95 Quintillion Complexity and Purity for all 81 blessed recipients.]
Your personal Complexity and Purity has reached 500 Quintillion through accumulated advancement.
When paired with your fused Primus Inevitability, Protos, who stands at 600 Quintillion, you have officially crossed the barrier of 1,000 Quintillion Complexity and Purity.
The major requirement for one to be considered in the Sextillions designation is the attainment and practical usage of Civilizational Authority. Such requirement has long since been met.|
At this moment, your combined Complexity and Purity stands at 1.1 Sextillion.
1.1 Sextillion!
The monumental marker that separated ordinary beings from those who could utilize Civilizational Authority!
To be given the Quintillion designation, one had to be walking on a Way of Existence- whether pioneered or following an established one.
The next demarcation needed Civilizational Authority as Noah had attained it!
Noah's calm and tyrannical weavings pulsed emerged as he processed this achievement.
The milestone was significant, certainly...representing crossing into territory that few outside THE Loom had reached.
But even achieving it, he only took moment to compose himself before his mind immediately moved forward.
"More."
More!
Because he would truly need much more than this. The Avatars from THE Loom would continue coming. THE Dead Order was mobilizing her forces.

THE Living Paradox himself possessed power that made 1.1 Sextillion seem utterly laughable as THE Living Paradox himself could still crush him whether he had 1 Sextillion or 100 Sextillion or 1,000 Sextillion....the number did not matter to THE!
This was why he was moving so quickly to collapse his Vessels while Existence suppressed him!
He needed exponentially more power if he genuinely intended to challenge the established order.
In the next moment, a burst of commotion erupted as brilliant blue-gold light of Primus Mana and obsidian-crimson light of Hunger pulsed intensely.

In front of Noah, Protos appeared alongside two other Primus Inevitabilities as they were dragging... an unconscious entity whose body was surrounded by paradoxical flames and frost simultaneously! Shockingly, this being was enveloped by unique paradoxical light that suggested he was slumbering and never meant to wake...caught in quantum superposition between consciousness and oblivion.
Noah looked at him with recognition blooming immediately.
Of course this entity was...a slumbering Schrodinger! The unique light of Paradox surrounding him would seemingly take some effort to break down through conventional means.
But at this moment, Khor floated down from Noah's shoulder as she looked coldly at the slumbering body of Schrodinger.
She quietly said single word.
"Outsider."
A single word, but Noah knew exactly what she meant...what she was
asking permission to do.
So he nodded lightly with gesture of approval.
In the next moment...
The First Hunger opened her mouth... and took a glorious bite.
A single bite.
And horrifically, existence itself twisted around the area where the slumbering Living Elemental Body of Schrodinger rested. This body and the surrounding existence became...collapsed!
BOOM!
Without hesitation and moving with quickness that suggested
urgency, one of the vessels of THE Living Paradox was systematically
collapsed!
She was so much stronger than before.
So much grander!
A bite was all it took!
The figure of The First Hunger pulsed with interminable brilliance in
the next moment, as if her hunger had devoured something unfathomably grand that resonated with her fundamental nature.
Prompts appeared detailing the consequences.
The First Hunger becomes stronger as Hunger across existence becomes stronger. The symbiotic relationship between subject Khor and the Primordial Civilization of Mana and Hunger continues
deepening.
Subject Khor has entered period of exponential growth. The consumption of a Vessel of THE Living Paradox has provided
exceptional harvest.

The First Hunger has successfully reclaimed the 1 Sextillion threshold and proceeds ahead gloriously toward restoration of her original power. It is distant. It is unfathomably far. But THE is possible. THE is
possible.
Khor also took step forward as her existence digested the Vessel of
THE Living Paradox with methodical efficiency!
It was terrifying progression of events when one properly accounted
for thr timeline.
Within matter of seconds, Noah had arrived with his army. Within
additional seconds, he had collapsed an Avatar holding 1.5 Sextillion Complexity and Purity.
Within another few seconds, his armies had scoured the Desiccated
Sleeping Shore and obtained the Vessel of THE Living Paradox.

And the Vessel was collapsed immediately upon discovery! The speed was devastating...leaving no opportunity for enemy reinforcements to arrive in time to prevent what they had been assigned to protect.
And only after another second passed, did Noah raise his head as he
looked upward with an expression mixing anticipation and cold
satisfaction.
His words emerged with a casual observation.
"You arrived a second too late, Ambessa. A single second, and you
might have been able to accomplish something meaningful...
BOOM!
His words echoed out just as the skies split apart with dramatic
violence!
Eight terrifying auras descended with presence that made surrounding existence tremble.
These auras were genuinely horrifying as they matched or exceeded
Aurelius Paradoxus significantly, each one burning with 1.5 to 2 Sextillion worth of authority.
But one aura exceeded all of them combined!
Oh!

sentences.text: It was a terrifying and swift execution.
Noah watched all of it silently as he only gave a few commands and allowed Protos to execute decisions independently.

The coordination and movements of these terrifying Weapons of his Civilization operated smoothly and grandly when they were left to carry out their orders while being led by singular commanding entity.

That entity was either Protos or his form of Ozymandias...both of whom could fully tap into the communication channels connecting all Primus Inevitabilities and move as one unified force rather than scattered individuals.
So he only nodded with satisfaction as he saw Protos kneeling while his body pulsed with 600 Quintillion Complexity and Purity...power that now positioned him as a decently formidable threat!
As for himself...
Prompts materialized detailing his own advancement.
An immense quantity of harvest is flowing into the Foundation Palisades.
The quality of this harvest is unfathomable as it contains substantial concentration of The Primordial Civilizational Authority of Paradox.
Protection threshold from Foundation Palisades has increased from 500 Quintillion to 1,000 Quintillion Complexity and Purity.
Any entity wishing to harm your existence must now exceed this threshold while also being member of established Civilization.
Boon from Minor Mana and Hunger Palisades has increased from 45 Quintillion to 95 Quintillion Complexity and Purity for all 81 blessed recipients.]
Your personal Complexity and Purity has reached 500 Quintillion through accumulated advancement.
When paired with your fused Primus Inevitability, Protos, who stands at 600 Quintillion, you have officially crossed the barrier of 1,000 Quintillion Complexity and Purity.
The major requirement for one to be considered in the Sextillions designation is the attainment and practical usage of Civilizational Authority.
Such requirement has long since been met.|
At this moment, your combined Complexity and Purity stands at 1.1 Sextillion.
1.1 Sextillion!
The monumental marker that separated ordinary beings from those who could utilize Civilizational Authority!
To be given the Quintillion designation, one had to be walking on a Way of Existence- whether pioneered or following an established one.
The next demarcation needed Civilizational Authority as Noah had attained it!
Noah's calm and tyrannical weavings pulsed emerged as he processed this achievement.
The milestone was significant, certainly...representing crossing into territory that few outside THE Loom had reached.
But even achieving it, he only took moment to compose himself before his mind immediately moved forward.
"More."
More!
Because he would truly need much more than this.
The Avatars from THE Loom would continue coming.
THE Dead Order was mobilizing her forces.

THE Living Paradox himself possessed power that made 1.1 Sextillion seem utterly laughable as THE Living Paradox himself could still crush him whether he had 1 Sextillion or 100 Sextillion or 1,000 Sextillion....the number did not matter to THE!
This was why he was moving so quickly to collapse his Vessels while Existence suppressed him!
He needed exponentially more power if he genuinely intended to challenge the established order.
In the next moment, a burst of commotion erupted as brilliant blue-gold light of Primus Mana and obsidian-crimson light of Hunger pulsed intensely.
In front of Noah, Protos appeared alongside two other Primus Inevitabilities as they were dragging... an unconscious entity whose body was surrounded by paradoxical flames and frost simultaneously!
Shockingly, this being was enveloped by unique paradoxical light that suggested he was slumbering and never meant to wake...caught in quantum superposition between consciousness and oblivion.
Noah looked at him with recognition blooming immediately.
Of course this entity was...a slumbering Schrodinger!
The unique light of Paradox surrounding him would seemingly take some effort to break down through conventional means.
But at this moment, Khor floated down from Noah's shoulder as she looked coldly at the slumbering body of Schrodinger.
She quietly said single word.
"Outsider."
A single word, but Noah knew exactly what she meant...what she was
asking permission to do.
So he nodded lightly with gesture of approval.
In the next moment...
The First Hunger opened her mouth... and took a glorious bite.
A single bite.
And horrifically, existence itself twisted around the area where the slumbering Living Elemental Body of Schrodinger rested.
This body and the surrounding existence became...collapsed!
BOOM!
Without hesitation and moving with quickness that suggested
urgency, one of the vessels of THE Living Paradox was systematically
collapsed!
She was so much stronger than before.
So much grander!
A bite was all it took!
The figure of The First Hunger pulsed with interminable brilliance in
the next moment, as if her hunger had devoured something unfathomably grand that resonated with her fundamental nature.
Prompts appeared detailing the consequences.
The First Hunger becomes stronger as Hunger across existence becomes stronger.
The symbiotic relationship between subject Khor and the Primordial Civilization of Mana and Hunger continues
deepening.
Subject Khor has entered period of exponential growth.
The consumption of a Vessel of THE Living Paradox has provided
exceptional harvest.
The First Hunger has successfully reclaimed the 1 Sextillion threshold and proceeds ahead gloriously toward restoration of her original power.
It is distant.
It is unfathomably far.
But THE is possible.
THE is
possible.
Khor also took step forward as her existence digested the Vessel of
THE Living Paradox with methodical efficiency!
It was terrifying progression of events when one properly accounted
for thr timeline.
Within matter of seconds, Noah had arrived with his army.
Within
additional seconds, he had collapsed an Avatar holding 1.5 Sextillion Complexity and Purity.
Within another few seconds, his armies had scoured the Desiccated
Sleeping Shore and obtained the Vessel of THE Living Paradox.
And the Vessel was collapsed immediately upon discovery!
The speed was devastating...leaving no opportunity for enemy reinforcements to arrive in time to prevent what they had been assigned to protect.
And only after another second passed, did Noah raise his head as he
looked upward with an expression mixing anticipation and cold
satisfaction.
His words emerged with a casual observation.
"You arrived a second too late, Ambessa.
A single second, and you
might have been able to accomplish something meaningful...
BOOM!
His words echoed out just as the skies split apart with dramatic
violence!
Eight terrifying auras descended with presence that made surrounding existence tremble.
These auras were genuinely horrifying as they matched or exceeded
Aurelius Paradoxus significantly, each one burning with 1.5 to 2 Sextillion worth of authority.
But one aura exceeded all of them combined!
Oh!

chapters.title: Chapter 4456 Olethros! IV
paragraphs: Ambessa!
She appeared at this moment with a presence that commanded attention.
Her radiant crimson-gold eyes surveyed the battlefield, taking in the 300,000 Primus Inevitabilities, the absence of Aurelius, the collapsed Vessel that should have been protected.
She wore pink bloomers and white tank top that somehow appeared regal rather than casual through sheer force of her bearing.
Her crimson-gold hair flowed like banner of authority, and her expression carried no fear...only cold calculation of changed circumstances.
The moment she fully manifested, existence pulsed. A calm and valor-filled Symphony echoed out as from surrounding reality itself, one could hear...
"AMBESSA!"
"AMBESSA!"
Her very name was being echoed by surrounding existence...acknowledgment of her significance!
This terrifying being looked down toward Noah as Noah gazed back with equal intensity.
She and the rest of the Avatars had likely been securing other Vessels of Schrodinger scattered across different territories, just as Aurelius had been assigned to protect this one.
Noah looked at her calmly and saw her details with perfect clarity through his enhanced perception.
Illusory Reality Avatar of Existence
Designation: Ambessa - Early Creature of THE Loom
Current State: Avatar displaying 50% of Main Body's capability
Main Body Complexity and Purity: 10 Sextillion
Avatar Complexity and Purity: 5 Sextillion
Primary Authority: Civilizational Authority of Paradox
Active Principles: 5 Grand Principles detected - surpassing Aurelius significantly
Exceptional combat capability. Exceeds parameters of all other Avatars present. Primary threat designation.
5 Sextillion.
Immensely high.
Gloriously powerful!
The others around her ranged from 1.5 Sextillion to 2 Sextillion at most, while she alone stood at 5 Sextillion...more powerful than several of them combined.
At this moment, she delivered her grand introduction as she looked toward Noah.

"I will normally begin by asking whether you comprehend just who you stand against, what consequences follow from opposing THE Loom. And yet you seem to understand this full well, and you still carried out the actions that you did. Am I correct to assume that we are not going to receive opportunity for diplomatic discourse?"

She articulated such words calmly as all around her, terrifying concentration of Civilizational Authority of Paradox began gathering....golden light that made surrounding existence warp in recognition of her power.
At her words, Noah gave light nod with an expression carrying finality.

"No. We will not be receiving opportunity for conversation. You came to protect Vessels. We are trying to collapse them. Our objectives are mutually exclusive, which means only force will determine outcome."
The moment his words concluded...
The glorious scene that unfolded would be remembered as demonstration of overwhelming numerical superiority properly applied.
All around the newly appearing Avatars, hundreds of thousands of Primus Inevitabilities bloomed into existence with synchronized
precision!
In addition to the 300,000 currently deployed, 700,000 more appeared through spatial tears and surrounded the eight Avatars in perfect formation!
Their heavy and calm crimson eyes stared at their enemies with hunger that transcended simple appetite.
The scene itself was utterly glorious and magisterial...a demonstration that Noah possessed resources exceeding anything the Avatars had
anticipated.
Ambessa's expression remained calm as she prepared to ask: Is this all?
But before she could even articulate the question...
In the space above where the Avatars had appeared...
BOOM!
Hunger tore space open with violent authority as Ozymandias' chest
flickered with brilliant light. And a million more Primus Inevitabilities appeared far above the battlefield!
Heavy and immense silence settled down all around!
2 Million Primus Inevitabilities.
Each one possessing 100+ Quintillion Complexity and Purity at
baseline.
One far exceeding it.
Each one wielding Civilizational Authority of Mana and Hunger.
Each one capable of Hunger Propagation, Void Appetite, Civilizational Resonance, and other devastating capabilities.
All of them... coordinated under singular command structure.
All of them hungry.
Infinitely hungry.
Noah observed this scene with his eyes releasing a silent command to
his general through their bond.
And in the next moment, Protos voiced out coldly with authority.
"Fulfill your duty."
The Primus Inevitabilities pulsed silently.
All of them in their similar glorious armored states, crimson eyes of
Infinite Hunger fixed upon their eight enemies, gazed downward with
synchronized focus.
With unity and glory... their Hunger Propagation and Void Appetite crashed down onto their enemies simultaneously!
HUUM!
And alongside this terrifying exertion of hunger....
"DUTY!"
Their voices echoed across existence as alongside such concentrated
assault, they waved their swords and shields with synchronized
motion.
Their swords shone with obsidian-blue light interwoven with crimson...hollow blades with Primordial Fireballs spinning within their
centers.
Their shields gleamed with gold interwoven with blue...surfaces
inscribed with Primus Mana Arcana Glyphs that pulsed with
concentrated authority.
From 2 Million swords, 1 Million Primordial Fireballs each bloomed
outward!
That was... 2 Trillion Primordial Fireballs filling surrounding existence with concentrated destructive potential!
And alongside them, the Shields of Primus Mana and Hunger flashed
as 2 Million unfathomably real Primordial Primus Mana-Flame Wyrms manifested.
Each one pulsed with Civilizational Authority of Mana and Hunger as their nine heads opened simultaneously to release terrifying blasts
toward the enemies!
The combined assault was so immense and terrifying and unfathomably numerous that the entirety of surrounding existence seemed to be filled with nothing but the brilliance of Mana and
Hunger.
So much concentrated authority in such vast quantities that it felt like
existence itself was...lagging.
Lagging!
Reality struggling to process the sheer volume of simultaneous
attacks being executed... as if the surrounding existence couldn't
handle this density of destructive potential occupying identical space!
Oh!
And at the center of all of this apocalyptic assault were eight Avatars facing utterly devastating attack.
They were immensely powerful, yes.
Ambessa alone possessed 5 Sextillion Complexity and Purity...far
exceeding what Aurelius had wielded.
But how exactly would they emerge from the other side when so

many waves of Infinite Hunger were waiting for them?! The drums of existence pounded with anticipation. And the Primus Inevitabilities waited with hungry eyes to see what would remain after their duty was fulfilled.
Immensity crashed down and collapsed, and existence wept at the
results!

chapters.title: Chapter 4457 Olethros! V
paragraphs: Casualties in war were unavoidable.
The strongest commanders knew this fundamental truth.
Because war was not pretty or kind...no matter how eloquent the speeches justifying it, no matter how noble the cause supposedly driving it.
Despite how one planned and strategized and executed everything with immense calculation considering every possibility... they would inevitably discover that their enemy had done exactly the same.
Even in the most glorious victories, there would be losses. Bodies that would not rise. Existences that would cease. Names that would be mourned.
This was the inescapable weaving of conflict.
At this moment.
In the Desiccated Sleeping Shore.
The skyspace above had transformed into region of molten authority and systematic collapse as existence itself had been fractured and torn through concentrated application of overwhelming force.
Rivers and seas of molten Primus Mana and Hunger spread gorgeously through the wounded sky...obsidian-blue and
crimson-gold currents flowing like arterial blood from a body that had been grievously injured.
The molten currents created patterns that suggested both beauty and devastation, artistic destruction on scale that transcended
comprehension!
The molten skies were littered with hundreds of thousands of figures of Primus Inevitabilities that were all gazing downward with cold eyes.
Their crimson stares fixed upon the aftermath of battle that had
tested them for first time since their emergence.
In some regions of the skies, there existed massive blinking singularities shining the colors of Mana and Hunger.
At least nine Primus Inevitabilities surrounded each singularity as if engaged in grand ritual...their forms creating protective formations around something precious that required safeguarding.
Dozens of such singularities could be observed across this grand domain, each one pulsing with rhythmic intensity.

And yet, down below, it seemed as if existence was still reeling and struggling to stabilize...as if being put to fundamental test regarding how much devastation reality could absorb before collapsing entirely.
Because at this moment, a terrifying battle had concluded in less than one minute after it began.
Noah stood on the gray sands of this Desiccated Shore, his crimson visor-covered eyes piercing as they surveyed the battlefield.
On his shoulders, Khor also gazed upward as the two of them looked at the singularities.
Those singularities represented... collapse of Primus Inevitabilities! They represented casualties.
There was heavy silence that settled across the domain as the surroundings where eight descended Avatars should have been visible showed only devastation.
Seven of them could not be perceived anywhere...consumed entirely through Infinite Hunger.
The only one currently visible in surrounding existence was none other than Ambessa.
Her appearance was devastating testimony to the battle's intensity.
Her attire- pink bloomers and white tank top that had appeared so casual yet regal, now looked torn and shredded.
Her body lay deeply embedded in the center of point of impact on the gray sands, the crater suggesting she had been driven downward with catastrophic force.

Across her radiant form, countless small wounds showed bleeding Civilizational Authority of Paradox...golden light seeping from injuries. All around her, 2 Million Primus Inevitabilities surrounded her and imposed their terrifying hunger onto her existence with coordinated precision.
At this moment, she could not even move...her 5 Sextillion power completely suppressed through sheer weight of accumulated Hunger Propagation.
That was how devastating the battle had been.

The only other entities visible in the surroundings were the very real figures of Primordial Primus Mana-Flame Wyrms who floated with terrifying eyes, their nine heads per Wyrm swiveling as if still ready for additional enemies to descend.
Noah looked at such scene as prompts appeared before him.
Infinite Hunger has revealed a unique quality about its weavings of existence.

It has been determined that 124 Primus Inevitabilities faced collapse during engagement with Ambessa. Her 5 Sextillion power combined with 5 Grand Principles allowed her to systematically eliminate targets despite overwhelming numerical disadvantage.
However: Primus Inevitabilities within your Civilization burning with Infinite Hunger will have their identity in existence preserved within the collective Infinite Hunger.

These collapsed existences will be systematically reborn within 24-hour period in the Sanctuaries of Inevitabilities with half of their original power. The Collapse due to Civilizational Authority that would normally devastate one's foundation and potentially prevent resurrection is negated through grandeur of Infinite Hunger.
This capability is nullified should you, The Leader of The Primordial Civilization of Mana and Hunger, is ever collapsed by another
Civilizational Authority.
These prompts were radiant in their implications...transforming what should have been devastating casualties into temporary setbacks that would be systematically corrected.
After reviewing this information, Noah commandingly allowed such knowledge to spread through the communication channels connecting all Primus Inevitabilities.
The moment this revelation propagated through their collective consciousness, all of these terrifying titanic entities turned to look toward him with brilliant crimson eyes that blazed with renewed
fervor.
Protos nearby raised his fist high as he bellowed out.
"Under the light of Infinite Hunger, the dead may never die! Our
Brothers and Sisters will return! Our Civilization cannot be
diminished through simple collapse!"
HUUM!
The others in response to his declaration raised their fists with glory
and purpose as they roared out in synchronized chorus.
"THE DEAD MAY NEVER DIE! THE DEAD MAY NEVER DIE!" Crimson winds of Hunger and accumulated complexity raged across
the battlefield as at this moment, Noah turned his gaze toward the
only remaining Avatar.
The other seven had fallen either to him personally or to Ozymandias, Khor, or Protos...with them dealing finishing blows after systematic weakening through coordinated assault.
All seven had their existences collapsed into Event Horizons of concentrated Hunger, with every single aspect of what they were being systematically harvested.

At this moment, this harvest was being amplified by Perpetual Harvest...waiting for final addition from the strongest among their enemies before it would be distributed across the Civilization. And so Noah turned his attention toward the enemy who was the reason for the casualties of Primus Inevitabilities despite
overwhelming numerical advantage.

Ambessa! Noah's glorious titanic armored form...radiant with obsidian-blue-and-gold-crimson light, the Sword and Shield of Hunger and Mana gleaming in his hands...walked toward the crater that contained the enemy who had withstood Hunger Propagation and Void Appetite with such immensity that even her attacks squeezed through gaps in their assault to instantly collapse dozens of Primus Inevitabilities.
Ambessa's glorious body lay sprawled on the gray sands of the Desiccated Sleeping Shore, her neck mangled from devastating strike, her chest caved in from concentrated impact.
She turned her head with visible effort to stare toward Protos and
Noah's approaching figure.

Even though the current situation seemed utterly dreadful and her body was systematically failing, her eyes were immensely calm and even filled with light of genuine curiosity rather than fear or rage.
After all, these were just Avatars of beings who remained safely within THE Loom.

Noah expected substantial damage to be inflicted upon their main bodies due to his Civilizational Authority of Mana and Hunger devouring their projected forms, but toward such powerful beings even this damage might prove negligible.
Was this the reason for how remarkably laid back she currently
appeared? Her calm and grand words emerged as she actually looked around at the surrounding devastated existence.
"How has life been outside THE Loom? I received opportunity to

observe briefly after we descended, but it was not truly sufficient time to satisfy my curiosity. I have always wondered how things have unfolded since we entered...how many eons have passed, what has changed, whether anything recognizable remains."

Noah's glorious titanic armored form...radiant with obsidian-blue-and-gold-crimson light, the Sword and Shield of Hunger and Mana gleaming in his hands...walked toward the crater that contained the enemy who had withstood Hunger Propagation and Void Appetite with such immensity that even her attacks squeezed through gaps in their assault to instantly collapse dozens of Primus Inevitabilities.
Ambessa's glorious body lay sprawled on the gray sands of the Desiccated Sleeping Shore, her neck mangled from devastating strike, her chest caved in from concentrated impact.
She turned her head with visible effort to stare toward Protos and
Noah's approaching figure.

Even though the current situation seemed utterly dreadful and her body was systematically failing, her eyes were immensely calm and even filled with light of genuine curiosity rather than fear or rage.
After all, these were just Avatars of beings who remained safely within THE Loom.

Noah expected substantial damage to be inflicted upon their main bodies due to his Civilizational Authority of Mana and Hunger devouring their projected forms, but toward such powerful beings even this damage might prove negligible.
Was this the reason for how remarkably laid back she currently
appeared?
Her calm and grand words emerged as she actually looked around at the surrounding devastated existence.
"How has life been outside THE Loom?
I received opportunity to
observe briefly after we descended, but it was not truly sufficient time to satisfy my curiosity.
I have always wondered how things have unfolded since we entered...how many eons have passed, what has changed, whether anything recognizable remains."

chapters.title: Chapter 4458 Civilization Specialization I
paragraphs: At such unexpectedly casual words, Noah came forward in his armored form and squatted down while looking at Ambessa closely.
His reply emerged with an edge of skepticism.

"Curious? Why maintain curiosity for lands your people will systematically raze and devour all lifeforms from? Lands that actually used to be your home before you abandoned them for THE Loom's structured safety?"
Ambessa nodded with an expression of genuine nostalgia.

"Mmm, I do miss the First Folds. Everything felt...new. Grand in ways that structured existence cannot replicate. THE Loom is magnificent in its organization...everything there is designed with meticulous purpose and immensity."
Her eyes grew distant

"But the First Folds as I remember them felt... grand precisely because there could be many things happening which seemingly had no purpose. There was factor of unknown. Factor of lack of control. Chaos that could produce unexpected beauty or unexpected horror. Perhaps I'm simply nostalgic for something I haven't experienced in eons. But regardless..."
Her expression sharpened.
"Be ready. We were sent out here as experimental deployment. With your response, with you collapsing eight Avatars including myself, it is no longer experiment, but declaration of war."

"You have wounded the pride of powerful beings within THE Loom who are unaccustomed to facing resistance. Oh, and you messed up them trying to suck up to THE Esteemed Paradox. They will not wait patiently for the Fallout. They will mobilize an unfathomable more to crush what dared to spit on their pride."

Noah nodded with an expression acknowledging the warning, while internally celebrating as he needed food for his Infinite Hunger! "Hmm. You seem somewhat interesting compared to expectations. I anticipated someone as powerful as you to be shouting and raging and raving about how Civilizational Authority of Paradox will rain devastation upon us. How we will all burn under the grandeur of established Primordial Civilization. But...even as I am about to collapse you... you maintain a mindset to converse freely and calmly."
His crimson visor fixed upon her with calculating intensity.
"Want to do something unpredictable like...betray your Civilization?"
Noah articulated such words with cool directness as Ambessa laughed, the sound mixing genuine amusement with resignation!

"You magnificent fucker. I genuinely admire you for being one of the leaders of whatever Civilization has emerged out here. Infinite Hunger, is it? Is it a Derivative of the Collapsed Civilization of Hunger? Oh well..."

"Any entities capable of leading are typically grand...Elderborns, those bearing concentrated Everythings of THE Creature himself... However grand you are personally, I'm not placing my confidence in your victory. You will likely face collapse very soon once a proper response is mobilized. So this was entertaining, but that concludes my involvement...for now anyway. I'll probably be sent again because of how tight of a fit I am in this scenario...
She thought he was one of the leaders of whatever grand Civilization had collapsed her and the other Avatars.

And that was far more believable idea to grasp....that there existed some grand hidden Civilization that had bloomed outside THE Loom over the eons, that whoever led it was someone utterly astonishing.

One might find it easier to believe that perhaps this Civilization was a Derivative of Hunger or even carrying weavings of THE Creature himself or representing one of the Collapsed Civilizations that had somehow reconstituted itself.
This was exponentially easier to believe than the reality...that it was a human who had been a weak, manaless being less than three years
ago!
At such thought, Noah couldn't help but pause and metaphorically blink as he truly contemplated the timeline himself.
Three years.
Had it truly been almost that duration since he awakened?
Three years felt simultaneously unimaginably short and impossibly long because during that period he had played with time dilation and other temporal manipulations constantly.
So that number could be stretched up or down.
But in the objective passage of approximately three years, he had progressed unfathomably far from where he began.

When he was initially rising through his first Apocalypse, one of his foundational ideals was refusing to remain so weak that he could be existing peacefully in his world or realm when a terrifying power or cataclysm descended without him being aware.

He had rejected the possibility of facing complete collapse without understanding or even knowing what was happening...simply ceasing to exist because forces beyond his comprehension decided his corner of reality was inconvenient.
A sneeze from an Ender, Dikastes, or any others could have turned his entire world to dust.

If his progression had been slightly slower, if he was still confined within a Cosmos or even an Omniverse... the Fallout would occur to systematically wipe out entire Folds and all of Observable Existence
outside THE Loom. Including whatever little corner he would have been occupying.
Things would simply cease, and Noah Osmont alongside all those around him would stop existing without even knowing how they
perished.
But instead, here he stood approximately three years later.
Not merely surviving, but fucking thriving.
He had begun forging his own Primordial Civilization!
Not as one of many leaders of some grand established framework, but
as THE leader of The Primordial Civilizations of Mana and Hunger!
Well, not THE leader quite yet in terms of recognition across
existence.
But this perspective alone reminded him that there remained truly tremendous work to be accomplished.
Because even now, he had not escaped the constraints of the Fallout.

Even though his Civilization was Primordial...similar to Order, Origin, Hunger, or any other Collapsed Civilization, and would theoretically be able to persevere through collapse and reconstitute in some form after years or eons...
Similar to how THE Living Order became THE Dead Order, or how Khor returned from near-total dissolution...
But!
The concept of collapse was not something he anticipated experiencing with anything approaching enthusiasm.
His eyes flashed with decisiveness as yes, there was still immense work requiring completion!
After being momentarily sidetracked with introspective thoughts during that span of an instant, he returned his focus to Ambessa who
was constantly bearing the immense weight of Hunger Propagation
from 2 Million+ Primus Inevitabilities and still maintaining sufficiently calm expression to converse freely.
Entities in the Sextillions of power were utterly monstrous in their
resilience.
Noah looked at her as he nodded before stating with casual tone.

"How is THE Loom, by the way? Since according to your assessment, I and all those around me will face collapse anyway from whatever retaliation comes next...or simply from the Fallout itself, you can share some information about THE Loom, correct? Oh, and you could also indicate where you all concealed the other Vessels of THE Living
Paradox...

chapters.title: Chapter 4459 Civilization Specialization II
paragraphs: Ambessa smiled at such a transparent attempt to extract intelligence before she shook her head.
She looked at Noah directly as her response emerged.

"THE Loom... is something genuinely unimaginable. You would need to witness it personally to truly comprehend what has been constructed there. Describing it would be like describing color to someone who has never possessed vision...fundamentally inadequate."
At such unhelpful words, Noah replied with edge of irritation.
"It doesn't appear as though I'm going to fucking witness the inside of THE Loom though, so you might as well elaborate with whatever inadequate description you can provide."
Ambessa's smile widened slightly.
"Nah. You have to see it yourself. Some experiences cannot be translated through words, only through direct observation!"
Noah's crimson visor flashed as he rose upward, his blade rising with him in a gesture stating his patience was exhausting itself.
"And the Vessels?" he asked with pointed directness. "Where are the remaining Vessels of THE Living Paradox that your people secured?"
Ambessa's reply was equally unhelpful.
"Also nah on those. Operational security exists for reasons. But I will offer genuine advice: be extremely careful opposing arguably one of the most powerful existences in... well, all of Existence."

"THE Living Paradox may be somewhat annoyed with you currently. Maybe. But avoid making him entirely angry. Live slightly longer for yourself and those you lead. Be with your bretheren. Your family. Hold them close. Wait for the Fallout instead of being collapsed before it even arrives."
Her expression became almost sympathetic:
"Perhaps THE Creature and his mechanisms will prevail. Even if you and all others face collapse, you may return as Dead Existence rather than permanent cessation."

"Maybe when I and all others emerge from THE Loom years down the timeline, I might encounter you again as diminutive skeleton and recognize you through some residual characteristic. You seem like genuinely cool guy, so I would take care of you then. Ensure you weren't mistreated by whatever new order emerges."
After such unexpectedly considerate words, Noah nodded as the Sword of Mana and Hunger pulsed in his hands with hungry anticipation.
"What a reality that would be. Let's earnestly hope that events do not unfold that way!"
He brought the sword down with deliberate motion as he looked into the radiant stellar eyes of Ambessa...meeting her gaze directly through his crimson visor.
Ambessa smiled as she nodded at him with an expression of no fear!
"See you in a bit, interesting stranger. Whether as enemy, skeleton, or something unexpected."
HUUM
Noah sank his sword into her chest, the hollow blade piercing through her devastated form with finality.

Her existence collapsed into an Event Horizon of concentrated Hunger as everything about her...her 5 Sextillion power, her accumulated Civilizational Authority of Paradox, her harvest of 5 Grand Principles, her very concept...was systematically consumed!
The harvest from eight Avatars was complete.
And Perpetual Harvest activated with full force to amplify what had been gained.

The moment that Ambessa's Avatar was collapsed and her entire existence fell under his glorious Civilizational Authority of Mana and Hunger, everything fell silent in the periphery as... only the gold-green light of harvest began to shine with blinding intensity.
This was because the effort and immensity and harvest of all the Avatars that had been systematically collapsed were being gathered together...culminating at this very moment in single magnificent
distribution!
In this silence, Noah felt sense of expectation.
Because the harvest this time was truly grand in ways that exceeded previous accumulations.
The presence from THE Loom...the beings who had cultivated for eons within that structured domain, who possessed Civilizational Authority of Paradox refined across incomprehensible
duration...would there be enough for him to fully complete the initial foundation of his Walls of Civilization?
Would they allow him to shed the designation of Nascent Civilization and advance toward something more substantial?
His armored figure stood gloriously amid the devastated Desiccated Sleeping Shore as prompts began flashing before his crimson
visor-covered eyes.
A quintessential quantity of effort and harvest have been successfully accumulated. The magnitude exceeds all previous collections by
substantial margin.
The weavings of existence of 8 Members of The Primordial Civilization of Paradox were systematically hungered and devoured by
you or other members of your Civilization.
These were not mere projections but genuine Avatars carrying substantial portions of their main bodies' power and authority. Their collapse has yielded unprecedented harvest.
All accumulated effort and harvest from this engagement has been
consolidated. For the sake of optimal advancement of the entire Civilization, all harvest flows into the Foundation Palisades as priority
allocation.
Perpetual Harvest amplifies all incoming resources. Multiplier effect
in progress...

The prompts were grand in their implications as Noah closed his eyes and envisioned the manifestation of his Civilization...that conceptual space where the abstract framework of his power took tangible form. He witnessed the grand manifestation materialize in his existence
with perfect clarity.
The towering walls that represented the Foundation Palisades stretched across impossible distances...blue-gold timber-like material
that pulsed with concentrated Primus Mana and Hunger.
These walls encircled the entire framework of his manifested Civilization, protecting the structures within from external interference or assault.

At this moment, seas of harvest were flowing into those walls with tremendous force...green-gold light of Perpetual Harvest mixing with the obsidian-blue-crimson of concentrated authority devoured from
enemies!
The Foundation Palisades grew larger and more substantial as they absorbed this influx, their height increasing, their thickness expanding, their protective capabilities multiplying.
The harvest was so potent that...
BOOM!
The blue-gold timber walls of the Foundation Palisades began to shine
with incandescent light that made them nearly impossible to perceive
directly.
They began transforming from the timber-like material toward
something that appeared far more permanent, far more imposing.
Something that looked like...stone!
Stone!
Noah observed such transformation as his eyes shone with grand
luminosity.

There was only single reason why the fundamental quality of his Walls of Civilization would undergo material transformation from timber to stone...it represented a categorical advancement to entirely new
designation!

chapters.title: Chapter 4460 Civilization Specialization III
paragraphs: Grand prompts descended with weight.
The harvest accumulated from collapsing 8 Avatars of the Primordial Civilization of Paradox is so immense that the Foundation Palisades have completed their developmental cycle.
The grand foundation has been successfully established. Structural integrity confirmed. Defensive parameters exceed all projections.
The transformation and elevation toward becoming The Architect's Bulwarks is commencing. Calculating harvest sufficiency for initial entry into second designation...
Calculation complete: Harvest is precisely sufficient for initial entry and stabilization.
Advancement confirmed: Foundation Palisades to The Architect's Bulwarks
Your Walls of Civilization advance from timber to stone. From temporary fortification to permanent bastion. From nascent protection to established defense.
Noah observed this glorious phenomenon with satisfaction.

He witnessed the Walls of his Civilization transforming in real-time...the blue-gold timber shifting, solidifying, reconstituting itself into magnificent stone that appeared both ancient and newly-forged simultaneously.
The Architect's Bulwarks emerged in their full majesty.
These were not simple walls.
They were monuments of towering stone fortifications that appeared to be carved from single continuous piece of obsidian-blue stone interwoven with golden veins.
The surface was inscribed with countless Primus Mana Arcana Glyphs that pulsed with rhythmic intensity, each one contributing to the overall defensive framework.
The Bulwarks stretched impossibly high...so tall that their tops disappeared into conceptual clouds that represented limits of observable existence.
They were so thick that entire armies of Primus Inevitabilities could march along their tops without crowding!
They radiated authority that suggested anything attempting to breach them would face systematic destruction.
And of course, since the Walls of his Civilization had advanced... all components of his Civilization were concurrently advancing!
Noah observed all the components of his Manifested Civilization becoming larger, more complex, more refined as they absorbed overflow from the concentrated harvest.
His Early Atlas of the Folds expanded dramatically. New regions appeared on its surface, new pathways between locations manifested, the overall detail and accuracy increased exponentially.
The Trees representing his Principles grew substantially taller and more magnificent.
The Cheating Architect's golden-blue tree sprouted additional branches.
Perpetual Harvest's green-gold tree deepened its roots. All others also surged up immensly!
His 159 Resplendent Citadels, those towering structures representing accumulated power and authority, pulsed with rhythmic intensity.
Additional prompts materialized with detailed accounting.
Your personal Complexity and Purity has surged to 1.5 Sextillion baseline. This does not account for combined Complexity and Purity when fused with Protos, which would elevate the total to 2.1
Sextillion.

As of this moment, The Architect's Bulwarks ensure that anything below 3 Sextillion Complexity and Purity cannot harm your existence. The Boon of Minor Mana and Hunger Palisades has undergone categorical transformation.
New designation: The Boon of Major Mana and Hunger Bulwark
Applicable Recipients: Expanded from 81 to 6,561 Members of your Civilization
Granted Power: Each blessed recipient receives .3 Sextillion (300 Quintillion) Complexity and Purity
Additional Benefit: All recipients gain full capability to efficiently
utilize Civilizational Authority without requiring individual cultivation
of such capability
Noah looked at these glorious prompts.
But the notifications seemed in no way finished, because he could feel his entire existence still buzzing with sense of immensity...as if even more substantial transformations awaited manifestation.
In the next moment, the sensation intensified dramatically as reality around him seemed to acknowledge what was occurring within his conceptual Civilization space.
New prompts descended with weight that made surrounding existence tremble.
Your Civilization has taken major step forward, no longer bearing the designation of Nascent Civilization.]

Through systematic accumulation of power, through conquest of enemies possessing genuine Civilizational Authority, through establishment of a permanent defensive framework, through cultivation of specialized forces and diverse capabilities...
The Primordial Civilization of Mana and Hunger has advanced to
attain the designation of:
THE CATHEDRAL OF ORDER
Second Designation achieved. Civilizational identity solidified.
The Cathedral of Order!
The name resonated through Noah's existence with profound
significance.
The different structures of his Manifested Civilization grew dramatically at this moment in response to achieving this milestone.
His Early Atlas of the Folds seemed to become even larger and more impossibly detailed.
The Trees representing his Principles grew substantially taller, their canopies expanding until they provided shade across vast portions of his manifested Civilization!

The roots deepened until they touched the very foundation of The Architect's Bulwarks themselves, creating symbiotic relationship between defensive structure and power-generation of the Principles! And his 159 Resplendent Citadels pulsed with rhythmic intensity of
change and transformation!
Prompts bloomed immediately afterward detailing the full scope of transformation.
Your 5 Principles shine ever brighter with accumulated power and
refined authority.
Enhancement confirmed: 300 Primus Mana Glyphs of each Principle can now be forged (increased from previous maximum of 200)| Each Glyph now contributes .5 Quintillion Complexity and Purity to
your existence
Total potential contribution from all Principles at maximum Glyph
capacity: 750 Quintillion(.75 Sextillion) Complexity and Purity
Alongside the substantial growth of your Principles, your Resplendent Citadels have completed the 4th Stage of development and are now advancing into the 5th Stage.]
New designation: The Resplendent Citadels transform into THE
SOVEREIGN SPIRES OF OSMONT
The Sovereign Spires represent the refined authority of your Existence, each one now capable of independently manifesting Civilizational Authority in specific domains.

The light of all Principles, guided systematically by Cheating Architect and amplified by Perpetual Harvest, reinforces a glorious newly manifesting feature emerging from the 5th Stage of The Sovereign Spires of Osmont
This feature outlines the core distinctive capability of The Second
Designation of The Primordial Civilization of Mana and Hunger, The Cathedral of Order.
Core Feature Designation: CIVILIZATION SPECIALIZATION
An immense quantity of harvest and accumulated effort from all
different components of your Civilization flows systematically into the formation and structural design of the Civilization Feature of Civilization Specialization.
This represents categorical advancement in organizational sophistication. Your Civilization evolves from monolithic force into
multifaceted wonder.]
Estimated completion of Civilization Specialization framework:
Imminent
Noah's mind buzzed as he processed these extraordinary prompts.
The Cathedral of Order. The designation felt appropriate!
The Sovereign Spires of Osmont. His Citadels had evolved into
something bearing his name gloriously.
And most intriguingly... Civilization Specialization.
He contemplated this new core feature with analytical focus.
The prompts suggested it represented fundamental transformation in how his Civilization operated!
But the specifics remained unclear. What exactly would this
Civilization Specialization entail? His mind raced with possibilities!

The grand foundation has been successfully established.
Structural integrity confirmed.
Defensive parameters exceed all projections.
The transformation and elevation toward becoming The Architect's Bulwarks is commencing.
Calculating harvest sufficiency for initial entry into second designation...
Calculation complete: Harvest is precisely sufficient for initial entry and stabilization.

Your Walls of Civilization advance from timber to stone.
From temporary fortification to permanent bastion.
From nascent protection to established defense.
Noah observed this glorious phenomenon with satisfaction.

He witnessed the Walls of his Civilization transforming in real-time...the blue-gold timber shifting, solidifying, reconstituting itself into magnificent stone that appeared both ancient and newly-forged simultaneously.
The Architect's Bulwarks emerged in their full majesty.
These were not simple walls.
They were monuments of towering stone fortifications that appeared to be carved from single continuous piece of obsidian-blue stone interwoven with golden veins.
The surface was inscribed with countless Primus Mana Arcana Glyphs that pulsed with rhythmic intensity, each one contributing to the overall defensive framework.
The Bulwarks stretched impossibly high...so tall that their tops disappeared into conceptual clouds that represented limits of observable existence.
They were so thick that entire armies of Primus Inevitabilities could march along their tops without crowding!
They radiated authority that suggested anything attempting to breach them would face systematic destruction.
And of course, since the Walls of his Civilization had advanced... all components of his Civilization were concurrently advancing!
Noah observed all the components of his Manifested Civilization becoming larger, more complex, more refined as they absorbed overflow from the concentrated harvest.
His Early Atlas of the Folds expanded dramatically.
New regions appeared on its surface, new pathways between locations manifested, the overall detail and accuracy increased exponentially.
The Trees representing his Principles grew substantially taller and more magnificent.
The Cheating Architect's golden-blue tree sprouted additional branches.
Perpetual Harvest's green-gold tree deepened its roots.
All others also surged up immensly!
His 159 Resplendent Citadels, those towering structures representing accumulated power and authority, pulsed with rhythmic intensity.
Additional prompts materialized with detailed accounting.
Your personal Complexity and Purity has surged to 1.5 Sextillion baseline.
This does not account for combined Complexity and Purity when fused with Protos, which would elevate the total to 2.1
Sextillion.
As of this moment, The Architect's Bulwarks ensure that anything below 3 Sextillion Complexity and Purity cannot harm your existence.
The Boon of Minor Mana and Hunger Palisades has undergone categorical transformation.

Granted Power: Each blessed recipient receives .3 Sextillion (300 Quintillion) Complexity and Purity
Additional Benefit: All recipients gain full capability to efficiently
utilize Civilizational Authority without requiring individual cultivation
of such capability
Noah looked at these glorious prompts.
But the notifications seemed in no way finished, because he could feel his entire existence still buzzing with sense of immensity...as if even more substantial transformations awaited manifestation.
In the next moment, the sensation intensified dramatically as reality around him seemed to acknowledge what was occurring within his conceptual Civilization space.
New prompts descended with weight that made surrounding existence tremble.

attain the designation of:

Second Designation achieved.
Civilizational identity solidified.
The Cathedral of Order!
The name resonated through Noah's existence with profound
significance.
The different structures of his Manifested Civilization grew dramatically at this moment in response to achieving this milestone.
His Early Atlas of the Folds seemed to become even larger and more impossibly detailed.
The Trees representing his Principles grew substantially taller, their canopies expanding until they provided shade across vast portions of his manifested Civilization!
The roots deepened until they touched the very foundation of The Architect's Bulwarks themselves, creating symbiotic relationship between defensive structure and power-generation of the Principles!
And his 159 Resplendent Citadels pulsed with rhythmic intensity of
change and transformation!
Prompts bloomed immediately afterward detailing the full scope of transformation.
Your 5 Principles shine ever brighter with accumulated power and
refined authority.

your existence
Total potential contribution from all Principles at maximum Glyph

Alongside the substantial growth of your Principles, your Resplendent Citadels have completed the 4th Stage of development and are now advancing into the 5th Stage.]

The Sovereign Spires represent the refined authority of your Existence, each one now capable of independently manifesting Civilizational Authority in specific domains.

Imminent

The Cathedral of Order.
The designation felt appropriate!
The Sovereign Spires of Osmont.
His Citadels had evolved into

Civilization Specialization.

What exactly would this
Civilization Specialization entail?

chapters.title: Chapter 4461 Civilization Specialization IV
paragraphs: Specialization.
Some believed it meant limitation...surrendering the versatility of being capable in many areas to achieve excellence in one narrow domain.
These individuals viewed specialization as sacrificing potential breadth for depth, trading adaptability for focused capability.
Others believed it meant optimization, recognizing that attempting to master everything resulted in mastering nothing.
And that strategic allocation of resources toward specific functions produced superior results than diffuse distribution across all possibilities.
But in the scope of a Civilization, a true Civilization...specialization meant something far more profound.
It meant evolution.

It meant recognizing that a Civilization was not merely collection of powerful individuals, but an organism composed of differentiated cells, each performing distinct functions that contributed to the health and capability of the whole.
A body did not require every cell to be capable of everything.
The heart did not need to perform photosynthesis. The brain did not need to digest food. The liver did not need to pump blood.

Each organ, each system, each specialized component contributed its unique function...and through that contribution, the organism achieved capabilities that exceeded what any individual cell could accomplish regardless of its individual power.
Specialization, properly understood, was not limitation.
It was glory, it was majesty!
In a distant time.
In the Earliest Folds.
There existed a moment when a unique entity met another unique entity and they discussed The Ways of Existence while standing in frozen landscape that seemed to exist outside normal temporal flow.
One anomaly had said farewell to another before he took a single step and disappeared, traversing impossible distances through sheer force of his cultivated Way!
This anomaly was none other than Anaximander as his next step carried him countless territories distant.
He found himself floating in region surrounded by millions of floating Primordial Wheels of Existence, each one representing concentrated authority.
This brilliant Fold Dweller was particularly introspective at this time as he contemplated all the subjects he had discussed with Osmont during their unexpected meeting.
How Osmont had cautioned him regarding any entities possessing the distinction of THE.
Anaximander owed substantial debt to THE Weavers for what they had done to allow him to take that transformative step and embark upon his Way.
He was naturally curious by disposition as he wanted to understand more than he feared the unknown.
His mind brightened with audacity as he asked himself...
What if I simply tear apart the veil of mystery by directly meeting THE entities? Perhaps those encounters would prove as fruitful as the conversation with Osmont?
Across his existence, Anaximander had observed that countless beings feared what they did not comprehend.
The masses in his original world, no matter how many technological advances he and fellow scientists produced, inevitably feared what remained beyond their understanding.
He reasoned that if could simply underst
THE entiti
directly, the veil of mystery would be systematically torn away, and genuine comprehension would become possible.
After all, he sought understanding with intensity that exceeded his desire for safety or comfort!
So his eyes brightened with characteristic determination as he spoke aloud to existence itself.
"When I take this next step, I will arrive before... the most powerful THE existence in these Folds..."
HUUM!
His Existence was grand. His Way grander.
So he took that step... and disappeared from that space entirely.
When he reappeared, he found himself observing scene that defied his understanding.
He manifested on golden sands of an unfathomably vast shore that stretched toward horizons that seemed to extend infinitely in all
directions.
Anaximander blinked repeatedly at the scope of wonder surrounding him as his mind attempted to categorize what he perceived.
There existed massive trees that seemed to bear fruits composed of nurtured Principles.
Plots of cultivated land where Primordial Folds and Transcendent Folds were being grown like crops.
Massive structures of immense mystery and architectural wonder that suggested purposes beyond his current comprehension. But at this moment, what drew his attention most prominently was an
entity who appeared to be struggling to erect a tilted wall across one particularly vast plot of land.
Anaximander observed with growing curiosity as this figure pushed against the wall with visible effort, attempting to position it vertically rather than at its current severe angle.

The moment Anaximander fully manifested, this entity turned to regard him with expression of genuine surprise...gazing at the unexpected visitor with an analytical assessment while Anaximander performed an identical evaluation.
The entity appeared humanoid in general configuration but radiated authority that made surrounding existence acknowledge his
presence.
His features were difficult to focus upon directly, as if his fundamental nature resisted simple observation.
Observing that this being required assistance with his construction project, Anaximander moved forward with directness.
"I apologize for this intrusion. I was seeking the most powerful THE existence across these Folds, and my Way delivered me here specifically. Are you the entity I sought? Do you need...help?"
With these straightforward words, Anaximander positioned himself
on one side of the tilted wall that this entity was attempting to erect
properly.
He placed his hands against its surface to help stabilize and lift...
And for the first time since he began embarking upon his way, he felt like he was holding something genuinely heavy.
Not heavy in simple physical sense, but heavy in existential sense!
The wall itself appeared deceptively simple upon initial observation.
Clean wooden construction without elaborate ornamentation.
But when Anaximander examined it more carefully with his analytical perception, he noticed extraordinary details.
One side of the wall bore vibrant fruits filled with pulsing life-force...entities that radiated vitality and growth and continuation.
The opposite side held fruits that seemed...dead, yet paradoxically shone with their own distinct vibrancy.
Not lifeless in sense of absence, but bearing a different quality of existence that was equally valid and complex.

As he studied this peculiar construction and what it separated with growing fascination, the entity who had been working on erecting this wall looked toward him and smiled with an expression of amusement.

"Why are you seeking THE entities so deliberately? There exists substantial danger if you encounter the wrong one. Not all of us are benevolent, and some possess... questionable ethics regarding how we interact with other beings."
Anaximander continued looking at the wall with intense interest...noting how it defied conventional physical properties. He replied while studying it with scientific fascination.
"I met a friend recently. Perhaps I can legitimately call him that
despite brief acquaintance. He advised me to exercise some caution regarding THE existences."
His expression brightened with enthusiasm.

"But for good or bad, I am fundamentally a learner of existence and student of reality by core nature. My curiosity overwhelmed my caution, and I decided I wanted to stand before the most powerful THE specifically to understand that which I currently do not comprehend. Fear born from ignorance seems philosophically inferior to knowledge acquired through calculated risk."

chapters.title: Chapter 4462 Civilization Specialization V
paragraphs: His earnest words caused the distant being holding the opposite end of this heavy wall to smile with genuine warmth as he nodded.
"Well... what specifically do you want to know?"
Anaximander, now thoroughly engrossed with the mysteriously heavy wall he was supporting, replied with immediate focus.

"At this precise moment, I am intensely interested in what exactly you are accomplishing here. What is this wall fundamentally? And why does it possess such extraordinary existential weight that I can barely maintain my position?"
At such direct inquiry, the entity on the opposite end released an audible sigh as his response emerged with melancholy and determination.

"I also have a... friend. We can call her that, though our relationship is complex. She was unfairly collapsed some time ago through circumstances beyond her control, and I've been systematically attempting to help her and others like her who faced similar collapse."
His expression grew distant.

"Their fundamental nature and specialization is inherently dead...bearing authority over cessation and endings rather than beginnings and growth. There exist substantial complications when their collapsed weavings interact with the weavings of the living." He gestured toward the wall they were collectively supporting. "I am attempting to erect a wall, a Veil, around their domains to provide protection and separation. A Veil that would also act as protection because some rather unpleasant things seem to be in play. So I thought of a Veil."
"A veil so they can maintain semblance of peace and stability after everything that has occurred to them. I have accomplished everything
within my capability thus far, but this final section seems
extraordinarily heavy. Unless I am actively supporting it, this wall continues tilting dangerously."
His tone carried self-awareness.

"Perhaps it is because I am executing too many simultaneous projects at this moment. Perhaps I need to attempt this construction during period when I can dedicate complete focus rather than divided attention across countless responsibilities."
Anaximander's eyes illuminated with intellectual excitement at such explanation.
He looked at this tilted wall with renewed understanding and spoke. "Can I attempt to help? My Way may be of use."
The entity regarded him calmly for extended moment. Finally he nodded.

"You can attempt this, but exercise extreme care. The weight of this wall is not merely physical. You will be supporting the boundary between life and death, between continuation and cessation, between what is and what was."
At such solemn warning, the glorious scene that unfolded in the next moment would have profound implications.
Anaximander breathed out slowly...centering himself, focusing his cultivated Way entirely upon this singular task.
He began applying systematic pressure on the tilted wall while simultaneously instructing his existence with logical precision.

This is just a wall. A boundary requiring proper positioning. With both of us applying coordinated force, it simply needs to cease being tilted and stand vertically as intended. Simple physics combined with
existential authority. Calculate optimal force vectors. Apply pressure systematically. Achieve result.
His existence buzzed with intensity as it received these guidelines and directives....his Way manifesting tangibly as he applied the conviction that this wall should stand straight.
And shockingly, the heavy tilted wall actually began to shift!
HUUM!
When the humanoid entity on the opposite side observed this unexpected movement, his expression transformed to genuine
surprise and wonder.
He immediately applied his own substantial power to the wall as they pushed together with synchronized effort...
HUUUM!
An immense eruption of concentrated complexity exploded outward at that moment as the entire expanse of the vast and intricate shore trembled beneath the weight of what they were accomplishing!
The body of the entity on the opposite end pulsed with seas of endless Primordial Civilizational Authority as torrents of concentrated power flowed into the wall's structure.
Meanwhile Anaximander felt like he was executing task that entirely contradicted his fundamental nature, pushing against a really heavy wall when he was never the athletic or strong type.
And yet he continued exerting maximum effort to straighten this
simple wall.
And shockingly, after duration that felt simultaneously instantaneous
and eons...
BOOM!
The tilted wall was no longer tilted. It stood straight and strong and
permanent, properly positioned as intended!

The moment it achieved perfect vertical alignment, brilliant incandescent light erupted from the top of this wall and stretched upward endlessly...piercing through dimensional boundaries, extending across territorial divisions, creating visible demarcation
that would persist across eons.
Anaximander observed such marvelous phenomenon as he stumbled backward with exhaustion that exceeded anything he had experienced before.
He felt profound sense of weakness pervading his entire existence,
but the accomplishment of straightening that significant wall made him smile and laugh with genuine satisfaction despite his depleted
state.
While expressing such triumph, his body began swaying dangerously as if about to collapse entirely.
The entity who had been working on the opposite end of the wall appeared beside him instantaneously to provide stabilizing support, preventing his fall with gentle but firm assistance.
Anaximander breathed heavily as he steadied himself with visible
effort.
"I never anticipated manual labor would cause such profound exertion. I haven't experienced genuine fatigue like this since I first embarked upon my Way. But ah, no matter, totally worth the
experience."

He straightened with effort and extended a conceptual hand. "I am Anaximander. A Fold Dweller by current classification, a scientist by training and disposition, and a dreamer who wishes to learn everything existence can teach. Who are you, exactly?" Anaximander articulated such direct question as the being who was
helping him maintain stability shook his head with warm smile.
"I am THE Creature."
Anaximander blinked repeatedly at such casual revelation as his processing caught up with implication.
"THE? All capital letters? So I successfully located the precise entity I
sought to understand? You don't trigger any alarm bells in my mind
though..."
He contemplated Osmont's stern warnings to exercise caution against THE beings.

This particular one seemed remarkably approachable, and when THE Creature had helped stabilize him, Anaximander had felt immense infusion of surrounding existence's concentrated life-force flowing into his depleted framework to accelerate recovery.
As if THE Creature could perceive the questioning evaluation occurring behind Anaximander's expression, he nodded while providing clarification.

"THE- all capital, exactly as you understood. And your friend demonstrated wisdom advising caution regarding THE entities. Some of us can be... profoundly selfish, manipulative even, pursuing agendas that disregard consequences for other beings."
His expression brightened with genuine curiosity. "Who is this friend of yours who provided such counsel? Are they as
remarkable as you are? I would appreciate opportunity to meet them as well, it's rare to encounter beings and anomalies like you."
At such inquiry, Anaximander shook his head with an apologetic expression.
"I made an explicit promise not to reveal their identity. They expressed substantial discomfort regarding THE entities and requested anonymity. I respect that boundary despite my natural
inclination toward sharing information freely." THE Creature nodded with understanding. "What a shame. Anyone you would designate as friend would
undoubtedly prove exceptional to meet directly. But no matter, come."
He gestured expansively toward the vast shore.

"Since I have unexpected guest, and you even provided crucial assistance establishing The Veil properly, let me treat you with appropriate hospitality. You expressed desire to understand Existence more completely? I may possess capability to provide...some answers."
THE Creature helped Anaximander steady himself completely before leading this extraordinary being deeper into the vast and seemingly endless shore.
It was a meeting that none across observable history knew occurred.
A meeting that none would believe possible even if informed directly.
But existence was grand beyond comprehension.
And the possibilities were genuinely endless!
Meanwhile, in the present...
On a nearly collapsed Desiccated Sleeping Shore...
Noah stood processing the implications of what "Civilization Specialization" might represent for his framework as a moment later...prompts began to descend!
