Are they as
remarkable as you are?
I would appreciate opportunity to meet them as well, it's rare to encounter beings and anomalies like you."
At such inquiry, Anaximander shook his head with an apologetic expression.
"I made an explicit promise not to reveal their identity.
They expressed substantial discomfort regarding THE entities and requested anonymity.
I respect that boundary despite my natural
inclination toward sharing information freely." THE Creature nodded with understanding.
"What a shame.
Anyone you would designate as friend would
undoubtedly prove exceptional to meet directly.
But no matter, come."
He gestured expansively toward the vast shore.
"Since I have unexpected guest, and you even provided crucial assistance establishing The Veil properly, let me treat you with appropriate hospitality.
You expressed desire to understand Existence more completely?
I may possess capability to provide...some answers."
THE Creature helped Anaximander steady himself completely before leading this extraordinary being deeper into the vast and seemingly endless shore.
It was a meeting that none across observable history knew occurred.
A meeting that none would believe possible even if informed directly.
But existence was grand beyond comprehension.
And the possibilities were genuinely endless!
Meanwhile, in the present...
On a nearly collapsed Desiccated Sleeping Shore...
Noah stood processing the implications of what "Civilization Specialization" might represent for his framework as a moment later...prompts began to descend!

chapters.title: Chapter 4463 Civilization Specialization VI
paragraphs: Noah's eyes pulsed with immensity as he observed the formation of the Sovereign Spires of Osmont while prompts descended to explain exactly what Civilization Specialization represented.

The prompts materialized alongside radiant illusory holographic displays of the Sovereign Spires...towering structures that appeared simultaneously within his manifested Civilization and as conceptual diagrams floating before his vision.
The Civilization Specialization System represents evolutionary refinement of The Primordial Civilization of Mana and Hunger's membership structure.
This system allows for the diversification of roles and capabilities among Members, transforming your Civilization from monolithic force into sophisticated organism with differentiated functions.

Through the Sovereign Spires of Osmont, Members of your Civilization can voluntarily transform their existence into specialized path that provides substantial benefits to both individual and collective framework.
Current Available Specializations:
- The Infinite Bulwark Specialization
- The Hungering Maw Specialization
- The Vital Chorus Specialization
Additional Specializations Currently Under Development: -The Architects of Infinity Specialization: 17% completion
- The Sovereign Heralds Specialization: 13% completion
Access to additional Specializations will unlock as your Civilization advances and as harvest continues flowing into the Sovereign Spires of Osmont.
Noah's eyes flashed as he processed these prompts.
So the Civilization evolves from everyone possessing similar capabilities toward specialized roles with distinct functions.
Three Specializations currently available, two more under development...

In the next moment, he observed one of the massive Sovereign Spires of Osmont within his Manifested Civilization rise up prominently and be displayed before him with enhanced clarity...as if the entire conceptual structure was being pulled forward for a detailed examination.
The Spire was magnificent in its architectural expression. A towering structure composed of layered obsidian-gold crystalline formations that suggested absolute solidity and permanence.
The surface was inscribed with countless defensive Arcana Glyphs that pulsed with rhythmic intensity.
Above it, floating labels materialized with clear identification.
SOVEREIGN SPIRE OF OSMONT - THE IRON CONCORDAT
The blue-gold holographic figure of RUIN/EDEN appeared beside the displayed Spire, her form coalescing from scattered light into coherent representation.
She bowed gracefully toward Noah with expression mixing professionalism with barely suppressed excitement...as if she had been waiting eagerly to present this new capability.
Her voice emerged with precision, though underlying enthusiasm colored her typical analytical tone.

"Master, allow me to present the first available Civilization Specialization... The Infinite Bulwark Specialization. This path can be obtained when any Member of your Civilization, with the sole exception of yourself, enters a Sovereign Spire of Osmont bearing the
distinction of The Iron Concordat and consciously chooses to undergo the transformation."

As she articulated this introduction, the obsidian-gold coloration of the Spire intensified...the defensive architectural structure becoming more pronounced as if physically responding to being discussed.
RUIN/EDEN began explaining the Specialization through systematically presented prompts!
THE INFINITE BULWARK SPECIALIZATION
Faction Declaration: "We are the wall upon which existence breaks. We do not fall. We cannot fall."]
Primary Focus: Absolute Defense and Endurance

This Specialization represents commitment to protection above all other considerations. Members who choose this path sacrifice offensive capability entirely in exchange for defensive power that transcends conventional limitations.
An illusory figure manifested beside RUINEDEN...showing how a humanoid figure who chose this Specialization would appear after transformation.
The figure was massive, imposing, covered in layered crystalline plates of obsidian-gold that seemed to absorb light rather than
reflecting it.
The entity moved with deliberate slowness, but each step radiated
absolute certainty and caused minor stabilization effects in
surrounding reality.
Additional prompts continued with detailed specifications.
CORE TRANSFORMATION PARAMETERS:

Total Offensive Sacrifice: Members of this Specialization lose 100% of their offensive capabilities. They cannot deal direct damage through any conventional or unconventional means. All attacks, abilities, and techniques designed to harm enemies are systematically removed
from their framework. Any attacks towards Members of The Civilization are automatically drawn to them.

Multiplicative Defensive Gain: In exchange for complete offensive sacrifice, their Complexity and Purity is multiplied by 15x for all defensive calculations. This multiplication applies to Durability, Resistances to Living Existential Authority, Principles, and Civilizational Authority, and all other protective measurements.]
Immovable Presence: Cannot be forcefully moved, teleported,
displaced, or otherwise repositioned without explicit consent. Their
existence becomes anchored to their chosen location through fundamental authority that resists manipulation.

The illusory Bulwark figure demonstrated these capabilities...absorbing devastating attacks without visible damage, remaining perfectly stationary despite tremendous force being applied, radiating defensive authority that created visible protective
fields around nearby allies!
UNIQUE CAPABILITIES:
Civilization Fortress Formation: Multiple Bulwarks can merge their

individual defensive fields to create unified impenetrable barriers protecting designated allies. The more Bulwarks participate in formation, the stronger the collective barrier becomes, scaling exponentially rather than linearly.
The visualization showed three Bulwarks combining their defenses...their individual protective fields merging into single cohesive barrier that appeared capable of withstanding apocalyptic
assault.
Damage Conversion: All damage absorbed by Bulwark can be
systematically stored within their framework and subsequently channeled to the offensive specialists within the Civilization. Nothing is wasted...every attack they endure becomes fuel for allied
counter-assault.
The illusory figure absorbed barrage of attacks, and visible energy accumulated within its form before being transferred through golden conduits toward offensive-oriented allies who held different
Specializations!

Existential Anchoring: Their presence stabilizes reality itself within substantial radius. Prevents spatial tears, dimensional collapse, reality manipulation, or existential alteration within their vicinity. The more powerful the Bulwark, the larger the stabilization radius. The visualization demonstrated reality becoming more solid around the Bulwark...attempts to tear space, manipulate dimensions, or alter fundamental principles simply failing within the stabilized zone!

Regenerative Resonance: Healing effects directed toward Bulwarks are amplified by 500%. Their defensive specialization creates synergistic relationship with restorative capabilities, allowing healer Specializations to restore them far more efficiently.
Armored forms appear as living fortresses, massive entities covered in
layered crystalline plates of obsidian-gold that shift and reconfigure to optimize defensive coverage.
Movement is deliberate and unhurried, but conveys absolute
certainty.|
Eyes glow with steady, unwavering silver light that suggests immutable commitment to their protective purpose.
IDEAL CANDIDATES: Those who value protection above personal
glory or offensive capability.
Beings who have experienced devastating loss and refuse to allow such loss to occur again.
Entities with naturally defensive psychological dispositions who find fulfillment in shielding others rather than destroying enemies.
Members who understand that sometimes the greatest strength lies
not in capacity to harm, but in capacity to endure.
Noah's eyes pulsed with tyranny as he absorbed the comprehensive presentation of this first Civilization Specialization!
He ignored everything else and focused on a number.
Did this mean, truly, 15x the Complexity and Purity of any members
who chose this defensive Specialization? 100 Quintillion to 1,500
Quintillion(1.5 Sextillion)?
Truly?!

chapters.title: Chapter 4464 Civilization Specialization VII
paragraphs: The idea of it alone was ridiculous as thid type of power truly benefitted his overal Civilization as it would mean...any Primus Inevitabilities with a base of 100 Quintillion Complexity and Purity could become a bastion of defense.
If he chose just 20 Million of the 100 Million Primus Inevitabilities to go through The Iron Concordat Sovereign Spire...that would be 20 Million Entities with...1.5 Sextillion Complexity and Purity.
One needed to take a second to process this.
And then another second!
Because oh!
His eyes gleamed with appreciation for the sophisticated design as he contemplated potential applications.
As he continued staring at the illusory diagram of the Infinite Bulwark form, additional prompts materialized with crucial clarification.
The stated 15x Complexity and Purity multiplier for defensive calculations represents baseline enhancement for standard Members choosing this Specialization.
However, the actual multiplicative effect can be substantially higher depending on the Civilization Specialization Potential possessed by an individual Member.

Higher Potential Ranks receive proportionally greater benefits from Specialization transformation, creating dramatic power differentials between Members of identical base power but different Potential classifications.
Noah's attention sharpened at this revelation.
Potential!
Potential determineed how much benefit they extract from Specialization!
It meant that not everyone who becomes an Infinite Bulwark achieves identical results.
In the next moment, an illusory diagram of Riya materialized before him...her familiar form rendered in blue-gold holographic light with exceptional detail.
From this diagram, countless lines of information extended outward like branches, each one providing specific data about her capabilities and characteristics.
But most prominently, directly above her rendered form, glowing text displayed...
Civilization Specialization Potential: Sovereign Potential(Legendary 3rd Seal)|
Noah's eyes widened fractionally at seeing this concrete
measurement of Riya's inherent capacity.
Additional prompts manifested to explain!
CIVILIZATION SPECIALIZATION POTENTIAL SYSTEM

Every being within your Civilization possesses innate Civilization Potential Rank that determines their capacity for Specialization advancement, their speed of progression, and the magnitude of benefits they receive from choosing Specialization path.]
This Potential is not arbitrary, it reflects fundamental characteristics of their existence, their connection to the Civilization's core principles, and their capacity for transformation and growth.
POTENTIAL RANK CLASSIFICATIONS:
The prompts organized themselves into hierarchical structure as RUIN/EDEN provided a comprehensive explanation.
RANK 1: UNDEFINED (Unique - Noah Osmont Only)|
This classification is possessed solely by The Primordial Sovereign, the foundational existence around which the entire Civilization is
constructed.
Capabilities:
- Can perceive, analyze, and systematically evaluate the Civilization Potential of all Members with perfect accuracy
- Can forcefully elevate the Civilization Potential of any Member through investment of accumulated Harvest
|- Can create entirely new Specialization Paths by combining existing frameworks or manifesting novel configurations
- Not bound by limitations of any single Specialization, already embodies all paths simultaneously without requiring conscious
selection
You are the architect. All others are components of your design.
Noah nodded slowly at this confirmation of his unique position. RANK 2: PRIMORDIAL POTENTIAL (Mythic - 1st Seal through 9th
Seal)|
Extraordinarily rare classification possessed by entities
fundamentally woven into the Civilization's genesis, beings whose
existence is inseparable from the Civilization's foundational
principles.
Capabilities:
- Can master multiple non-competing Specializations
simultaneously (maximum: 3)|
- Advancement speed multiplied by 50x compared to baseline
- Can evolve their chosen Specializations into unique personal variants that reflect their individual nature]
- Natural affinity for Civilizational Authority makes all Specialization abilities substantially more potent
Current Members with Primordial Potential: Khor (The First Hunger),
Sigrid (The Living Order)]
Noah's mind immediately catalogued this information.
Khor and Sigrid both qualified as Primordial Potential. It made sense...they were fundamentally connected to Hunger and Order
itself.
RANK 3: SOVEREIGN POTENTIAL (Legendary - 1st Seal through 9th
Seal)|
Rare classification possessed by exceptional individuals who demonstrate remarkable affinity for the Civilization's principles despite not being foundational components.
Capabilities:
|- Can master two non-competing Specializations simultaneously
- Advancement speed multiplied by 20x compared to baseline
- Capable of teaching their Specialization to lower-ranked Members,
accelerating collective growth
- Develop leadership capabilities naturally, often capable of
becoming commanders within their Specialization
Current Members with Sovereign Potential: Protos (The First Primus
Inevitability), Barbatos, Riya, Henry
Noah evaluated each name.
All were exceptional in their own ways!
RANK 4: EXALTED POTENTIAL (Epic - 1st Seal through 9th Seal)|
Uncommon classification possessed by talented Members who show exceptional affinity for specific aspects of the Civilization.
Capabilities:
- Masters one Specialization with extraordinary depth
- Advancement speed multiplied by 10x compared to baseline
- Can develop unique techniques and variations within their chosen
Specialization
Estimated Members with Exalted Potential: 847 current Members
RANK 5: ASCENDANT POTENTIAL (Rare - 1st Seal through 9th Seal)| Common among capable Members who possess solid foundation and
genuine commitment to Civilization.|
Capabilities:
- Masters one Specialization effectively
- Advancement speed multiplied by 5x compared to baseline
|- Standard but reliable progression along chosen path|
- Form backbone of Specialization factions through consistent
competence
Estimated Members with Ascendant Potential: 4 Million+ current Members
RANK 6: INITIATED POTENTIAL (Common)
Baseline rank for most Members who join the Civilization.
Capabilities:
- Can pursue one Specialization]
Standard advancement speed
- Requires substantial resource investment for meaningful
progression
|- Can be elevated to higher Potential through Master's intervention
and Harvest investment
Estimated Members with Initiated Potential: Majority of current
Civilization membership
After Noah absorbed the complete framework of Civilization
Specialization Potential, his eyes shone with brilliant intensity as he contemplated everything.
He could see everyone's Potential. And more importantly, he could elevate that Potential through Harvest investment! His mind raced through tactical calculations.
He smiled with tyrannical satisfaction as the potential wonder to bloom from all of this was simply...
Catastrophic. Absolutely catastrophic levels of power become
possible!
WAA!
And so far, he had only examined one Civilization Specialization in
detail. There remained two other currently available Specializations that he
could guide Members toward...The Hungering Maw and The Vital
Chorus.
One could already decipher what they would be geared towards if the
first Civilization Specialization was defensive.
Each would offer distinct capabilities. Each would create different
opportunities.
His Civilization was evolving beyond simple accumulation of powerful individuals and was becoming a true organism...differentiated, specialized, optimized.
And he controlled every aspect of that evolution!

chapters.title: Chapter 4465 Immense! I
paragraphs: After obtaining a comprehensive understanding of the first Specialization and the Potential system that governed it, Noah issued his command for overview of the remaining two Civilization Specializations to be presented.
The prompts materialized with systematic precision.
THE HUNGERING MAW SPECIALIZATION
Faction Designation: THE CRIMSON HUNGER

Faction Declaration: "We hunger. We devour. We grow without end."| Primary Focus: Pure Offensive Power and Systematic Consumption This Specialization represents commitment to destruction and growth through violence. Members who choose this path sacrifice defensive capability substantially in exchange for offensive power that transcends limitations.
CORE TRANSFORMATION PARAMETERS:
Defensive Sacrifice: Members lose 80% of their defensive capabilities. They become fragile glass cannons, extraordinarily vulnerable to counterattack but devastatingly lethal when unmolested.]
Multiplicative Offensive Gain: Their offensive Complexity and Purity is multiplied by 15x for all damage calculations, attack potency, and destructive capability measurements.

Consumption Acceleration: Everything they destroy is immediately and automatically converted to personal power with 100% efficiency. No energy is wasted, all defeated enemies become fuel for continued growth.
UNIQUE CAPABILITIES:|
Reality Severance: Their attacks ignore conventional defenses by directly attacking the fundamental existence of targets rather than
merely their physical or energetic manifestations. Armor, barriers, and protective techniques prove substantially less effective against Reality Severance strikes.|
Exponential Hunger Stacks: Each successful kill increases their

overall power by 10%. This enhancement stacks indefinitely during combat engagement, creating snowball effect where early kills make subsequent kills easier, which generate more kills, which compound power further.

Predatory Instinct: Can perceive and automatically identify the weakest point in any defense, existence, Principles, or protective weavings. This sense guides their attacks toward maximum effectiveness with minimal conscious effort.]

Feast of Conquest: Can temporarily consume and actively wield defeated enemies' signature abilities, techniques, and powers. Duration scales with power differential, weaker enemies provide brief access, comparable enemies provide extended usage.
They are sleek, predatory lifeforms covered in crimson-obsidian tentacles that constantly writhe with barely contained aggressive intent.]
Multiple serrated maws visible across their bodies, appearing on shoulders, chest, limbs...each one releasing wisps of concentrated Hunger that distorts surrounding space.
Eyes burn with ravenous red light that intensifies with each kill. After extended combat, their eyes become nearly blinding crimson beacons radiating accumulated bloodlust.
IDEAL CANDIDATES:
Those with naturally aggressive psychological dispositions who find fulfillment in destruction rather than creation.
Beings who have lost everything and channel emotion into systematic vengeance against those responsible or against existence itself.
Entities naturally inclined toward violence who would struggle with
defensive or supportive roles but excel when permitted to pursue offense without restraint.
Noah gave a light nod to the overview of The Hungering Maw
Specialization as there wasn't much to say about it apart from it being
just as astonishing as The Infinite Bulwark!
So he simply read the rest.
THE VITAL CHORUS SPECIALIZATION
Faction Designation: THE VERDANT CYCLE
Faction Declaration: "Life persists through us. Death is merely temporary setback."|
Primary Focus: Healing, Support, and Systematic Resurrection]

This Specialization represents commitment to preservation and continuation of existence. Members who choose this path sacrifice offensive capability almost entirely in exchange for restorative power that makes their allies extraordinarily difficult to permanently
eliminate.
CORE TRANSFORMATION PARAMETERS:

Offensive Sacrifice: Members lose 90% of their offensive capabilities. They become almost entirely incapable of dealing direct damage, though they retain capacity for self-defense through indirect means.
Support Amplification: All healing effects, buffing techniques, protective barriers, and supportive abilities weaved into complexity and purity are multiplied by 15x in potency and efficiency.

Life-Binding: Can establish permanent soul-bonds with other Civilization Members. If bonded ally faces collapse, they can be instantly resurrected as long as the Vital Chorus Member who holds their bond survives. This creates symbiotic relationship where protecting the healer ensures limited immortality for bonded

chapters.title: Chapter 4466 Immense! II
paragraphs: Noah's words emerged with commanding finality.

"Only a single Vessel of THE Living Paradox has been collapsed. The Avatars have secured and concealed the others, distributed them across existence to prevent easy acquisition. Find them. Hunt them. Collapse them one by one until none remain."
His crimson visor swept across the assembled forces.

"Meanwhile, I shall summon you sequentially to undergo Civilization Specialization over the next day. When you return to combat, you will return transformed...optimized for specific functions that will make our Civilization exponentially more formidable."
The Primus Inevitabilities accepted the order without hesitation, their formations breaking as they dispersed in coordinated groups.
Thousands streaked away in different directions, beginning systematic search across the Folds for remaining Vessels!

Noah looked at those still present...entities fused with Civilizational Armor who would return with him rather than continuing the hunt. Riya, Henry, Sigrid, Protos in his separated form, and numerous others.
His command was simple.
"Let us depart."
The Light of Mana and Hunger wrapped around all of them simultaneously...crimson-obsidian radiance that distorted space as they began disappearing one by one!
What remained behind was decimated, decayed shore.

In distant corner far from the primary battlefield, all those who had been frozen and paralyzed during the engagement began waking gradually, their consciousness returning as the overwhelming pressure of concentrated Civilizational Authority finally dissipated.
They would find their domain utterly transformed. Their reality shattered. Only dazzling blue sparks floated around them as extended hands for a chance.
In the wake of war, only devastation persisted!
After warfare concluded, there existed few viable courses of action available to participants.
The defeated held no voice in determining what followed...their opinions rendered irrelevant through systematic loss of capability to enforce preferences.
The victors could indulge in celebration...reveling in triumph, distributing spoils, commemorating fallen comrades.
Or they could recognize they remained in perpetual state of conflict, understanding that failure to advance immediately would result in them becoming the defeated when next engagement occurred.
And because Noah understood this fundamental principle with absolute clarity...

He stood now in the Early Veiled Shore as this vast continental landscape, rapidly enlarging and transforming through accumulated harvest, currently bore three massive Sovereign Spires of Osmont standing impossibly tall near each other along the Shore's expanding edges.
These three represented the available Specialization paths.
The first Spire gleamed with obsidian-gold coloration and bore defensive architectural characteristics- massive layered walls and redundant structural supports.
Above it, floating designation proclaimed...
THE IRON CONCORDAT - DEFENSIVE SPECIALIZATION
The second Spire was sleeker, more predatory in design- sharp
angles, aggressive protrusions, surface covered in blade-like formations that suggested violence barely contained.
Crimson light pulsed through obsidian framework. Its designation read...THE CRIMSON HUNGER - OFFENSIVE SPECIALIZATION
The third Spire radiated gentle luminescence...green-gold-blue light emanating from its structure in rhythmic pulses.
Circular rather than angular architecture, flowing curves rather than harsh edges. Its designation proclaimed...THE VERDANT CYCLE - SUPPORT SPECIALIZATION
At this moment, Noah stood on golden sands alongside Khor and many others, all watching the entrance of The Iron Concordat Sovereign Spire with focused attention.
They were witnessing the emergence of the first entity to undergo Civilization Specialization transformation.
The massive obsidian-gold doors of the Spire opened with resonant sound that seemed to vibrate through existence itself as...
Titano walked out.
His figure was adorned in Civilizational Armor of Mana and Hunger that now shone with pure obsidian-gold brilliance rather than the mixed coloration others displayed.
The armor had transformed...becoming far more massive, far more imposing, covered in layered crystalline plates that overlapped with sophisticated precision.
He looked absolutely magnificent, a walking embodiment of impenetrable defense.

On his chest, prominently displayed where all could observe, was inscribed massive obsidian-gold shield...the mark distinguishing him as member of The Iron Concordat, as one who had chosen the path of
The Infinite Bulwark.
The armored head opened with mechanical precision to reveal
Titano's giant features, his expression holding a mixture of satisfaction and solemn recognition of responsibility he had accepted.
He looked directly toward Noah and spoke with a voice that
resonated with newfound authority.
"Brother! Titano can protect everyone now. No one will fall while Titano stands. This...Titano promises!"
He could protect everyone now.
Noah smiled genuinely at such an earnest declaration as he nodded
with approval and pulled up Titano's current status information through his Undefined Potential's analytical capabilities.
ENTITY DESIGNATION: Titano
CIVILIZATION SPECIALIZATION POTENTIAL: Sovereign Potential
(Legendary 5th Seal)|
CURRENT SPECIALIZATION: The Infinite Bulwark (The Iron
Concordat)]
COMPLEXITY AND PURITY: 8 Sextillion
SPECIALIZATION EFFECTS:
|- Offensive Capability: Reduced to 0% (Complete Sacrifice)|
|- Defensive Capability: Multiplied by 20x due to Sovereign Potential
enhancement
- Immovable Presence: Active - Cannot be displaced without
consent
|- Civilization Fortress Formation: Available]
|- Damage Conversion: Active - All absorbed damage can be
channeled to offensive specialists
- Existential Anchoring: Radius 500 Gigaparsecs - Reality stabilization preventing spatial manipulation|
- Regenerative Resonance: 500% healing amplification active
This entity now represents a mobile fortress. Offensive capability
completely eliminated but defensive capacity elevated to truly extraordinary levels.
Noah's eyes burned with brilliant intensity at a single number as
everything else wss pushed aside.
8 Sextillion.
That was not a calculation error or display malfunction! Titano had originally possessed 300 Quintillion Complexity and Purity
as recipient of the elevated Boon of Major Mana and Hunger Bulwark.
Adding the 100 Quintillion from his fused Primus Inevitability brought him to 400 Quintillion baseline.

After selecting his Specialization and undergoing transformation, that 400 Quintillion had been multiplied by 20x through his Sovereign Potential's enhanced benefits...resulting in effective defensive rating of 8 Sextillion!

For defensive purposes, Titano now effectively possessed protection exceeding Noah's own Architect's Bulwarks threshold of 3 Sextillion...and yet Titano was considered a bastion of his Civilization- a wall as no damage would flow to him unless it bypassed Titano!
And when there were tens of millions of tanks in his Civilization...the
enemy would need to be ridiculously powerful to ever even hope to touch his grandeur and immensity.
This was a glimpse of how his terrifying Civilization Specialization could utterly change things from here on out!

chapters.title: Chapter 4467 Immense! III
paragraphs: Titano was the first.
But not the last.
Noah looked toward Henry, Sigrid, Protos, Riya, The Emperor Penguin, and numerous others assembled on the golden sands.
Oh, Protos!
Noah himself could not undergo Specialization as he embodied and controlled it all, but Protos, The Primus Inevitability bound to him... "Haha..."
Noah couldn't help but laugh as his eyes flashed with unbound Tyranny!
Titano's power was a result of both him and his fused Primus Inevitability, 300 + 100 Quintillion multiplied by the effects of the Specialization.

Noah couldn't undergo Specialization, but Protos could as when he did so, as someone with an even higher baseline than Titano and many others, paired with his Civilization Specialization Potential...oh!
This was why Noah couldn't help but laugh!
He also looked at all the others.
They would soon receive opportunity to specialize and potentially gain Complexity and Purity exceeding 8 Sextillion.
And Noah emphasized potentially because he also planned to elevate their Civilization Specialization Potential through Harvest
investment...which would accelerate advancement speed dramatically while also increasing the multiplicative benefits they received from Specialization transformation!
His imposing words emerged with commanding authority.

"Choose the Civilization Specialization that aligns most authentically with your fundamental nature. Become bastion if protection calls to your existence. Become sword if destruction resonates with your purpose. Become healer if preservation fulfills your philosophical disposition. Become anything you genuinely wish to become as we continue the advancement toward objectives that exceed what any individual could accomplish alone!"
OOOH!
Bellows echoed across the Early Veiled Shore as for the first time, mass Specializations commenced within The Primordial Civilization of Mana and Hunger!
Henry moved toward The Crimson Hunger Spire with determined stride...his expression suggesting he had waited for opportunity to unleash accumulated aggression without restraint.
Sigrid approached The Verdant Cycle with measured grace....Order itself gravitating toward healing and defensive stability that aligned with her fundamental principles.
Wait.
Noah blinked as he recalled a line under the Civilization Specialization Potential.
Could someone like Sigrid walk thr paths of both Defense and Healer since they were non-competing Specializations?
Noah's eyes blazed at the thought as his smile became even more devilish!
Riya darted toward The Crimson Hunger with characteristic rebellious energy...seeking power that would let her carve her own path through hostile existence.
Dozens, then hundreds began entering the various Spires...each one
making choice that would define their role within the Civilization's increasingly sophisticated architecture.
The Primus Inevitabilities would soon surge by the millions to choose their terrifying Specializations!
Noah watched with tyrannical satisfaction as his forces underwent systematic transformation.
This...is what separates true Civilizations from mere accumulations of power!
While such magnificent transformations bloomed in distant
territories...
Inside THE Loom.
The domain was vast beyond conventional measurement, structured space where reality itself operated according to deliberately imposed rules rather than natural principles.
Geometric perfection dominated every surface. Light emanated from no visible source yet illuminated everything uniformly.
Within central chamber of this domain, Ambessa's figure could be observed standing with her calm composure.

She had removed the Existence Avatar Diadem, the sophisticated headgear that had allowed her consciousness to pilot the Avatar manifestation outside THE Loom, and now stood in her genuine physical form.
Her hair cascaded like banner of authority. Her crimson-gold eyes surveyed the massive array of screens displaying recorded footage from all nine Avatars' experiences.
Around her, other Avatars who had participated in the deployment stood watching...some with expressions of livid fury, others with analytical focus, few with resigned acceptance of unexpected defeat.
The screens displayed devastating scenes: 2 Million Primus Inevitabilities surrounding the Avatars, the overwhelming coordination of their assault, the systematic collapse of all projections
despite their substantial individual power.
Uniquely, Ambessa's extended conversation with the armored entity did not play on these screens for all present to observe...
At this moment, a voice emerged with authority that commanded
immediate attention...belonging to one who clearly held substantial rank within THE Loom's hierarchy.
"What a unique Civilization we have observed emerging outside our secured boundaries. Ambessa..."
The speaker, Axiom Architect Surion, addressed her directly.
"You can confirm this represents The Derivative Way of Hunger? The connection seems obvious upon initial observation...the tentacles, the consumption mechanics, the relationship with The First Hunger
herself."
Ambessa's calm reply emerged without hesitation but also without
excessive elaboration.
"It...should be classified as Derivative Way of Hunger based on observable characteristics, yes."
She articulated such confirmation, but deliberately withheld additional insight that it might also represent something else entirely. Axiom Architect Surion smiled and nodded with approving gesture.

"Acceptable assessment. Now, regarding performance evaluation: Out of the nine participants in this experimental deployment, you demonstrated sufficient resonance with the Existence Avatar Diadems and exhibited most effective decision-making during engagement
outside THE Loom."
His tone shifted to a formal proclamation.
"You have been selected to receive Boon of Specialization as

recognition of your superior performance. Your standing within THE Loom's hierarchy is about to change substantially. You will be elevated to a leadership position among those who will coordinate all response teams for matters occurring outside THE Loom until THE Fallout concludes.....including systematic management of this... budding Derivative Civilization of Hunger."
"You will be ordained as one of the leaders of The Civilization Guard
of Paradox, a profound honor for any Member of our Civilization!"
HUUM!
Ambessa's eyes flashed with genuine surprise at such unexpected promotion...though she recovered her composed expression almost
instantly.
She simply nodded with slight smile acknowledging the honor.
"I accept this responsibility and will execute assigned duties to the best of my accumulated capabilities."
She turned her gaze back toward the screens displaying the armored
figure who had collapsed her Avatar...that being who possessed such confidence despite facing overwhelming odds, who commanded forces that had systematically eliminated eight other Avatars.
That bold existence...
Was he truly prepared for what was about to come? Because now it wouldn't be experimental deployment of nine Avatars. Now it would be a systematic response from THE Loom itself.
Her smile widened slightly...a mixture of anticipation and something
approaching respect for a worthy opponent.
Let us see how far you can advance before we meet again.
Let us discover whether your confidence is justified or merely arrogance awaiting correction.
The screens continued displaying the aftermath of devastation as a
small subsection of forces within THE Loom began planning its
response to this unexpected challenge.
A small subsection.
The major players themsleves had not even gotten involved as there
was no need to.
A few of the followers of THE Living Paradox merely wanted to take care of an annoyance surrounding Vessels of their Master that were being suppressed by Existence itself since The Fallout had yet to
occur.
This was something minor.
But it did initiate an exchange of conflicts even before The Fallout!

Riya darted toward The Crimson Hunger with characteristic rebellious energy...seeking power that would let her carve her own path through hostile existence.
Dozens, then hundreds began entering the various Spires...each one
making choice that would define their role within the Civilization's increasingly sophisticated architecture.
The Primus Inevitabilities would soon surge by the millions to choose their terrifying Specializations!
Noah watched with tyrannical satisfaction as his forces underwent systematic transformation.
This...is what separates true Civilizations from mere accumulations of power!
While such magnificent transformations bloomed in distant
territories...
Inside THE Loom.
The domain was vast beyond conventional measurement, structured space where reality itself operated according to deliberately imposed rules rather than natural principles.
Geometric perfection dominated every surface.
Light emanated from no visible source yet illuminated everything uniformly.
Within central chamber of this domain, Ambessa's figure could be observed standing with her calm composure.

She had removed the Existence Avatar Diadem, the sophisticated headgear that had allowed her consciousness to pilot the Avatar manifestation outside THE Loom, and now stood in her genuine physical form.
Her hair cascaded like banner of authority.
Her crimson-gold eyes surveyed the massive array of screens displaying recorded footage from all nine Avatars' experiences.
Around her, other Avatars who had participated in the deployment stood watching...some with expressions of livid fury, others with analytical focus, few with resigned acceptance of unexpected defeat.
The screens displayed devastating scenes: 2 Million Primus Inevitabilities surrounding the Avatars, the overwhelming coordination of their assault, the systematic collapse of all projections
despite their substantial individual power.
Uniquely, Ambessa's extended conversation with the armored entity did not play on these screens for all present to observe...
At this moment, a voice emerged with authority that commanded
immediate attention...belonging to one who clearly held substantial rank within THE Loom's hierarchy.
"What a unique Civilization we have observed emerging outside our secured boundaries.
Ambessa..."
The speaker, Axiom Architect Surion, addressed her directly.
"You can confirm this represents The Derivative Way of Hunger?
The connection seems obvious upon initial observation...the tentacles, the consumption mechanics, the relationship with The First Hunger
herself."
Ambessa's calm reply emerged without hesitation but also without
excessive elaboration.
"It...should be classified as Derivative Way of Hunger based on observable characteristics, yes."
She articulated such confirmation, but deliberately withheld additional insight that it might also represent something else entirely.
Axiom Architect Surion smiled and nodded with approving gesture.
"Acceptable assessment.

Now, regarding performance evaluation: Out of the nine participants in this experimental deployment, you demonstrated sufficient resonance with the Existence Avatar Diadems and exhibited most effective decision-making during engagement
outside THE Loom."
His tone shifted to a formal proclamation.
"You have been selected to receive Boon of Specialization as
recognition of your superior performance.
Your standing within THE Loom's hierarchy is about to change substantially.

You will be elevated to a leadership position among those who will coordinate all response teams for matters occurring outside THE Loom until THE Fallout concludes.....including systematic management of this... budding Derivative Civilization of Hunger."
"You will be ordained as one of the leaders of The Civilization Guard
of Paradox, a profound honor for any Member of our Civilization!"
HUUM!
Ambessa's eyes flashed with genuine surprise at such unexpected promotion...though she recovered her composed expression almost
instantly.
She simply nodded with slight smile acknowledging the honor.
"I accept this responsibility and will execute assigned duties to the best of my accumulated capabilities."
She turned her gaze back toward the screens displaying the armored
figure who had collapsed her Avatar...that being who possessed such confidence despite facing overwhelming odds, who commanded forces that had systematically eliminated eight other Avatars.
That bold existence...
Was he truly prepared for what was about to come?
Because now it wouldn't be experimental deployment of nine Avatars.
Now it would be a systematic response from THE Loom itself.
Her smile widened slightly...a mixture of anticipation and something
approaching respect for a worthy opponent.
Let us see how far you can advance before we meet again.
Let us discover whether your confidence is justified or merely arrogance awaiting correction.
The screens continued displaying the aftermath of devastation as a
small subsection of forces within THE Loom began planning its
response to this unexpected challenge.
A small subsection.
The major players themsleves had not even gotten involved as there
was no need to.
A few of the followers of THE Living Paradox merely wanted to take care of an annoyance surrounding Vessels of their Master that were being suppressed by Existence itself since The Fallout had yet to
occur.
This was something minor.
But it did initiate an exchange of conflicts even before The Fallout!

chapters.title: Chapter 4468 Thaumata I
paragraphs: In The Wandering Territories.
The Sanctuary of The First Farmer.

A simple verdant-gold hut stood in the center of many radiant farm fields, a modest structure that seemed almost ridiculous given the concentrated life-force emanating from surrounding plots where entire dimensions were being cultivated like crops.
Elyndra entered the hut with expression mixing nostalgia and calming grief.

Her golden hair cascaded like wheat fields in harvest season. Her blue eyes held depths of accumulated wisdom beyond her apparent age. The verdant-gold dress she wore seemed woven from living plant matter that pulsed with rhythmic vitality.

This was the home her father loved to occupy when he required respite from responsibilities, surrounded by vibrant life all around, tending to growth with his own hands rather than delegating to subordinates.

She closed her eyes and breathed deeply, inhaling the immense force of life permeating the surroundings. The accumulated essence of The First Farmer's cultivation still lingered here, making the simple hut feel sacred despite its modest construction.
In the next moment, a voice echoed from behind her with measured calmness.
"The Perpetual Farmer. Are you prepared for what comes next?"

Noah pushed aside the straw door and entered while surveying the interior with analytical assessment. His eyes catalogued details...the simple furniture, the preserved artifacts, the carefully maintained garden visible through rear window.
Was she prepared?
Elyndra turned to stare at this magnificent entity before her, who had walked into her father's sanctuary as if he belonged there.

His figure approached until he stood mere inches from her position. He tilted his head with expression suggesting genuine curiosity rather than manipulation as he observed the wetness accumulating in her eyes.
His hand reached out with surprising gentleness to wipe away tears that threatened to fall.

She felt the immensity and warmth of hands that appeared capable of crushing her existence or elevating it beyond current limitations. Her blue eyes pulsed like endless sea while examining him, trying to comprehend what exactly he represented, what role she was about to play in his designs.
Because it truly seemed like it would be his designs!
But he pulled his hand away with deliberate motion as he spoke with calm finality.
"You expressed desire to establish a friendship between us, correct? Then let us be friends. Let us discover whether we can successfully guide you toward achieving The False THE designation. Come."
With casual wave of his hand, a blue-gold portal manifested beside them, a spatial tear leading to destinations unknown.
He entered without hesitation or backward glance, as if he had absolute confidence that she would follow.
Moments passed in weighted silence.

Elyndra bit her lips with visible indecision, looking around the hut one final time...at her father's favorite chair, at the preserved tools he had used for his farming, at all the memories this place represented. Then she followed Noah through the portal with determined stride. Father gave me this path. I will walk it to discover where it leads.
Inside the Infiniverse.

Noah and Elyndra materialized before a radiant Crimson Hunger Sovereign Spire of Osmont that floated grandly in conceptual space...this particular Spire positioned outside the Early Veiled Shore, hovering alone in sea of golden sandy dreamlike authority that stretched infinitely in all directions.
Inside a domain filled with the weavings Dreams!
The Spire itself was magnificent in its predatory design. Sleek architecture covered in blade-like protrusions. Crimson light pulsing through obsidian framework with rhythmic intensity.
There existed nobody present at this location apart from Protos.

The First Primus Inevitability stood before the Spire's entrance with arms crossed, radiating heavy aura that made surrounding space distort visibly. His form had grown substantially since his initial emergence...now standing twice as tall as standard Primus Inevitabilities, covered in more elaborate armor, eyes burning with accumulated authority.
Elyndra looked around with expression mixing shock and growing comprehension as she articulated her confusion.
"Where is this place? And what is that...massive structure? Who is that
being radiating such terrifying presence?"
Noah replied with measured explanation.
"This is my home...a small portion of it, at least. This place represents
a space where my Civilization's framework manifests tangibly. I
brought you here to witness something important."
He gestured toward Protos with a casual motion. "Can you perceive
the power level of the being standing before us?"
He smiled with an expression of genuine curiosity regarding her assessment.
Elyndra's eyes trembled as her analytical senses reached out to measure Protos.
She wouldn't be able to fully tell, but...
900 Quintillion Complexity and Purity blazed ahead of her!
For her it just felt overwhelming.

Her own power, 15 Quintillion after accepting the mantle of Perpetual Farmer, seemed to almost mean nothing in comparison. She felt like delicate feather confronting hurricane that could absolutely obliterate her existence without conscious effort.
Regardless of the Nine Principles her father had carefully instilled within her framework! Regardless of all the preparation and engineering that had gone into her creation!
Noah observed her shocked reaction with analytical focus as he continued his explanation.
"This represents his current power level in base form, before he undergoes his transformation. What you're sensing now is merely his
starting point."
He nodded toward Protos with a commanding gesture.
"Proceed."
Protos bowed with formal precision before turning and entering the
massive Spire through doors that opened at his approach.
The Spire began shining with intensifying crimson brilliance as unfathomable transformation commenced within, visible even from external observation as the entire structure pulsed with concentrated
authority.
As this grand metamorphosis progressed, Noah turned his attention back to Elyndra with an expression of assessment and challenge.
"This entity represents one among millions contained within my Civilization who possess comparable power levels. Well, others are

slightly less on average, he's exceptional even among his peers. Right now, he is undergoing transformation that will multiply the power you just measured by more than fifteen times through... Civilization Specialization mechanics."
His voice carried weight of undeniable truth.
"This represents the level of immensity you must achieve if you

genuinely wish to compete at scales we're operating on. You possess the legacy of The First Farmer, he had already engineered your existence specifically for pursuing The False THE designation. I am simultaneously pursuing multiple potential solutions to The Fallout. You represent... merely one option among several."
HUUM!
His eyes fixed upon her with penetrating intensity.

"Surprise me. I harbor substantial doubt regarding your viability as a solution currently. Prove that skepticism wrong. Demonstrate that The First Farmer's legacy constitutes something capable of allowing Civilization to bloom exponentially. Or at minimum, prove that his specific plan to have you personally attain The False THE designation represents achievable objective rather than impossible ambition."
Elyndra trembled even more profoundly at such blunt assessment as she bit her lips with decisive determination.
Her figure turned fully toward Noah as she spoke with eyes shining
with barely contained fervor.

"My father designed my fundamental nature and the Principles instilled within my framework specifically with Perpetual Harvest synergy in mind. The engineering was deliberate and comprehensive. I would require you to... infuse me with substantial quantities of
harvest..."
She spoke straightforwadly.
Noah nodded with calm acceptance.
"I will provide that and more. But first...watch what transformation
actually accomplishes at scale."
The massive doorway of the Spire before them pulsed with blinding crimson radiance as a terrifying figure emerged from within!

chapters.title: Chapter 4469 Thaumata II
paragraphs: Protos had undergone complete metamorphosis.

His form was now substantially more predatory...sleek and dangerous rather than merely imposing. Crimson-obsidian tentacles covered his body in intricate patterns, each one writhing with barely contained aggressive intent.
Multiple serrated maws had manifested across his shoulders, chest, and limbs...each one releasing wisps of concentrated Hunger!
His eyes burned with ravenous crimson light that seemed capable of consuming everything they focused upon.

The pressure he radiated proved so intense that crimson winds and concentrated authority erupted from his form...and became invisible force that inadvertently crashed against Elyndra with devastating weight.
She fell to her knees involuntarily, panting with exertion as her existence struggled to remain coherent under such overwhelming presence.
Beside her, Noah observed with eyes shining with tyrannical satisfaction.
He couldn't suppress the smile that bloomed across his features!
Because the results for Protos were utterly magnificent beyond initial projections.
Noah was the acknowledged leader of this Civilization. Yes, he
embodied all Specializations simultaneously through his Undefined Potential. Yes, he possessed more absurd advancement rates than any individual Member.
But would he truly be excluded from the remarkable benefits that Civilization Specialization provided?
Protos, who had fused with him, who served as his armor and
extension...emphatically rejected such limitation!
His own Civilization would never constrain him. This principle was demonstrated through Protos, whose power was fundamentally Noah's power due to their symbiotic fusion.
And at this moment, that combined power was utterly absurd.

Noah's eyes shone with brilliant intensity as he examined Protos's updated status information. Protos knelt before him with formal reverence and spoke with a voice resonating with accumulated authority.
"I have undergone Specialization transformation for the sake of the Master's advancement. My power is your power. My growth is your growth."
The status sheet materialized with comprehensive details. ENTITY DESIGNATION: Protos - The First Primus Inevitability CIVILIZATION SPECIALIZATION POTENTIAL: Primordial Potential (Mythic 7th Seal)|
CURRENT SPECIALIZATION: The Hungering Maw (The Crimson Hunger)|
BASE COMPLEXITY AND PURITY (PRE-SPECIALIZATION): 900 Quintillion
SPECIALIZATION MULTIPLICATIVE EFFECT: 50x (Primordial Potential enhancement - base 15x elevated to 50x through exceptional Potential synergy)|
CURRENT COMPLEXITY AND PURITY (POST-SPECIALIZATION): 45 Sextillion
SPECIALIZATION EFFECTS:
- Defensive Capability: Reduced to 20% (80% Sacrifice)|
|- Offensive Capability: Multiplied by 50x - All attacks carry devastating destructive potential|
- Consumption Acceleration: 100% efficiency - All defeated enemies immediately converted to power
- Reality Severance: Active - Attacks ignore conventional defenses
- Exponential Hunger Stacks: 10% power increase per kill, stacks indefinitely
- Predatory Instinct: Can perceive optimal attack vectors
automatically
- Feast of Conquest: Can temporarily wield defeated enemies'
abilities
SYMBIOTIC NOTATION: As fused entity with Master, all accumulated
power transfers bidirectionally. Master gains full benefit of Protos's Specialization without sacrificing his own versatility.
After reviewing these shocking specifications, Noah shook his head with genuine marvel at what had been achieved.
He addressed Protos with commanding simplicity.
"Come. Let us demonstrate what our combined framework can
accomplish."

Protos's form dissolved into crimson-obsidian light that flowed toward Noah's existence. The fusion occurred with practiced smoothness as Noah's body underwent dramatic transformation...expanding substantially, becoming far more imposing.

His armored form now stood twice his normal height. The armor itself had transformed, incorporating Protos's predatory characteristics alongside its defensive capabilities. Crimson tentacles woven through blue-gold framework.
Multiple serrated patterns visible across the surface. Eyes burning with combined authority of both entities.
Noah sensed the combined power flowing through his transformed existence as prompts materialized with updated measurements.
COMBINED ENTITY: Noah Osmont + Protos (Fused State)
Your base: 2.25 Sextillion
Protos's base: 45 Sextillion
Combined Complexity and Purity: 47.25 Sextillion
Master retains full versatility and defensive capabilities from
Architect's Bulwarks (3 Sextillion threshold) while simultaneously wielding Protos's overwhelming offensive specialization.
In such terrifying transformed state, Noah turned his attention toward the astonished Elyndra who had collapsed to her knees under the concentrated pressure.
His voice boomed out with authority that made surrounding space
tremble.
"This represents the power level you need to be advancing toward if you genuinely wish to accomplish objectives we're pursuing. Will you prove capable of reaching such heights?"
Elyndra felt the shocking pressure Noah was releasing, the
concentrated authority that made her entire existence feel suppressed, constrained, barely capable of maintaining coherence.
Even though every instinct screamed at her to remain prostrate, to acknowledge overwhelming superiority...
She arduously forced herself to stand upright with visible strain. Her legs trembled. Her breath came in gasps. But she met his burning gaze directly and spoke with a determined declaration!
"I! Am! Capable! My father designed me for this! His legacy will not
fail!"
At such words, Noah nodded with an expression of cautious approval.

"Then let us provide you with starting point. A Boon to elevate your baseline capabilities substantially. All else will follow through systematic cultivation. Whether you prove viable solution or others must be pursued instead... we will continue exploring all available options simultaneously..."
With such proclamation, The Boon of Major Mana and Hunger Bulwark descended upon Elyndra's existence.
The marker of a radiant crown appeared above her, a glowing
designation identifying her as one of the 6,561 blessed recipients who would receive substantial power infusion.

Her Complexity and Purity surged dramatically as the Boon integrated itself into her framework. From 15 Quintillion to 315 Quintillion, a twenty-fold increase that made her gasp with sensation of power flooding through her existence.
Prompts bloomed before Noah's vision with systematic details.

Boon of Major Mana and Hunger Bulwark has been successfully applied to: Elyndra (The Perpetual Farmer)] Granted Enhancement: 300 Quintillion Complexity and Purity Updated Total: 315 Quintillion Complexity and Purity] Additional Benefit: Full capability to efficiently utilize Civilizational
Authority of Mana and Hunger

Cultivation Acceleration: All advancement related to Mana and Hunger principles receives substantial multiplicative enhancement Noah observed her transformation with analytical assessment...noting how her aura had changed, how her presence had become substantially more imposing despite still being incomparably weaker than his own power.
Then he looked at himself, at his combined form with Protos, at the
47.25 Sextillion power flowing through his framework, at all the
capabilities and potential that represented.
His eyes flashed with light of pure tyranny. This is merely the beginning. So much more remains to be
accomplished...
Civilization Specialization has only just commenced. Millions more will
undergo transformation. My forces will become exponentially more
formidable.
And I...will continue accumulating power without theoretical ceiling.
Until The Fallout becomes a minor matter!
He was just getting started.
And existence itself would tremble at what he would accomplish!

undergo transformation.
My forces will become exponentially more
formidable.
And I...will continue accumulating power without theoretical ceiling.
Until The Fallout becomes a minor matter!
He was just getting started.
And existence itself would tremble at what he would accomplish!

chapters.title: Chapter 4470 Thaumata III
paragraphs: Time and glory.
Many across existence had debated their relationship since consciousness first achieved capacity for abstract thought.
Some argued glory required time, that accumulated achievements across eons inevitably produced legendary status through sheer persistence and compound growth.
Others claimed glory transcended time, that single moment of unprecedented action could eclipse millennia of mundane existence.
But the truth was simpler.
If one possessed sufficient time, unfathomable glory became inevitable.
Given enough duration, even modest advantages compounded into overwhelming superiority.
Given enough opportunities, even improbable outcomes manifested through statistical certainty. Given enough accumulation, even incremental growth achieved catastrophic totals.
The question was never whether time produced glory.
The question was whether one survived long enough to benefit from time's multiplicative effects.
Hours passed since the collapse of one of the Vessels of THE Living Paradox.
And in those hours, many, many things changed across the Folds.
Primus Inevitabilities spread across every crevice they could locate. They didn't force any existences to comply with demands or mandates.

But they appeared around and above regions where Living Existences concentrated across Transcendent Folds...distributing Sparks of the Way of Mana blatantly while remaining stationed as silent sentinels.
The implicit message was clear: Take the Spark or don't. But don't interfere with distribution.
Across the Folds, a sense of profound unease and escalating fear spread among Living Existences who considered themselves powerful.
Kleos Councils convened with emergency frequency. Dukes gathered to grasp and understand this unprecedented phenomenon that had manifested without warning or explanation.
Who were these entities? What did they represent? Why were they distributing power freely rather than demanding tribute or
submission?
The questions multiplied faster than answers could be formulated. And while all of this unfolded across populated territories...
The Primus Inevitabilities truly spread across the vicissitudes of the Folds and deep into the Wandering Territories where civilizational authority had collapsed or never existed.
For them, there existed overabundance of fuel to devour.
The Tears in Existence were becoming more and more apparent as THE Creature's Veil continued failing.
The boundary he had erected to separate life from death deteriorated with accelerating velocity.

More and more Dead Existences began flowing into the lands of the living...shambling corpses and malevolent Creatures that had been contained for eons suddenly released into territories unprepared for their presence.
Even though Dead Existences were seemingly considered weak in raw power compared to current Primus Inevitabilities, these terrifying
weapons of Noah's Civilization proceeded to systematically collapse and devour every single Dead Existence they encountered.
No exceptions. No mercy. Complete eradication.

Such systematic purging continued unfolding with methodical efficiency as Sparks of Mana were directed to flow into as many Wheels of Existence and domains as possible, permeating all known territories of Minor and Transcendent Folds.
The Way of Mana was being adopted with urgent frequency.

It didn't discriminate based on ability or lack thereof. It imposed no requirements for existing strength or weakness. It was accessible to anyone because Mana was so pervasive across everything that any single entity could grasp it if they chose.
And so, Noah's Civilization entered period of grandiose expansion.
Rapid. Systematic. Overwhelming.
At the same time...
Inside the Transcendent Paradoxical Folds.

A region existed filled with obsidian-gold rivers flowing through impossible geometries. Mirrors of concentrated Paradox floated throughout the space...each one reflecting reality that contradicted what other mirrors displayed.
In the very center of such a place rested massive corpse of an Early
Creature.
A Dead Early Creature!
This titanic deceased entity was currently observing the pacing, worried figure of none other than Diviticus.
Duke Diviticus.
She floated across this paradoxical region with expression carrying unfathomable worry and mounting tension...as if her very existence could perceive something fundamentally wrong occurring but
couldn't identify the specific threat.
Her instincts screamed warnings. Her framework trembled with foreboding sensations she couldn't rationalize or dismiss.
There was no news of Schrodinger.
Everything seemed to be systematically collapsing around them as
she received fragmented reports of terrifying monstrous entities whose power allegedly eclipsed any legends of Early Creatures that histories recorded.
And her existence could not settle. Could not find peace.
Something within her fundamental nature was shaking with
premonitions she didn't want to acknowledge.
At such moment as she continued pacing with increasing agitation...
CRACK!
The space nearby fractured violently as a terrifying aura swept across the domain, freezing the figure of the Dead Early Creature and Diviticus completely in temporal stasis!
A figure of a Primus Inevitability peeked through the spatial tear. Its eyes flashed with crimson light that seemed capable of perceiving everything about her existence in single glance.
It fully stepped through the crack and gazed at both Diviticus and the Dead Early Creature with an expression mixing analytical assessment
and predatory hunger.

Diviticus was frozen utterly, unable to move anything except her eyes. But she still felt the terror cascading through her existence at being forcefully rendered completely still by mere presence of this entity. Her eyes darted frantically, taking in every detail of the terrifying being that had just arrived uninvited.
And a moment after this initial Primus Inevitability's arrival...
Space cracked again with more violent rupture.
Gloriously, the visage of Protos appeared!
His form was substantially more imposing than the first Inevitability. His appearance alone radiated power many times greater than his
subordinate.
Multiple serrated maws visible across his body. Crimson tentacles
writhing with barely contained aggression. Eyes burning with accumulated authority that suggested he could collapse entire territories through sustained assault.

The moment Protos's gaze landed on Diviticus, she began trembling violently despite the temporal stasis constraining her movement. She felt like her existence was about to collapse just from this gaze
alone, as if his attention itself carried weight capable of unmaking her fundamental nature.
Protos stared at Diviticus with a calm, measured expression before he
spoke.
"I wish for you to understand clearly why the events that are about to occur to you will unfold as they do. Perhaps I can better communicate the underlying principles through a poetic expression..."
The stark contrast between Protos's titanic, terrifying form and his casual mention of poetry was jarring...almost absurd.
But he continued with sardonic amusement coloring his words.
"There once was a Living Paradox consumed by greed, Who took a bite from someone far beyond her reach indeed,

She stole a single drop of blood through treacherous deed, And that tiny drop elevated her, or so she did believe. She thought herself become someone grand in existence vast, Even daring to play with corpses of Early Creatures past,
She built relations and gathered power, thought her die was cast,
Never imagining that stolen blood would seal her fate at last.

And yet, in the end, she remains alone inside her domain small, While follower of the one she robbed now stands before her thrall, She doesn't deserve his presence, his attention, or his call, She only deserves to feel existence devoured, atom by atom, through
it all.
With her pain amplified to extremes beyond what mind can bear,

The last things her existence will know are endless throes of despair, Before collapse and darkness become the only comforts there, This is justice for those who steal from powers they cannot compare."
After completing this terrifying poem delivered with casual cruelty, Protos gazed at Diviticus with an expression mixing sinister amusement and cold finality.
"Did you comprehend the message? Do you understand what your
actions have earned you?"
The frozen figure of Diviticus trembled even more violently, waves of absolute fear cascading through her constrained existence. She couldn't fathom how things had deteriorated to this point so
rapidly. Days ago, she had been a glorious Living Paradox and a Duke of Paradox of substantial power!
Now she faced an entity whose mere presence suggested her collapse was inevitable, and the cause of it...was that drop of blood!
Ozymandias! Osmont! Moiraine!
Oh!
She wasn't even capable of replying or defending herself as at this
moment...
From Protos's form, crimson tentacles covered with countless

miniature sharp jaws began flowing outward like rivers of concentrated Hunger. They surrounded both the figure of the Dead Early Creature and Diviticus herself...encircling them completely, cutting off any possibility of escape.
The glorious voice of Protos echoed throughout the paradoxical

domain with a tone mixing anticipation and methodical purpose. "Well then. Let us commence, shall we? This will take considerable time to execute properly. After all, devouring existence atom by atom requires patience and precision. And I have been instructed to ensure you experience every single moment of what follows."
"Because...Existence can be so unfair, can it not?"
HUUM!
The tentacles began moving with deliberate slowness, approaching
her frozen form with terrible inevitability.
Diviticus's eyes widened with absolute terror as she understood what
was coming.
And she could do nothing to prevent it.
The first tentacle touched her existence...
And the screaming began.

chapters.title: Chapter 4471 Thaumata IV
paragraphs: In a corner of the Early Veiled Shore.
Inside a plot holding tall, vibrant green-gold Auric Vitae Grasses that now grew as tall as 100 meters.
Noah's figure sat cross-legged within such a plot, surrounded by overabundance of accumulated harvest that manifested as floating spheres of concentrated authority.
Before him were the figures of Heidrun, Yoshinami, and Malphas...his Land Lifeforms who had answered his call and become integral components of his grand Civilization.
Heidrun's radiant white-gold hair coat gleamed in the ambient light, her majestic goat form exuding serene, arrogant vitality.
Yoshinami had assumed her human form...wearing a obsidian silk dress that contrasted sharply with her crimson spider eyes that held predatory intelligence.
Malphas maintained his butler attire with characteristic precision, though his posture suggested unusual tension.
Noah calmly stroked Heidrun's coat while contemplating numerous things.
When it came to the many potential solutions to surviving The Fallout, he had come to understand something fundamental.
Similar to his Way of Existence itself, not simply complexity and raw power... but knowledge was unfathomably critical.
The specific type of knowledge could change everything.
And when it came to acquiring more knowledge, he possessed multiple viable sources.
He planned to make another trip to the Earliest Folds very soon. Another source was THE Dead Order, he would be initiating
conversation with her shortly.
Khor represented yet another wellspring of information as more of her memories returned with her terrifying rate of progression toward reclaiming original power.
Khor could also be considered another fully viable solution to surviving THE Loom, as long as she regains her distinction as THE First Hunger!
Many possibilities. Many options.
And yet none of them were where they needed to be. They all required time, and time seemed to be the one resource that remained perpetually scarce.
But another path he had pursued involved utilizing Existential Rollback on his Land Lifeforms...specifically Malphas!

Malphas had served THE Living Emotive directly. He had been granted isolated Everythings of THE Living Emotive herself! If more of his suppressed existence could be systematically restored... substantial information might become accessible.
And at this moment, Malphas had undergone Civilization Specialization in addition to already fusing with a Primus Inevitability.
He had chosen The Infinite Bulwark Specialization...wanting to serve as shield for his Master above all other considerations.
His Complexity and Purity stood at 16 Sextillion due to his remarkably high Potential classification.
Heidrun had specialized to join The Verdant Cycle, choosing healing and support roles that aligned with her nurturing nature.
Yoshinami had specialized to become Hungering Maw, her predatory instincts finding perfect expression in pure offensive power.
Each of them pulsed with tremendous accumulated authority.
At this moment, Noah looked toward the visibly trembling figure of Malphas as he asked with measured calm.
"Did you recover something substantial through the Existential Rollback?"
Malphas nodded with heavy expression...his eyes hiding something that appeared to be a mixture of pain and
and shame.
His voice emerged with uncharacteristic hesitation.
"It is best that I show you the recovered memory directly rather than
attempting to articulate what I've recalled."
With such words, he waved his hands with deliberate
motion....causing an illusory screen to manifest before them.
On the screen, lights began flickering as a scene started materializing
with increasing clarity.

The memory depicted cloudy multicolored domain seemingly composed of countless concentrated emotions given tangible form. The entire space pulsed with feelings...joy, sorrow, rage, serenity...all woven together into environmental fabric.
Within this domain stood two magnificent thrones positioned opposite each other. Between them rested table covered
with...Everythings.
Vibrant multicolored Everythings that radiated such unfathomably
potent authority that even viewing them through memory caused
Noah's existence to pulse.
They were filled with pure Civilizational Authority, distilled essence of THE Living Emotive's accumulated cultivation.
Two beings occupied the thrones.
One appeared to exhibit humanoid female form...though their features remained difficult to focus upon directly, as if their fundamental nature resisted simple observation.
The other was humanoid entity composed entirely of elemental lights and concentrated Everythings...their form seeming not entirely real.
Around this cloudy domain that held the table and thrones, the figure of Malphas could be observed along with two other servants adorned in butler and maid attire respectively.
Their hands held drinks and plates of condensed Everythings...luxury refreshments that would be priceless beyond measure in normal
contexts.
Even more elaborate plates of Everything fluttered around them like attentive servants...ready to provide additional refreshment the moment their masters desired it.
From one throne, a voice emerged with tone of curiosity and mild
concern.
"Emotive, is it acceptable to conduct this discussion with audience
present?"
The speaker gestured toward the figures of Malphas and the other caretakers with subtle motion.
On the opposite throne, THE Living Emotive turned toward THE Living Elemental and laughed with genuine warmth before waving her
hand dismissively.
"Don't concern yourself with them. They won't retain any memories
of this conversation afterwards."
Her tone shifted to become more focused.
"But you came here because you wanted specific clarifications regarding THE Loom's architectural design... I have completed the
specifications for most interior components. The structure will contain many internal domains that are infinitely more vast than even the First Folds themselves."
She leaned forward with evident enthusiasm.

"Early Creatures will permeate throughout it as inhabitants rather than visitors. Unlike how existence currently functions in the Earliest Folds where all Civilizations occupy shared territory, I plan to
separate the Living Existences into different domains... different Shelters."
Her hands gestured expansively.
"So your Primordial Civilization and mine and all others fortunate
enough to gain entry would enjoy their own separate advancement spaces inside grander construct that supports everyone equally... well, equally for the most part at least."

Her expression became more animated. "We would collaborate systematically and cooperate across Civilizational boundaries...and isn't that cooperation something utterly magnificent? There will be structured collaboration and eons upon eons of dilated time with absolutely no conflict, no wars, no wasteful expenditure of resources on mutual destruction..."

Her voice carried weight of profound conviction. "Simply the systematic advancement of all Civilizations contained within. And when the time eventually arrives for The Fallout... the collapse of everything else in Observable Existence outside THE Loom will provide one final burst, one ultimate push of concentrated
resources to our preserved Civilizations." She paused deliberately. "That final harvest may potentially elevate us incrementally closer
toward the next Scale. Toward that glorious Scale that THE Creature
himself stands to be the only one who will successfully reach."
BOOM!
Noah heard such terrifying revelations in this scene...this memory
recovered from a servant of THE Living Emotive as significant information crystallized before him!
THE Loom is designed with separate Shelters for different Civilizations...and one of the reasons behind all of this...ah. His eyes pulsed with intense focus as his mind raced through
implications.
He looked at the still-trembling Malphas with renewed appreciation
and...
"Show me more."
He gave his command.

chapters.title: Chapter 4472 Thaumata V
paragraphs: While Noah pursued knowledge accumulation in a secluded corner of the Early Veiled Shore...
The engine of his Civilization continued churning with relentless momentum.
At this moment, two particular beings were observing the glorious transformations that had swept across the Shore in the hours that had passed since mass Specialization commenced.
The observers were none other than The Queen of Matter and The Shadow Guard of Queen Adelaide- Night!

Both had books floating around them, meticulously documenting the changes and systematic establishment of three distinct factions within the Early Veiled Shore that correlated directly with the Civilization Specializations.

They floated near the center of the Shore above glimmering golden sands. From this vantage point, they could observe that the massive continental landscape had been carved into three distinct territorial spaces.
Each space bore a massive Sovereign Spire of Osmont at its center, architectural anchors around which the factions organized themselves.
The three carved domains represented The Iron Concordat, The Crimson Hunger, and The Verdant Cycle!
Those who had undergone Civilization Specialization could be observed moving together within their respective territories, working systematically to understand their newfound capabilities.

as she whispered to Night a question she already knew the answer to. "Which individual represents the most powerful member of The Iron Concordat currently? Who holds apex position within that defensive faction?"

"Oh?"
