"As of this moment, The Infinite Bulwark Specialization and The Vital

Chorus Specialization are the only two paths considered truly non-competing. Their sacrifices don't overlap, one eliminates offense, the other eliminates different offensive aspects. So they can theoretically coexist within a single existence."

"If someone possesses sufficiently high Civilization Specialization Potential to access multiple paths simultaneously, they can specialize in both of these complementary frameworks. The result? Ridiculous multiplicative effects to their baseline power."

"When general harvest distribution occurs...say, 1 Sextillion Complexity and Purity being allocated, these dual-specialized entities might receive effective harvest of 10 or even 20 Sextillion due to their advancement speed multipliers."

ambitious aspiration.
Time.

when one possessed abundance of it.

Time became unfathomably scarce.
The cruel irony of existence remained that...those who possessed
time rarely required it urgently. Those who required it urgently rarely
possessed sufficient quantity.
Noah's Civilization was racing against a clock that none of them could
observe directly but all of them could feel ticking with inexorable progression.
The Fallout approached!

chapters.title: Chapter 4473 Pathos I
paragraphs: In the Early Veiled Shore.
Riya emerged from the Crimson Hunger Sovereign Spire with a smile, waving goodbye to others who remained inside with a cheerful gesture that suggested nothing was amiss.
But when she turned to look out toward the Early Veiled Shore itself...
Her smile transformed into something melancholic.
Something hollow.
Her radiant figure was surrounded by blue-gold Mana at this moment, her fair skin visible beneath the concentrated authority that wrapped around her like second skin.
Faint crimson tattoos could barely be perceived on her arms, intricate patterns that pulsed with dormant power.

She had released her fused Primus Inevitability to roam with others near Khor for now. Her Civilization Specialization form was in inactive state...The Hungering Maw transformation reduced to those barely visible crimson markings.
At this moment, she moved across the golden sands with a gaze carrying melancholy she never showed others.
Because the others don't need to know.
They don't need to carry this burden alongside me.
She closed her eyes as she sensed that brilliant anchor...that sun which constantly emitted calming heat despite everything else in existence growing cold.
She took a step with natural instinct guiding her toward it.
When she opened her eyes again, she found herself in field of green-gold verdant grasses stretching impossibly tall around her.

She observed the figure of Noah watching an illusory screen displaying some recovered scenes. Heidrun, Yoshinami, and Malphas were present in the surroundings...each processing whatever information was being revealed.
Riya looked at the scene unfolding on the screen.

She saw a woman surrounded by swirling emotions seated on elaborate throne, talking vibrantly to another entity opposite her who was surrounded by terrifying elemental waves of concentrated brilliance.

On the screen, the visage of Malphas could be observed as he carried ornate jug filled with vibrant Civilizational Everythings of Origin. He was approaching to refill the cup of THE Living Emotive who motioned for him impatiently as her vessel had emptied.
THE Living Emotive's voice emerged with enthusiasm.

"So entry into THE Loom isn't going to be available for everyone who desires it. THE Living Existences have to pay to secure access, alongside however many Early Creatures, Living Existences, and even lesser Fold Dwellers you wish to bring with your Civilization. Each individual requires ticket to board this grand ride. And-"
As THE Living Emotive spoke with mounting excitement, her terrifying power leaked outward slightly.
The pressure was so immense that Malphas, who was in the process
of pouring the liquid Everythings into her cup, trembled violently and stumbled from the overwhelming authority.
The jug tilted too far.
Liquid Everythings gushed out uncontrolled and splashed directly onto THE Living Emotive's hand!
The moment such accident occurred, the entire atmosphere
changed.
The air became heavy.
Malphas trembled while attempting to bow in immediate apology, but before he could articulate words-
"You fucking insect."
The words from THE Living Emotive carried such weight that
surrounding reality distorted visibly.
In the next moment, she dropped her cup deliberately. It fell to the
cloudy surface with resonant sound.
Her voice emerged with cold authority.
"Pick it up."
Malphas trembled as he moved to obey...descending to retrieve the fallen vessel. The other maid and butler servants behind him watched
with visibly shaking eyes as tension mounted.
The moment Malphas bent to grasp the cup...
THE Living Emotive's hand shot out with vicious speed, grabbing
Malphas's head and smashing it against the cloudy surface!
She then used her leg to keep his face pressed firmly to the ground- applying steady pressure that prevented any movement.
Her words emerged with twisted satisfaction.

"While I am conducting such important strategic discussions with an esteemed colleague, you make a mistake? You tasteless void of emotion. How exactly did that make you feel? Can you even comprehend the shame you should be experiencing right now?"
Malphas trembled while his face was being pushed down with
increasing force.
"I... I beg for your forgiveness, Miss. I did not mean to cause offense or
disruption..."
"No. You never mean to."
Her voice dripped with contempt.
"You lack the vibrant spectrum of emotions. You are tasteless. Gray.
Cheap, watery sentiment that can be easily consumed if it makes mistakes. So don't make mistakes. Understood?"
Malphas's reply emerged as broken whisper.
"Yes, Miss. I understand completely. It will not occur again."
"Stay down there for now and reflect properly on your failure."
THE Living Emotive's face twisted into disturbing smile as she waved her fingers with a casual motion.
From Malphas's prostrate body, she systematically harvested the
emotions and Everythings he was generating...misery, fear, despair, shame...all the concentrated negative sentiments produced by his
humiliation
By her purposeful insults!
She caused them to flow directly into her mouth.
She swallowed them with visible pleasure while licking her lips
appreciatively.

Opposite her, THE Living Elemental displayed an expression of profound disgust. He shook his head with barely contained revulsion. "Must you engage in such treatment toward your own people? This seems... excessive."
THE Living Emotive's eyes flashed dangerously as she sneered.
"Are you actually presuming to instruct me on how to conduct my Way of Existence? My Way is The Way of Emotions. The Way of Feelings. Misery, despair, fear...all the negative emotions are most
prevalent across existence. Most potent. Most delicious."
Her foot twisted on Malphas's head as she continued.

"I occasionally share my own accumulated misery and negativity with this insect and others like them. Then I systematically wipe their memories clean and start the cycle again. Even now, this one and those servants observing will remember nothing of this encounter.
This is my Way. Don't fucking insult it."
Her voice intensified.
"I don't tell you how your fire or ice should manifest, do I? Oh, now
you've gotten me genuinely heated..."

THE Living Elemental's expression became even more sour. In his eyes flickered emotion suggesting he hated dealing with Emotive above all other entities. As if she was extraordinarily difficult to manage and all recognized this fact.

chapters.title: Chapter 4474 Pathos II
paragraphs: The words of THE Living Elemental emerged with forced calm.
"Let us simply continue our discussions and forget this incident occurred. My sincere apologies for overstepping boundaries."
At such words, THE Living Emotive's expression shifted instantly, transforming from apparent fury to exaggerated happiness in single breath.
Down below, her foot continued twisting on Malphas as she drew more and more concentrated misery from his existence.
"Yes, yes! Let us continue discussing THE Loom's entry requirements..."
Her eyes shone with manic light containing countless swirling emotions.
This was her Way of Existence.
This was the true Emotive!
The scene on the illusory screen began fading as the recovered memory reached its conclusion.
Malphas, the present version observing this revelation, trembled violently. His eyes looked lost. Decimated. Absolutely shattered as he shook his head with broken whisper.
"I... I knew her differently. All the memories I retained portrayed her as kind to me and others. She would confide in us. Share her
Everythings of anger, of misery, of doubt. We were.."
What he thought he knew about his previous Master crumbled rapidly.
Malphas seemed almost defeated by this revelation!
Nearby, Heidrun moved closer, nudging his hand gently with her muzzle to provide wordless consolation.
Yoshinami hesitantly raised her hand as she awkwardly patted the butler's shoulder with uncharacteristic gentleness.
Noah sighed as he articulated his measured observation.

"Nobody reveals their true nature easily. Even those closest to us can witness entirely different faces than what actually exists beneath surface presentation. Masks are universal...worn by weak and powerful alike."
His voice carried weight of promise.

"In the future, if and when we grow sufficiently capable... I will see about the possibility of arranging a face-to-face encounter with THE Living Emotive herself. And just as she stepped on you and called you an insect... if you possess it within your existence to reciprocate such treatment... I will attempt to make that outcome possible."
BOOM!
His words discussed such terrifying prospect casually... as if confronting THE entity was merely a future logistical challenge rather than suicidal impossibility.
Malphas trembled as he nodded absently...as if he hadn't truly processed the statement and remained locked in internal turmoil.
Noah turned toward the newcomer.
Riya.
He saw her melancholic expression clearly as his own demeanor shifted. His eyes narrowed as he spoke with directness.
"Really? You're telling me there's absolutely no change? Nothing at all?"
He could read her existence with precision unlike Kael and her father
who remained oblivious to what she alone perceived.
Her entire existence was surrounded by melancholy as at this moment, the normally bright Riya nodded with an exhausted
expression.

"With Civilization Specialization creating such a terrifying explosion of accumulated power... with all these newly rising entities capable of forming a glorious Bastion of Mana... every time I witness all these magnificent developments occurring around you, all these incredible achievements you continue accomplishing...
She paused with visible strain.
"I check for the brilliance of Mana in the future. And... even now, Mana still dims. It doesn't make sense. It truly doesn't make any logical sense given what we're achieving..."
Her voice dropped to near-whisper.

"The only change I can perceive is that Mana doesn't disappear completely anymore. Instead of total extinction, 99% of the brilliant sun that is Mana gets snuffed out. Only embers remain flickering in darkness where blazing glory should persist."
Noah absorbed this information as his eyes flashed with coldness.
So even with all this, everything still collapses?
And only glimmer of my Civilization survives because it's Primordial?
Only for me to emerge like Khor or THE Dead Order...returning from near-total dissolution in some distant era?
His gaze was absolutely frigid.
It truly didn't make sense that with all this unprecedented progress, the only change manifesting was... not complete collapse.
But even while hearing this devastating assessment, it still didn't alter what he planned to do.
I will continue regardless. I will advance until either I succeed or existence itself prevents further progression.
Riya reached out toward Noah at this moment. Her blue eyes showed exhaustion from being the only one who continued feeling Mana dimming in future, a burden she carried alone while others celebrated
victories.
Her voice emerged as quiet plea.
"Can you...keep me company for a bit? Just to occupy my mind with something other than watching everything we're building fade into
darkness?"
Could he keep her company.
Noah's hardened gaze softened at such vulnerable request.
He looked at this gorgeous woman before him as...

He scooped her into his arms with a smooth motion. She closed her hands around his neck gratefully as she laid her head against his chest, seeking comfort from the one anchor that remained constant regardless of what futures she perceived.
Noah turned to Malphas as he spoke with firm authority.
"Take time to process what you've learned. Let me know if you require

anything. Unlike your previous Master who viewed you as disposable insect... I consider you one of the more capable existences surrounding me. You can achieve unfathomable immensity that THE Living Emotive could never have imagined possible."
Malphas nodded with an expression mixing devastation and gratitude.
Noah took single step and disappeared in the next moment.
Because as always in existence, you had to make time for little things.
Sometimes the little things made existence fulfilling.
The golden grasses swayed in breeze as Malphas remained kneeling...supported by Heidrun and Yoshinami.
In The Transcendent Law Folds.
In The Heart of Law.
Inside a coliseum-like structure filled with rising white marbled pillars

that stretched toward impossible heights. The sleek silver marbled floor reflected ambient light with mirror-like perfection. Multiple statues of legendary Dukes of Law surrounded the space...each one carved with meticulous detail depicting figures who had shaped Law's
history across eons.
At the center of such magnificent architecture sat Alexander and
Seraphina Valorheart on thrones arranged around silver marbled
table.
The figures of Dukes of Law composing the Kleos Council could be observed scattered throughout...standing amidst pillars with expressions mixing anticipation and mounting tension.
Near Alexander stood Malphas in his characteristic butler attire.
He looked upward suddenly as if perceiving something others
couldn't detect yet.
"The Master arrives."

chapters.title: Chapter 4475 Pathos III
paragraphs: Space cracked violently as Noah emerged from the dimensional tear with grace.
His descent was measured. Controlled. Alexander and Seraphina rose from their thrones immediately.
Noah smiled calmly and proceeded to sit on another throne opposite them without requesting permission or waiting for invitation.
He looked at both Alexander and Seraphina as his smile widened.
"It seems you two were successful in your endeavors? I was rooting for you, Seraphina."
Noah articulated this with knowing amusement.
Because in the past, when he had encountered these two in Aeternitas Concordia, he had advised Alexander how one man's heart could be tied to multiple women without betraying any of them.
It seemed his philosophy had infected The Peacemaker successfully! After his words, Seraphina Valorheart visibly relaxed, as if confirming he remained the same entity they had met all those days ago.
Alexander also breathed out with relief, his gaze affirming Noah held no connections to THE Loom despite the terrifying power he and his forces displayed.
Alexander's words emerged with measured directness.

"I did not anticipate the absolutely terrifying power that your forces and you personally seem to be wielding. This creates certain possibilities that I believed would only become viable weeks or months down the timeline after my own substantial personal advancement."
His eyes gleamed with calculated hope.
Noah looked toward Alexander as he nodded.
"Oh? What possibilities?"
Alexander continued.
"In the Earliest Folds during the initial conflicts, when forces of THE Living Emotive and THE Living Paradox were systematically
deployed... The Primordial Civilization of THE Living Law was targeted specifically by combined armies of Emotive and THE Living Elemental."
He paused deliberately.

"Some of the more powerful components of Law's forces were scattered during systematic assault. The major battle had already occurred, THE Heart of Law itself was decimated and fractured through combined assault from THE Living Paradox and THE Living Emotive working in coordination."
His expression grew somber.

"In that catastrophic engagement that followed, the armies of Emotive and Elemental pursued the surviving vestiges of Law who were desperately carrying a shattered fragment of THE Heart of Law itself, attempting to preserve it from complete annihilation."
Alexander leaned forward.

"For the sake of saving one of the remaining vestiges of his collapsed Civilization along with that precious fragment... THE Living Law instituted an Existential Injunction and froze everything and everyone."
His voice intensified.

"The vestiges of his own collapsed Civilization holding the shattered Heart fragment... and the pursuing armies of Emotive and Elemental that would have systematically eliminated them... all were frozen across eons of time and contained in what's called the Injunction Sanctuary of Law."
He placed his hand on his chest.

"Countless powerful Living Laws have been frozen there across incomprehensible duration, still holding the shattered fragment they were trying to preserve. But frozen alongside them are the terrifying armies that would have annihilated them completely."
At this critical point, Alexander looked toward Noah with eyes shining.
"I have obtained the inheritance of THE Living Law. This Injunction Sanctuary represents something I was planning to reclaim after growing sufficiently powerful over coming weeks and months."
His voice dropped.

"THE Remnant Will of THE Living Law itself expressed profound regret that we lack time. That if we possessed sufficient duration to systematically reclaim the shattered Heart fragment and other scattered components of the collapsed Civilization... there existed genuine possibility of reconstituting power close to or exactly at THE entity level."
He shook his head.

"Power sufficient to withstand The Fallout entirely. But THE Living Law was woeful that time remains insufficient. That I wouldn't reach Sextillions and Septillions in Complexity fast enough through conventional advancement."
His gaze fixed upon Noah with intensity.

"But you... it appears your forces alone already operate at those power levels. If we assault this Injunction Sanctuary together... the terrifying armies of Emotive and Elemental frozen within...forces that should range within Sextillions in Complexity...we may actually prove capable of systematically collapsing them."
His voice carried weight of proposal!
"We could save the collapsed Civilization of Law. I could obtain the shattered Heart fragment and potentially begin to reconstitute THE Living Law's power. What do you think?"
Beside him, Seraphina Valorheart looked visibly tense as this
monumental proposition was said.
The Dukes of Law scattered throughout the coliseum appeared even more strained...several possessed ashen faces as if they desperately hoped this conversation would proceed differently.
As if they didn't want the weavings of Law to be shared with others!
Noah maintained his focused gaze on Alexander as he eventually nodded with calm finality.
"I have armies being forged just waiting to be directed at appropriate
targets. Acceptable. I will join in on this fun."
His simple agreement caused Alexander's face to relax substantially,
though caution remained.
"It will be extraordinarily dangerous. The forces of Emotive and Elemental frozen in that Sanctuary represent genuine Primordial Civilizations before most withdrew into THE Loom. The engagement
will be absolutely brutal."
Noah's smile only widened at such warning as he responded with tyrannical satisfaction.
"I appreciate brutality above most other approaches. Come. Let us prepare for the assault."
Inside The Early Veiled Shore.
In the Abode of The Early Creature, Osmont.
Inside an isolated domain of this abode.
Different layers of seas composed of blue-gold Primus Mana
stretched across the space endlessly. Radiant rays of concentrated blue-gold light permeated everything...filling the domain with ambient glow that pulsed rhythmically.
At the very center of such magnificent space, Noah's figure could be
observed lying atop the surface of the radiant sea. His toned physique was bare as a veil of concentrated Primus Mana covered him and the figure of Riya snuggled contentedly in his arms.
As if this moment stripped away some of the many burdens weighing
on her existence.
Noah's eyes remained clear as he contemplated the conversation
another instance of himself had just conducted with Alexander.
"An Injunction Sanctuary of Law..."

He raised his hand upward as he looked at the infinite seas of Primus Mana stretching above and below...thinking about how the Specialists of his Primordial Civilization would receive opportunity to be deployed against forces from genuine Primordial Civilizations. The same Civilizations whose leaders I just witnessed discussing THE Loom's construction through Malphas's recovered memories...
Glorious!

chapters.title: Chapter 4476 Pathos IV
paragraphs: As he contemplated these implications, his existence began buzzing with intensity.
Above him, the infinite seas of blue-gold began trembling and vibrating violently as even grander waves of accumulated harvest began flowing from conceptual heights.
They crashed down onto Noah with tremendous force!
Prompts materialized with systematic precision.
The elevated 20% harvest of Everything related to Mana and Hunger across Observable Existence has reached the set harvesting threshold and is being systematically collected through Existential
Communication and Permeation.
The substantial harvest generated by the resurgence of The Primordial Civilization of Law has been collected and processed.]
The accumulated efforts and harvest of your rapidly advancing Civilization have been consolidated.
All collected essence flows into The Walls of Your Civilization, specifically into The Architect's Bulwarks for systematic integration.|
CONSOLIDATION IN PROGRESS...
Noah stared directly at the approaching harvest as it smashed into his existence with overwhelming force.
His power began surging upward with dramatic velocity!
Even without closing his eyes to perceive his manifested Civilization directly, he could feel the walls of The Architect's Bulwarks rising, becoming substantially more fortified, more impenetrable.
Additional prompts bloomed before his vision.
The Architect's Bulwarks have undergone substantial elevation through accumulated harvest integration.
Protection Threshold Increased: 3 Sextillion to 21 Sextillion
Any entity wishing to harm your existence must now exceed 21 Sextillion offensive power while also being member of established Civilization.
CRITICAL NOTATION: A fundamental component of your existence has been detected as fused with a Member of your Civilization who has undergone unique Specialization.|
The harvest flowing into the fused entity (Protos) through symbiotic connection is being amplified tremendously due to Civilization Specialization multiplicative effects.
Protos's Complexity and Purity after all amplifications through Civilization Specialization mechanics: Increased by 108 Sextillion from this harvest cycle.
Updated Total for Protos: 153 Sextillion
Your combined Complexity and Purity: 174 Sextillion
Noah absorbed these specifications as his smile widened with tyrannical satisfaction.
Even though Specialists appear to gain tremendous benefits from Civilization mechanics... I will always advance further. I will always claim grander boons...
Final prompts materialized with additional critical information.
The Boon of Major Mana and Hunger Bulwark has undergone substantial elevation.
Previous Boon Value: 300 Quintillion Complexity and Purity]
Updated Boon Value: 1 Sextillion Complexity and Purity
After applied through amplifications and elevations of Civilization Specialization mechanics, Specialists receiving this Boon are
projected to gain effective power ranging from 12 Sextillion to 40+ Sextillion depending on:
|- Their Civilization Specialization Potential classification
- How many Specialization paths they have integrated into their existence
|- Synergistic effects between multiple Specializations
Your Civilization's power distribution has become catastrophically elevated.]
After these revelations concluded...
BOOM!
The snuggling figure of Riya erupted with concentrated power!
The surrounding existence vibrated and trembled at her sudden brilliance. Noah gazed at her with analytical focus as he perceived her Complexity and Purity had just surged dramatically.
59 Sextillion!

Her hair pulsed with liquid blue-gold Mana flowing through each strand like living rivers. Her eyes shone as if releasing immense waves of concentrated brilliance that illuminated everything around them. She felt such terrifying power coursing through her framework as she stretched luxuriously and looked at Noah's rested figure.
Her smile turned devilish as she spoke with a playful challenge.
"It seems I'm sufficiently energized to continue, Ancestor. Come on, don't make me wait!"
Waves of blue-gold Mana covered the region as an Ancestor was challenged directly.
And he accepted that challenge with enthusiasm.
His other instances moved across different aspects of existence preparing for numerous objectives.
One of those being thr potential confrontation with forces from Primordial Civilizations that had been frozen across eons.
And then...
The Vessels of THE Living Paradox continued being searched for
without success yet.
His Primus Inevitabilities continued spreading across all territories.
His Civilization expanded relentlessly!
Effort and failure.
Many across existence poured tremendous quantities of effort into
their pursuits.
They cultivated systematically. They planned meticulously. They sacrificed everything they possessed toward achieving objectives they
deemed worthy.
And yet regardless of what they accomplished, regardless of all accumulated effort...
They seemed to progress nowhere.
Failure after failure.
Some proclaimed that as long as you invested sufficient effort, your
results would eventually be rewarded proportionally.
Which begged the fundamental question...What of the rewards for
those who invested countless efforts as they now lay collapsed in
endless darkness?
What fruit did their effort bear if they experienced only systematic failure until their existence ceased?
A question along these lines was asked...in the Earliest Folds.
A particularly brilliant Fold Dweller sat beside THE Creature near modest hut inside vast shore stretching infinitely.
Before them, THE Creature had summoned several Inevitabilities who
were nudging their tentacles against his hand affectionately...as if they were beloved pets seeking attention.
Anaximander watched this unexpected scene with genuine
fascination.
At such moment, Anaximander posed question that had been troubling him since he began talking to THE Creature.
"If your Way is The Way of Existence itself... do the efforts of every
lifeform elevate your framework? Or only the efforts that successfully bear visible fruit?"
At such inquiry, THE Creature's response emerged.
"All effort bears fruit without exception. The effort that culminates in
success bears fruit. The effort that results in failure also bears fruit. There isn't a single entity across existence that invests effort... where that effort fails to produce fruit of some nature."
He paused deliberately.
"Effort will always, unequivocally, bear fruit. Now, the specific form

that fruit manifests as... is sometimes not immediately known or properly understood by those who generated the effort. But I benefit from all effort regardless of whether the one exerting it perceives
success or failure."
Anaximander absorbed such words with characteristic focus before nodding slowly.
THE Creature continued with an expression growing more contemplative.
"One of the existences who has invested the most sustained effort
while facing supposed failure after failure... he is known as The First Farmer. I pitied him profoundly. And unfortunately, my pity has
already made him target for those who view my compassion as weakness to be exploited."
His voice carried mixture of respect and regret.
"I envy the extraordinary level of effort that creature proved capable

of continuing to invest... even after experiencing all his supposed failures. Failure after failure after failure, and he persisted regardless. He never surrendered. He never accepted defeat as final." THE Creature's gaze grew distant.
"Now that represents genuine effort. And that accumulated effort
through endless apparent failure... I am absolutely certain it will bear its own unique reward for him eventually. Perhaps not in forms he
anticipated. Perhaps not in timelines he desired. But fruit will manifest from such persistent cultivation."
The words carried profound weight as Anaximander simply listened.
In the current era.
In the Wandering Territories.
Inside the Sanctuary of The First Farmer.
The grave stood surrounded by dazzling plots of systematic
cultivation, holding vibrant herbs that pulsed with concentrated life-force and Trees of Matured Principles that waved their branches gently to invisible wind.
Everything remained precisely as it should be.
And yet...
At this moment...
The silent grave of The First Farmer began shining. Radiant verdant-gold brilliance erupted from the burial site!
A brilliance representing profound effort and systematic failure began blooming as heart-shaking aura started rising from the grave itself!
The accumulated effort of one who had failed countless times yet never surrendered was manifesting tangibly!
The moment such phenomenon commenced...
CRACK!
Space fractured violently above the grave as Noah's figure
materialized.
He looked down at the shining grave of The First Farmer with eyes
that analyzed every detail of what was occurring. Noah floated there silently, his gaze sharp as he sensed an immensity
of existence erupting from this grave!

His other instances moved across different aspects of existence preparing for numerous objectives.
One of those being thr potential confrontation with forces from Primordial Civilizations that had been frozen across eons.
And then...
The Vessels of THE Living Paradox continued being searched for
without success yet.
His Primus Inevitabilities continued spreading across all territories.
His Civilization expanded relentlessly!
Effort and failure.
Many across existence poured tremendous quantities of effort into
their pursuits.
They cultivated systematically.
They planned meticulously.
They sacrificed everything they possessed toward achieving objectives they
deemed worthy.
And yet regardless of what they accomplished, regardless of all accumulated effort...
They seemed to progress nowhere.
Failure after failure.
Some proclaimed that as long as you invested sufficient effort, your
results would eventually be rewarded proportionally.
Which begged the fundamental question...What of the rewards for
those who invested countless efforts as they now lay collapsed in
endless darkness?
What fruit did their effort bear if they experienced only systematic failure until their existence ceased?
A question along these lines was asked...in the Earliest Folds.
A particularly brilliant Fold Dweller sat beside THE Creature near modest hut inside vast shore stretching infinitely.
Before them, THE Creature had summoned several Inevitabilities who
were nudging their tentacles against his hand affectionately...as if they were beloved pets seeking attention.
Anaximander watched this unexpected scene with genuine
fascination.
At such moment, Anaximander posed question that had been troubling him since he began talking to THE Creature.
"If your Way is The Way of Existence itself... do the efforts of every
lifeform elevate your framework?
Or only the efforts that successfully bear visible fruit?"
At such inquiry, THE Creature's response emerged.
"All effort bears fruit without exception.
The effort that culminates in
success bears fruit.
The effort that results in failure also bears fruit.
There isn't a single entity across existence that invests effort... where that effort fails to produce fruit of some nature."
He paused deliberately.
"Effort will always, unequivocally, bear fruit.
Now, the specific form
that fruit manifests as... is sometimes not immediately known or properly understood by those who generated the effort.
But I benefit from all effort regardless of whether the one exerting it perceives
success or failure."
Anaximander absorbed such words with characteristic focus before nodding slowly.
THE Creature continued with an expression growing more contemplative.
"One of the existences who has invested the most sustained effort
while facing supposed failure after failure... he is known as The First Farmer.
I pitied him profoundly.
And unfortunately, my pity has
already made him target for those who view my compassion as weakness to be exploited."
His voice carried mixture of respect and regret.
"I envy the extraordinary level of effort that creature proved capable
of continuing to invest... even after experiencing all his supposed failures.
Failure after failure after failure, and he persisted regardless.
He never surrendered.
He never accepted defeat as final." THE Creature's gaze grew distant.
"Now that represents genuine effort.
And that accumulated effort
through endless apparent failure...
I am absolutely certain it will bear its own unique reward for him eventually.
Perhaps not in forms he
anticipated.
Perhaps not in timelines he desired.
But fruit will manifest from such persistent cultivation."
The words carried profound weight as Anaximander simply listened.
In the current era.
In the Wandering Territories.
Inside the Sanctuary of The First Farmer.
The grave stood surrounded by dazzling plots of systematic
cultivation, holding vibrant herbs that pulsed with concentrated life-force and Trees of Matured Principles that waved their branches gently to invisible wind.
Everything remained precisely as it should be.
And yet...
At this moment...
The silent grave of The First Farmer began shining.
Radiant verdant-gold brilliance erupted from the burial site!
A brilliance representing profound effort and systematic failure began blooming as heart-shaking aura started rising from the grave itself!
The accumulated effort of one who had failed countless times yet never surrendered was manifesting tangibly!
The moment such phenomenon commenced...
CRACK!
Space fractured violently above the grave as Noah's figure
materialized.
He looked down at the shining grave of The First Farmer with eyes
that analyzed every detail of what was occurring.
Noah floated there silently, his gaze sharp as he sensed an immensity
of existence erupting from this grave!

chapters.title: Chapter 4477 Iskhus I
paragraphs: Noah watched as the grave trembled and pulsed with mounting intensity.
Immensity could be felt radiating from within!
So profound that moments later...
Prompts materialized before his vision.
A tremendous accumulation of effort and countless failures that have been systematically cultivated across eons are finally reaching ripening stage.
Conditions for unprecedented manifestation have been satisfied.]
Noah absorbed this information with eyes shining brilliantly.

Inside his existence, the Principle of Perpetual Harvest buzzed with sudden intensity, beginning to permeate its green-gold radiance across his entire framework as if resonating with what was occurring below.
Through that resonance, even more detailed information flooded into his consciousness.
Additional prompts emerged with profound implications.
Effort and failure exist as inseparable companions across all cultivation paths.
No entity in Observable Existence has invested comparable quantities of sustained effort while experiencing proportionally equivalent systematic failure as The First Farmer.]
His most recent failure involved deviating from his established path, attempting alternative approaches despite accumulated expertise suggesting otherwise.
And yet, even in this unprecedented effort at innovation... he failed absolutely.
The culmination of an existence defined by cycles of immense effort and continued failure has concluded in ultimate failure, the complete collapse of his existence itself.
But his effort persists across eons regardless of physical dissolution. His failures persist across eons as accumulated weight.]
Boundless and unfathomable effort now blooms paradoxically from complete failure.
This is the fruit that effort bears when invested without surrender across incomprehensible duration.]
BOOM!
From the grave below, a radiant seed erupted upward with explosive force!

It appeared as extremely pristine celestial seed, almost resembling cocoon in its perfectly symmetrical construction. It shone with terrifying green brilliance that illuminated the entire Sanctuary with concentrated authority.
Noah felt immense Complexity and Purity emanating from such object as he observed it spinning gloriously in the skies above the Sanctuary of The First Farmer.
As it rotated with hypnotic precision...
It stopped suddenly.
And sank back down into the ground with deliberate motion.
The vast earth of this endlessly expansive Sanctuary trembled violently. A moment later, something began emerging from the area that had previously been simple grave.
A tree.
An utterly massive tree that vibrated with the concentrated light of an incredible Principle!
When Noah examined it with calmness, he could perceive its
fundamental nature clearly.
A Singularity Principle!
Prompts emerged with clarifying details.
From endless effort and systematic failure, the weavings of The First
Farmer bloom him once more into existence.
This represents unprecedented emergence through accumulated cultivation rather than external intervention.
The fruit of his effort manifests as transformation of his entire
existence into living embodiment of what he pursued across eons.
The emergence of this terrifyingly vast tree representing Singularity Principle continued with dramatic progression.
At the base of the massive trunk, bark composed of concentrated green authority covered with golden leaf patterns, a hand suddenly erupted outward!
A figure began emerging from the glorious tree itself as if being born directly from accumulated effort given physical form.
Fair hands emerged first, gradually followed by entire form of middle-aged man who pulled himself free from the tree's embrace.
His physique was laid bare initially. His skin was covered with countless green Glyphs that appeared like intricate tattoos painting elaborate patterns across every visible surface.
His eyes...
His eyes were terrifying golden beams of concentrated light that gazed around with intensity that illuminated vast lands surrounding
the Sanctuary.
Those eyes eventually landed on the figure floating above, on Noah
who had been silently observing this entire emergence.
They paused on him.
Blinked once.
Noah looked back with completely calm expression that rapidly
became stone-faced as he processed what he was witnessing.
The entity who had just emerged blinked again with apparent confusion before looking down at his own body.
He seemed to gradually recognize that it remained completely bare.
Noah's cold-faced gaze conveyed unmistakable sentiment without
requiring verbal articulation.
As if he was saying...
Dude. Why are you walking around with your junk hanging out?
In the next moment, The First Farmer waved his hand with a slightly embarrassed gesture.

Green robes materialized to cover his form, flowing garments that seemed woven from living plant matter and concentrated authority. His figure began floating upward as he examined himself with expression mixing confusion and gradual comprehension of what had just occurred to his existence.
When he came to float directly before Noah, he simply looked at him. Noah looked back with identical calm assessment.
The two did not speak. They simply analyzed each other with mutual
recognition that words would be premature until proper evaluation concluded.
Noah's eyes flashed as he systematically observed the specifications
of the entity before him.
A status sheet materialized with comprehensive details.
The First Farmer
- The Cultivator of Endless Cycles
- He Who Failed Forward]
- The Persistent One
- Architect of Ten Thousand Unsuccessful Harvests
- The One Who Would Not Surrender] Civilization Affiliations: An Unknown Budding Civilization)|
COMPLEXITY AND PURITY: 100 Sextillion (Exactly)|
CORE PRINCIPLE: The Singularity Principle of Perpetual Effort|

PRINCIPLE DESCRIPTION: This Singularity Principle represents the accumulated weight of effort invested across eons regardless of outcome. It does not require success to generate power, only sustained commitment to continuous cultivation. Each failure feeds this Principle as much as each success. The more effort invested, the more powerful the wielder becomes regardless of whether that effort
produces desired results.
UNIQUE CAPABILITIES:
- Effort Conversion: All energy invested toward any objective,
successful or failed, converts to accumulated power
- Failure Immunity: Cannot be permanently collapsed as long as
effort was genuinely invested
- Resurrection Through Persistence: Will manifest again after any collapse through accumulated effort across existence
- Unfathomable Endurance: Cannot be discouraged, demoralized, or convinced to surrender regardless of circumstances
This entity has undergone transformation from standard existence into living embodiment of his cultivated Principle. He IS Perpetual
Effort given conscious form.
Noah absorbed these specifications with his expression remaining
deliberately neutral.
100 Sextillion Complexity and Purity!
A Singularity Principle born from accumulated failure!
And as Noah looked at the Principle he embodied...
'Is this fucker just copying and pasting?"
The details his new Principle, Perpetual Effort, were very much
similar to Noah's Principle of Perpetual Harvest!
But at the end of the day, even Perpetual Harvest stemmed from The
First Farmer...
The First Farmer continued floating there, golden eyes examining
Noah with equal analytical focus as if performing identical
assessment.

chapters.title: Chapter 4478 Iskhus II
paragraphs: Finally, The First Farmer spoke.
His voice sounded rusty from disuse but carried undeniable authority.
"Thank you for what you did. For allowing events to unfold as they naturally progressed."
He paused, golden eyes flickering.
"If I had not experienced that final failure... I may have continued failing effortfully for whatever duration remained before The Fallout concluded everything."
Noah listened without reply.
The First Farmer continued with visible earnestness.
"I do want to clarify something important. Yes, I did scheme against you...that remains an undeniable truth."
His expression tightened.
"But regarding your analogy about catching me stealing simply representing the first time I was caught rather than first time I stole... suggesting I could have been stealing for eons past..."
He shook his head firmly.
"I truly did not steal repeatedly across my existence. What I did was simply another mistake that led to another failure."
His voice dropped.
"Which ultimately... made way for my effort culminating in collapse itself. And even in that collapse, I paradoxically failed at dying and succeeded in emerging once more."
His golden eyes shone with intensity.
"And so my existence has risen while being systematically molded in the concentrated glow of effort."
He gestured at himself.
"I don't just pursue effort, I embody effort itself as I now cultivate the Singularity Principle of Perpetual Effort. My Way... is The Way of Effort."
The Way of Effort!
Noah heard this and titled his head as he voiced out slowly.
"Effort? Are you sure about that? Why not The Way of Harvest?"
The momentum of The First Farmer faltered as he looked intensly at Noah before he replied.
"No. Effort. Effort is required before any Harvest. Effort is the backbone behind it all!"
HUUM!
The First Farmer seemed set on Effort as Noah sighed internally and simply nodded. He just thought The Way of Harvest sounded better, but okay!
The First Farmer's voice intensified with mounting conviction.
"Regardless of success. Regardless of any harvest or reward. Endless perpetual effort will continue driving existence forward through sheer accumulated persistence."
He looked upward.
"Effort was present when THE Creature established his immensity and incomprehensible power. Effort was there for all THE Living Existences when they founded their Primordial Civilizations."
His arms spread wide.
"Effort was there for the Inevitabilities. Effort has persisted across incomprehensible eons!"
As he articulated these words with growing passion, the surrounding existence began buzzing.
Trembling.
A glorious symphony descended from conceptual heights, filling the Sanctuary with resonant harmonics.
Reality itself vibrated sympathetically!
From within that symphony, a single word began echoing with
mounting intensity.
EFFORT! EFFORT! EFFORT!
The First Farmer's declaration continued as the symphony swelled.
"Effort was present even when all those monstrous beings founded their grand Civilizations!"
His voice rang out.
"And so on this day, after eons of accumulated cultivation, let it be witnessed that I officially follow my Way of Existence that I did not realize in my countless failures!"
His arms spread wide with gesture encompassing everything.
"I did not abandon farming, it will always remain fundamental
component of my nature."
He smiled.
"But the very core principle behind farming itself is effort! The persistent cultivation regardless of whether seeds germinate or harvests succeed!"
His eyes blazed.
"And so I walk The Way of Effort! And so I shall establish... The Civilization of Effort!"
BOOM!
Pure radiant green light emanated from The First Farmer's form.
It expanded outward in concentric waves that illuminated the entire
Sanctuary with blinding brilliance!
Existence continued buzzing with validation.
The symphony bellowing the word "EFFORT" echoed across. dimensional boundaries with such intensity that distant territories surely perceived the phenomenon!
Prompts materialized before Noah's vision.
A Derivative Way of Effort has been successfully established in your presence, bearing semblance of your influential authority.
The Derivative Way of Existence, specifically, The Way of Effort, has catalyzed emergence of a Derivative Primordial Civilization.
DESIGNATION: The Primordial Civilization of Effort CLASSIFICATION: Derivative of The Primordial Civilization of
Existence (THE Creature)
This Civilization will operate under umbrella authority of THE Creature's framework while maintaining independent operational
structure.
The First Farmer has been designated as The Primordial Sovereign of
The Civilization of Effort.
Your observation and contribution for its establishment has created
minor resonance with your own Primordial Civilization of Mana and
Hunger.
Mana and Hunger were present during all moments of Effort across
existence.
Noah absorbed these prompts with eyes shining brilliantly.
His existence buzzed with cascading questions.
A Derivative Way of Existence.
Similar to The Great Usurper!
The First Farmer had declared and founded his Civilization, and it
manifested as a derivative falling under the bastion of THE Creature's Primordial Civilization of Existence.
Noah's mind raced.
Why is it that out of two beings I've personally witnessed establishing
Ways... both connected as derivatives to something belonging to THE
Creature?
When Noah had established his own Civilization of Mana and Hunger,
it was his exclusively.
Not derivative of any overarching framework.
Independent. Self-sustaining.
So why did others' attempts automatically connect to THE Creature's
authority?
His existence buzzed with immensity and mounting questions.
Though no immediate answers presented themselves.
He looked at the figure of The First Farmer with measured
assessment.
"I will accept your assertion that you were not a perpetual thief
across eons."
His voice carried deliberate calmness.
"And we can consider your temporary collapse sufficient repayment
for your transgression against me."
Noah's gaze was steady.
"I always considered it wasteful that someone of your evident caliber,
someone who had cultivated for incomprehensible duration supposedly pursuing righteous objectives...would simply collapse permanently."
His tone carried genuine acknowledgment!
"It seemed like tremendous waste of accumulated potential. But if
that collapse represented the final necessary component for your eons-long existence to bear ultimate fruit..."
He nodded slightly.
"Then perhaps everything worked out optimally after all."
The First Farmer smiled with genuine appreciation.
He nodded with acceptance before his expression shifted to concern.
He began looking around the Sanctuary with searching gaze.
Golden eyes scanned every visible territory. "Where is my daughter?"
His voice carried mounting worry.
"I cannot sense Elyndra anywhere within this Sanctuary. Did
something occur to her?"
Noah blinked at this inquiry.
His expression became oddly neutral before replying with careful
calmness. "She is currently... preoccupied with critical cultivation procedures."
The First Farmer tilted his head.
"Preoccupied with what specifically? What procedure requires such focus that I cannot even perceive her presence?"
Noah replied with straightforward directness. "Well, if you recall your original instructions... you did send her to me
specifically for the purpose of gaining access to Perpetual Harvest." He paused deliberately.
"The objective was propelling her existence and her Nine Principles
forward through systematic infusion of accumulated authority!" Another pause.
"She is currently preoccupied with the... extensive infusion of
Perpetual Harvest into her framework."
His tone remained clinical.
"The process requires sustained focus and cannot be interrupted
prematurely."
His words were delivered with complete calm.
A clinical assessment devoid of suggestive subtext!
But when The First Farmer fully grasped their potential implications...
His eyes flashed with sudden immensity!
He looked at Noah with expression suggesting he was approximately
three seconds from initiating violence!
Noah raised his eyebrows.
His expression almost communicated... Try it and discover exactly
how that works out for you.
But instead, his voice emerged with firm authority.
"Leave her be for now. She is at critical juncture in her transformation
process."
His gaze was unyielding. "Disrupting her concentration could prove catastrophic. Let's discuss
you instead. With your return and emergence bearing this new
Singularity Principle... do you possess any new information or methodologies for surviving against THE Loom?" He tilted his head slightly.
"Anything beyond the admittedly limited plan of having your daughter
somehow attain THE False designation?"
Did he have plans?
The First Farmer was confronted with such pointed inquiry mere
moments after his resurrection.
His golden eyes focused with mounting intensity as he processed the
question.
A moment later, shocking words emerged from his lips.
"Well... in my state of dissolution and collapse, during that transition between existence and non-existence..." He paused, seemingly uncertain how to articulate it.
"I actually heard the voice of THE Creature speaking directly to me."
BOOM!

"Preoccupied with what specifically?
What procedure requires such focus that I cannot even perceive her presence?"
Noah replied with straightforward directness.
"Well, if you recall your original instructions... you did send her to me
specifically for the purpose of gaining access to Perpetual Harvest." He paused deliberately.
"The objective was propelling her existence and her Nine Principles
forward through systematic infusion of accumulated authority!" Another pause.
"She is currently preoccupied with the... extensive infusion of
Perpetual Harvest into her framework."
His tone remained clinical.
"The process requires sustained focus and cannot be interrupted
prematurely."
His words were delivered with complete calm.
A clinical assessment devoid of suggestive subtext!
But when The First Farmer fully grasped their potential implications...
His eyes flashed with sudden immensity!
He looked at Noah with expression suggesting he was approximately
three seconds from initiating violence!
Noah raised his eyebrows.
His expression almost communicated...
Try it and discover exactly
how that works out for you.
But instead, his voice emerged with firm authority.
"Leave her be for now.
She is at critical juncture in her transformation
process."
His gaze was unyielding.
"Disrupting her concentration could prove catastrophic.
Let's discuss
you instead.
With your return and emergence bearing this new
Singularity Principle... do you possess any new information or methodologies for surviving against THE Loom?" He tilted his head slightly.
"Anything beyond the admittedly limited plan of having your daughter
somehow attain THE False designation?"
Did he have plans?
The First Farmer was confronted with such pointed inquiry mere
moments after his resurrection.
His golden eyes focused with mounting intensity as he processed the
question.
A moment later, shocking words emerged from his lips.
"Well... in my state of dissolution and collapse, during that transition between existence and non-existence..." He paused, seemingly uncertain how to articulate it.
"I actually heard the voice of THE Creature speaking directly to me."
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4479 Iskhus III
paragraphs: The First Farmer said that he heard the voice of THE Creature.
Noah gazed at him calmly, waiting.
The First Farmer continued with a voice of weight of recovered memory.
"In that state of collapse and emergence, I cannot accurately measure how much time passed across existence entirely. But for me
personally, it felt instantaneous."
He paused, golden eyes distant.
"In that instant, I remember the voice of THE Creature, the same voice I encountered in the past. That voice said to me simply...find my Early Veiled Shore."
Find my Early Veiled Shore!
Noah looked closely at The First Farmer as he tilted his head with an expression mixing curiosity and frustration.
"That's it? That's the entirety of the message?"
The First Farmer nodded simply.
"That's it."
Noah continued gazing at The First Farmer with deliberate calmness as his mind worked through potential implications and interpretations.
"THE Creature couldn't add a few more words? Add a sentence or two to provide some measure of clarity? Perhaps a helpful direction or specific instruction?"
The First Farmer simply looked at him with expression suggesting he shared identical frustration.
Neither possessed answers.
Eventually The First Farmer's eyes blazed with a light combining effort and accumulated majesty as he articulated his speculation.

"THE Creature represents the entity who was demonstrably strongest amongst all THE beings. Even if THE Living Paradox and THE Living Emotive, alongside any others who aligned with their conspiracy, successfully plotted against him... THE Creature would still possess numerous means of survival and contingency."
His voice carried conviction.
"Maybe the genuine answer to surviving The Fallout resides within his Early Veiled Shore. Maybe that cryptic message contains everything necessary if we can only decipher it properly."
Noah smiled coldly and shook his head as he absorbed this speculation from The First Farmer.
Maybe.
He was hearing that particular word with increasing frequency lately.
When Khor had used it, the uncertainty seemed almost endearing...cute, even.
But as more and more maybes accumulated without resolution...
It was rapidly ceasing to be something he enjoyed encountering.
He looked toward The First Farmer before speaking with direct inquiry.
"Do you possess any tangible clues regarding where to commence an investigation? Any contextual details from your interaction with THE Creature that might prove relevant?"
The First Farmer shook his head with genuine regret.
"No. I shared but a single extended conversation with THE Creature before my collapse. My knowledge remains frustratingly limited."
His expression shifted to earnest appeal.
"But with your aid and combined resources... I feel confident we can both substantially increase our respective chances of survival...not merely for ourselves but for our people as well."
His voice carried weight of responsibility.
"I have countless entities across my Sanctuary who look toward me for guidance and protection. I have my daughter to whom I must make proper amends. I'm certain you possess your own
responsibilities and people dependent upon your continued existence."
He gestured expansively:
"I have just embarked upon establishing my Civilization of Effort. Now

I must systematically forge it into something capable of enduring what approaches. For the benefit of both our Civilizations... collaboration can only increase and elevate our collective capabilities."
His golden eyes met Noah's directly.
"Are we able to let bygones be bygones and commence on entirely
new page? Can we move forward as genuine allies rather than
suspicious acquaintances?"
The First Farmer articulated these words with calm earnestness.
Noah listened without interruption and did not require extended deliberation before simply nodding with acceptance.
He sighed and looked around the Sanctuary before speaking.
"The more the merrier in this band of unfortunate survivors
attempting to defy impossible odds. Tend to your Sanctuary and those who mourned believing you permanently collapsed."
His voice carried finality.
"I will bring your daughter back to see you soon enough."
With such words, Noah disappeared.
Space folded around him and he was simply gone.
The First Farmer remained floating alone.
He gazed at the Sanctuary that had mourned him not long ago.
He was still The First Farmer at his core.
But now he was filled with immeasurable effort given conscious form.
And with every effort invested came even more unfathomable harvest
as consequence.
I may not have succeeded in obtaining Perpetual Harvest directly...
But I was able to forge successfully the counterpart that was
functionally equivalent.
Perpetual Effort.
He smiled with expression mixing sadness and profound satisfaction
as he contemplated this truth.
His voice emerged as philosophical musing directed at existence
itself.
"Effort and harvest exist as two faces of singular principle. One cannot exist without the other across any meaningful duration." He looked at the expanse before him, not merely Sanctuary anymore,
but Civilization.

"The farmer who plants seeds without effort produces no harvest. The farmer who exerts tremendous effort but fails to harvest wastes accumulated potential. But the farmer who understands that effort is harvest...that the act of cultivation itself represents fruit regardless of outcome..."
His eyes shone with golden light.
"That farmer transcends simple success or failure. That farmer
embodies the eternal cycle itself. Plant. Tend. Fail. Learn. Plant again.
Tend better. Fail differently. Learn more. Persist."
He spread his arms wide.
"This is the Way of Effort. This is what I will teach to all who join my
Civilization. Success matters less than persistence. Harvest matters less than cultivation. Results matter less than the willingness to
continue despite results."
His smile widened.
"And through that perpetual effort... harvest becomes inevitable.
Perhaps not the harvest initially envisioned. Perhaps not the harvest
desired. But harvest nonetheless...fruit born from persistence itself!
Oh!"
HUUM!
He descended toward his Civilization with renewed purpose.
Time to begin forging something worthy of surviving what
approaches...
At this moment in time.
In Noah's Early Veiled Shore.
The atmosphere within the vast continental landscape pulsed with
vibrant energy that made the entire territory seem alive with concentrated authority.
The inhabitants carried distinct auras and colors radiating from their
bodies that identified their Specialization paths immediately. To match the three different Specializations currently available, the
factions of The Iron Concordat, The Crimson Hunger, and The Verdant Cycle...different clusters of entities shone with corresponding brilliance.
Obsidian-gold radiance marked those who had chosen defensive
paths.
Crimson-gold intensity identified offensive specialists whose
presence made surrounding space tremble.
Verdant-gold luminescence surrounded support-oriented entities
who pulsed with restorative authority. Defensive, offensive, and support type entities whose attire now
reflected their chosen factions!
The Specializations made everyone seem substantially more vibrant, more alive as they communicated enthusiastically with each other
regarding optimal methods to leverage their collective capabilities. Discussions occurred everywhere!
"If three hundred Bulwarks establish the Fortress Formation while Hungering Maws attack..."
"Vital Chorus members should maintain Life-Binding with all frontline specialists to enable instant resurrection..."
"Damage Conversion from Bulwarks feeding directly into Hungering
Maw....hey, why not feed all collected damage to a single entity rather than spread it around? Could maybe The Master unleash all devoured
damage in the hundreds of Sextillions?"

The entire Shore buzzed with mounting excitement. Within the influence of the Crimson Hunger Sovereign Spire of Osmont, two figures stood observing the organized chaos. These two were the humanoid form of Hyperion and... Bob!
Little Bobby!
Hyperion maintained his characteristically cold gaze as he calmly observed everything with analytical detachment.
He turned slightly and happened to notice Bob standing nearby.
Bob looked distinctly forlorn and frustrated...his expression suggesting he'd just experienced personal defeat.
When Hyperion followed Bob's gaze to identify what provoked such
reaction...
He saw the figures of Henry talking vibrantly with two young women.
Henry was laughing, gesturing animatedly, clearly enjoying himself immensely. Hyperion raised his eyebrows at such scene.
Even though he genuinely didn't want to engage in conversation...
He forced himself to speak since proximity made silence awkward.
"Did you attempt to compete with the son of our monstrous Leader in pursuing romantic interest and subsequently lose? That represents a losing battle from inception, my friend."
At such words, Bob turned toward Hyperion with visible scowl.
"One of those women is my daughter. I was absent just for brief period, and this guy simply swooped in and just..." Bob's visage trembled with paternal frustration as words failed him.
Hyperion blinked and looked at him with an expression shifting to something approaching sympathy.
Eventually he raised his eyebrows and spoke with pragmatic
observation.

"Should you not be experiencing happiness rather than distress? Within our Civilization and broader existence, is there genuinely superior choice than the son of our monstrous Leader if your daughter was to establish a connection with anyone?" He paused deliberately.
"Or... would you rather prefer it be with The Leader himself?"
At such casually delivered statement, Bob visibly shuddered as if
experiencing visceral nightmare.
His round, circular bald head developed visible sweat as he nodded with rapid agreement.
"Fuck. You're absolutely right. You're correct. That perspective helps somewhat..."
He paused and blinked.
"Who are you again?"
Hyperion sighed with sn expression suggesting he couldn't believe
this conversation was even occurring.
"Hyperion."
Bob nodded.
"Bob."
Just as the two finished their perfunctory introductions, a booming
voice echoed through the air with authority that made everyone stop
their activities immediately.
Noah's words rang out across the entire Early Veiled Shore with
unmistakable command.
"The time has arrived to subject our Civilization to a genuine trial! There exist enemies belonging to the Primordial Civilizations that we will soon be confronting directly."
His voice intensified.

"Those who wish to participate in this engagement... adorn your Civilizational Armor immediately. Assemble together with your respective Civilization Specialization Faction and prepare for deployment." The declaration carried finality.
"The adversaries you will face during this operation will be the preserved forces of THE Living Emotive and THE Living Elemental, armies that have been frozen across eons and now await elimination."
His words were booming and impossibly heavy.
All those who heard them looked upward and around as his voice
seemed to echo from everywhere simultaneously, authority that couldn't be ignored or dismissed. Their eyes shone with mixture of anticipation and mounting
determination. Movement began blooming across the Early Veiled Shore as many
responded to their Leader's call! Civilizational Armor manifested. Specialists assembled with their factions.
A glorious war was coming.
And Noah's Civilization was ready for a feast!
